jobs.title: Global PR Lead - 12 month FTC
jobs.description:
About Skyscanner

Everyone loves travelling, but planning is not without its challenges ✈️. That's why we've spent 20 years building tools that turn travel-planning chaos into a breeze. Today, around 160 million travellers count on us every month to skip the whole “47 browser tabs open” phase and find flights, cars, and hotels quickly and easily 💻.

Joining Skyscanner means becoming part of a global brand that's striving to become the planet's go-to travel hack accessible for all 🌍.

Our vision? To be the world's number one travel ally. (Ambitious? 💪Yes, but, hey, that's what got us here).

Now, we’re on the lookout for a Global PR Lead to help us bring that vision to even more travellers.

About the role
(Hybrid)

This is a role at the heart of our fast-paced, high-volume PR team, helping keep our communications flying in formation across 23 markets worldwide. You’ll be the central point connecting plans, people, budgets, agencies and operations — making sure our global PR machine runs smoothly, efficiently and at scale.

Working closely with our Senior Director of Communications, regional PR leads, internal teams and global agency partners, you’ll help turn our international PR strategy into coordinated action. From shaping global initiatives to sharpening the way we plan, measure and operate, you’ll bring the structure that helps brilliant PR ideas travel further.

What you’ll be doing

  • Driving global PR planning: You’ll lead the planning process with our global PR agency hub, partnering with the Senior Director of Communications to keep forecasting, budgets, resources and priorities aligned.

  • Turning measurement into momentum: You’ll work closely with our measurement lead to make sure reporting is accurate, useful and connected to the strategies and decisions that matter.

  • Optimising our PR ecosystem: You’ll partner with Procurement and Finance to make sure we have the right suppliers, commercial setup and financial tracking in place to support growth — without the spreadsheet drama.

  • Keeping priorities moving: You’ll traffic-manage inbound requests, help the team navigate competing priorities and make sure resources are focused where they can have the greatest impact.

  • Leading global PR initiatives: You’ll spearhead strategic PR initiatives and special projects beyond our core campaigns, while supporting the delivery of our Awareness strategy and Big Bet activity through PR.

  • Making operations smarter: You’ll lead and collaborate on cross-functional improvements spanning tools and technology, including Tableau, ThoughtSpot, AI and our Product Ops model — finding smarter ways for a global team to work at scale.

  • Creating consistency across markets: You’ll partner with market leads, our global agency hub and Corporate and B2B PR teams to develop playbooks, strengthen processes and drive consistent adoption and delivery across 23 markets. You’ll also manage and develop our PR Coordinator, keeping calendars, finance trackers and reporting firmly on course.

About you

  • Global PR operator: You’ve worked in complex, international communications environments and know how to turn lots of moving parts into one joined-up plan.

  • Strategic and operational: You’re equally comfortable shaping a global PR initiative and getting into the detail needed to make it happen. Big picture, meet beautifully organised spreadsheet.

  • Stakeholder savvy: You build trusted relationships across senior leaders, market teams, agencies and cross-functional partners, bringing people together around shared priorities.

  • Agency confident: You know how to get the best from global agency relationships, balancing clear direction, strong partnership and accountability for delivery.

  • Commercially switched-on: You’re comfortable working with budgets, forecasting, suppliers, Procurement and Finance, and you understand how strong operational foundations help teams achieve more.

  • Tech and data curious: You’re interested in how measurement, dashboards, AI and smarter tools can improve PR operations, reporting and decision-making at scale.

  • Calm in the whirlwind: You thrive in fast-paced environments, can prioritise when everything feels important, and enjoy helping teams work more effectively. You’re also comfortable managing and developing others along the way.


What it's like here

We are the real deal - no corporate gloss, no empty promises. Just a team of genuinely curious, caring humans ❤️, building things that help travellers explore the world a little easier 🧭.

Skyscanner is made up of brilliant humans from every corner of the world. We believe travel makes the world better - and that the same is true of our diverse teams. We're proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and products that are accessible to all ✨.

Sound like your kind of adventure? 🚀 Apply now and help us shape the future of travel.

We're committed to ensuring our application and recruitment processes are inclusive and accessible to everyone. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations for interviews, and/or wish to apply under the Disability Confident scheme, please let your recruiter know. If you’d like more information on any of our policies, such as hybrid working or Parental Leave policies (typically we pay a minimum of 24 weeks birth parent/maternity leave globally), our recruitment team can provide more information on these.

jobs.title: Customer Success Director EMEA
jobs.description:
About EDITED

EDITED is the world’s leading AI-driven retail intelligence platform. We empower the world’s most successful brands and retailers with real-time decision making power. 

By connecting internal business and external market data, EDITED infuses intelligence into every retail decision. We help retailers increase margins, generate more sales, and drive better business outcomes through AI-powered market and enterprise intelligence that fuels automation. 

At EDITED, we foster a dynamic and inclusive culture where creativity thrives and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Our environment is dynamic and supportive, encouraging team members to take initiative, innovate, and continuously grow. We value diversity, transparency, and a shared commitment to excellence, creating a workplace where everyone's voice is heard and contributions are recognised. 

We believe that achieving a positive work-life balance is key to driving innovation and success. Our flexible working options—including hybrid working, flexible hours and a work from anywhere policy—empower our team to perform at their best. 

The Opportunity

A dynamic and results-driven Director of Customer Success who will lead our EMEA customer success strategy and team, responsible for > $10M in ARR, reporting directly into the Global Head of Customer Success. This role will be pivotal in driving customer retention, satisfaction and expansion initiatives across our SaaS customer base. The EMEA Director of Customer Success will be responsible for building a world-class customer success organization that delivers exceptional value to our customers throughout their entire EDITED platform journey.

The candidate will possess a demonstrated history of success in leading and scaling customer success organizations within the B2B SaaS space, and most importantly, experience in growing complex SaaS businesses. This includes a demonstrated ability to enable the creation and implementation of a repeatable, scalable customer journey that drives predictability in retention, expansion and customer advocacy. Additionally, experience in building and leading high-performing customer success teams, fostering a data-driven culture, and effectively managing resources to optimize efficiency and scalability are crucial. The ability to navigate complex organizational structures, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and secure executive buy-in is also essential for success in this high-growth environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Retention and expansion of the EMEA book: full accountability for Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) targets across the portfolio.

  • Direct management of a team of Account Managers and Retail Strategists. Managing the personal development of the team in service of delivering world-class customer service that directly supports retention and expansion goals.

  • Work closely with Director of Customer Success, NA (peer role) to ensure a smooth, consistent and world class customer experience regardless of contract size or product suite purchased

  • Own the key leading indicators of churn risk: data quality/adoption within the platform, KPI attainment, executive sponsor engagement, and health scoring — and intervene early on at-risk accounts.

  • Guide a deal cycle to a successful outcome

What You’ll Bring:

  • Direct experience managing both technical/delivery talent and commercially-oriented account management talent under one team.

  • Comfort operating in a data-driven, metrics-first culture — you can build and defend a GRR/NRR forecast, not just describe customer sentiment.

  • Ability to navigate complex organizational structures, influence cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Sales, Finance), and secure executive buy-in.

  • Strong relationship-building skills, internally and with senior client stakeholders.

  • Ability to move fluidly between tactical, day-to-day account issues and longer-term strategic planning.

  • At least 3 years of management experience actively coaching a dynamic team(s) to achieve both organisational and individual goals.

  • A minimum of 5 years experience working within a B2B SaaS organisation.

  • Retail industry background or deep familiarity with retail/merchandising working practices and pain points required.

 

Behaviours That Are Important:

  • Product evangelist who leads by example

  • Solutions-focused, bias to action

  • Strong time management and prioritization across a varied portfolio

  • Nurturing, hands-on coach to the team

  • Collaborative, low-ego mindset

 

What We Offer You

We value our team and to attract exceptional people, we offer an excellent package! This year, we were recognised as one of the top companies to work for in the UK.

jobs.title: International Trainee - Business Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

Job Description

Shape the future of energy.

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives and contribute to solving one of society's most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall and contribute to the energy transition from day one.



About the traineeship.  

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each of the trainee positions is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area and working location. This means that each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges and matching profile.

What you will experience

    Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges.
    Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall's different markets, business areas and locations through programme activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration.
    Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm, explains, “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”  

  

Your role as a Trainee – Business Engineer

As a Trainee Business Engineer you will join Customer Relations and Connections B2B within Vattenfall Eldistribution, where we partner with some of Sweden’s largest energy producers and large consumers. Here, you will have the chance to contribute to the energy transition and gain hands-on experience in supporting the large-scale electrification of society.

In this role, you will gain hands-on experience working with customer connection projects, strategic customer relationships, and sustainable energy solutions. You will collaborate with customers, technical specialists, project managers and colleagues across the business, gradually taking on increasing responsibility for your own customer portfolio. This is an opportunity to develop expertise in key account management, customer engagement and electricity distribution while contributing to the energy transition and supporting solutions that create value for customers, Vattenfall, and society.



Your responsibilities:  

    Support customer connection projects from initial dialogue through planning and implementation.
    Build and maintain strong relationships with industrial customers and key stakeholders.
    Contribute to commercial discussions, customer agreements, and business development activities.
    Analyze customer needs and identify opportunities that support electrification and sustainable growth.
    Prepare business cases, cost estimates, and customer presentations.
    Support the development of innovative ways of working through digitalization and automation.
    Support the business in leveraging data, analytics, and reporting to improve decision-making across Vattenfall Eldistribution.

Qualifications

Your qualifications as a Trainee - Business Engineer

    University degree in Industrial Engineering and Management, Engineering, Business or a related field.
    Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.
    An interest in technical systems and to work with cost estimates and financial calculations.

We are looking for someone who is curious, driven, and eager to learn. You enjoy taking initiative, challenging existing ways of working, and contributing with new perspectives. As a person, you combine analytical thinking with strong interpersonal skills and thrive in environments where collaboration and continuous improvement are key.

You enjoy building relationships and communicating with different stakeholders, creating trust through a service-minded and professional approach. You are interested in business, enjoy presenting ideas, and can navigate constructive discussions with both customers and colleagues. An interest in innovation, digitalization, AI, and continuous improvement is highly valued, as we are constantly looking for new ways to improve processes and create better solutions.

Whether you aspire to become an energy specialist, project manager, digital expert, engineer or future leader, the International Trainee Programme offers opportunities to explore your potential and build a meaningful career.

As Cato, a former International Trainee based in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”  



To be considered for our traineeship, you should:  

    Have completed, or expect to complete, an academic degree before the programme starts in March 2027
    Have no more than one year of relevant work experience after graduation, excluding internships and working-student roles
    Be available for the full-time programme from its start date
    Have the right to work in the country where the position is based, or meet the stated work-permit requirements
    Be open to mobility opportunities and collaborating across different locations.
    Demonstrate curiosity, initiative and growth mindset while sharing our values: Active, Open, Positive and Safe.



Location:

You will be working in the department Customer Relations and Connections B2B and located in Solna (Sweden).

jobs.title: Sosial og kreativ 22-åring søker nye BPA assistenter på Mortensrud !🌸
jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest
📌 Stillingstype: Fast
⏰ Arbeidstid: Ukedager (tidvis helg)


Hei!

Jeg er en sosial og kreativ jente på 22 år som bor i Søndre Nordstrand i Oslo (Mortensrud/ Dal) sammen med mine foreldre og to søsken. På fritiden liker jeg å dra på kjøpesenter, spise ute, gå på kino og være sammen med familie og venner. Jeg er også glad i å tegne, male og spille spill. Nå ser jeg etter en eller flere assistenter som kan bidra til at jeg får en aktiv, morsom og selvstendig hverdag.

Da jeg var barn, ble jeg utsatt for en bilulykke som har gitt meg lettere fysiske utfordringer og en lett utviklingshemming. Jeg kommuniserer godt og deltar aktivt i hverdagen min, men trenger praktisk bistand og støtte til ulike gjøremål og aktiviteter.

Stilling og arbeidstid

Jeg søker nå en fast assistent i en stilling på 12t i uken. Arbeidstiden er hovedsakelig på hverdager fra ca. kl. 14.00-20.00, med noe arbeid i helger mellom kl. 10.00-20.00. Arbeidstider kan varier noe i ferier- dette finner vi ut av sammen.

Oppgi gjerne i din søknad om det er noen dager/ tider du ikke har anledning til å jobbe.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Ta imot meg når jeg kommer hjem fra jobb/dagsenter

  • Lage og tilrettelegge måltider sammen med meg

  • Bistå ved skift og personlig hygiene, inkludert dusj (ingen tunge løft)

  • Bli med på gåturer i nærområdet

  • Følge til fysioterapeut

  • Vaske og stryke klær

  • Holde rommet mitt ryddig

  • Stelle planter

  • Delta på sosiale aktiviteter, familiebesøk og andre hyggelige sammenkomster

Hvem ser jeg etter?

  • Du er positiv, omsorgsfull og tålmodig

  • Du er initiativrik og liker å motivere og utfordre meg på en god måte

  • Du er trygg i voksenrollen, samtidig som du gjerne er i nærheten av min egen alder

  • Du trives med å være sosial og bygge gode relasjoner

  • Du er fleksibel og løsningsorientert

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Det er et pluss om du snakker urdu, slik at du kan kommunisere med min mor

  • Kan gjøre deg godt forstått og forstå norsk godt (B1 Norsk kurs)

  • Førerkort er ønskelig, men ikke et krav

  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt

  • Grunnet stillings natur, oppfordres kvinner til å søke

Hos meg får du en variert og meningsfull jobb hvor du blir en viktig del av hverdagen min. Hvis du kjenner deg igjen i beskrivelsen og ønsker en jobb der ingen dager er helt like, håper jeg å høre fra deg! 😊

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Hanna Brurås på epost: hanna.bruras@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: Konserter, gode øyeblikk og hverdagsliv – bli min BPA-assistent 🎶
jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest
📌 Stillingstype: Fast, vikariat og tilkalling
⏰ Arbeidstid: Dag, kveld og natt – ukedager og helger

Hei! 😊

Jeg er en livsglad og sosial dame på 51 år som nå ønsker å styrke BPA-teamet mitt med flere gode assistenter. På grunn av langtidssykefravær og permisjoner har jeg behov for flere personer rundt meg, og søker både faste assistenter, vikarer og fleksible tilkallingsvikarer.

Jeg tilbringer mye tid hjemme og setter pris på gode og rolige dager, men jeg liker også veldig godt å finne på ting. Konserter og reiser er noe av det beste jeg vet, og jeg er glad i å invitere venner og familie på besøk og selskap. Jeg interesserer meg også for historie og blomster, og prøver generelt å være flink til å sette pris på de små og store øyeblikkene i hverdagen.

Jeg har ALS og trenger assistanse for å kunne leve livet mitt slik jeg ønsker. Som assistent hos meg blir du derfor en viktig del av hverdagen min – og mine ekstra armer og ben når jeg trenger det.

En viktig rolle i hverdagen min

ALS er en sykdom i utvikling, og behovet mitt for bistand kan derfor endre seg over tid. Arbeidsdagen vil være variert og kan blant annet innebære personlig stell, forflytning, praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet og bistand når jeg skal ut på aktiviteter, konserter eller reiser.

Noen dager krever mer enn andre. Derfor er det viktig for meg å ha assistenter rundt meg som er trygge, oppmerksomme og klarer å tilpasse seg situasjonen. Du må kunne ta ansvar og jobbe selvstendig, samtidig som du forstår at dette er mitt hjem og min hverdag.

Du trenger ikke kunne alt fra før. Du vil få god opplæring og relevante kurs slik at du blir trygg på arbeidsoppgavene og rollen som BPA-assistent.

På grunn av arbeidets karakter, som innebærer personlig og intim bistand, søker jeg kvinnelige assistenter til stillingene.

🔎 Dette er stillingene som er ledige nå

Grunnet langtidssykefravær og permisjoner har jeg nå behov for flere assistenter og søker etter:

  • Nattevakt i 62 % stilling – vakter både på ukedager og i helger

  • Vikariat i 70 % stilling – med mulighet for fast ansettelse

  • Fast stilling i 70 %

  • 1–2 tilkallingsvikarer som kan stille opp ved sykdom, ferie og andre behov

Turnusen innebærer arbeid både på ukedager og i helger, og avhengig av stillingen vil vaktene være på dagtid, kveld eller natt.

Skriv gjerne i søknaden hvilken av stillingene du er interessert i, og hvor mye du ønsker å jobbe.

🛠️ Dette vil du blant annet hjelpe meg med

  • Personlig stell og daglige gjøremål

  • Forflytning og praktisk bistand

  • Huslige oppgaver

  • Å skape trygghet og forutsigbarhet i hverdagen

  • Å bli med på konserter, turer, reiser og andre aktiviteter

🧭 Hvem håper jeg at du er?

Jeg ser etter deg som er trygg og omsorgsfull, men samtidig selvstendig og ansvarsbevisst. Det er viktig at jeg kan stole på at du møter opp som avtalt og tar jobben på alvor.

Jeg tror du vil passe godt inn hos meg dersom du:

  • Er pålitelig, punktlig og ansvarsfull

  • Har høy arbeidsmoral og tar initiativ

  • Er omsorgsfull, empatisk og tålmodig

  • Er fleksibel og tilpasningsdyktig

  • Har et glimt i øyet og bidrar til gode dager

🎓 Kvalifikasjoner

  • Førerkort klasse B, manuell

  • Gode norskkunnskaper

  • Gyldig politiattest

  • Personlig egnethet og kjemi vil bli vektlagt

Høres dette ut som en jobb som kan passe for deg? Da håper jeg du sender inn en søknad! 🙌

Ved spørsmål om stillingen kan du kontakte rekrutterer Petter Ariel Skog på e-post: petter.skog@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfull og variert jobb

  • Verdifull erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49 kr, kveldstillegg på 67 kr og helgetillegg på 70 kr

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Tett oppfølging fra BPA-koordinator

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer og nettbutikker

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: International Trainee - Property Development and Construction Management
jobs.description:
Företagsbeskrivning

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

Om rollen

Shape the future of energy.

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives and contribute to solving one of society's most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall and contribute to the energy transition from day one.



About the traineeship.  

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each of the trainee positions is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area and working location. This means that each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges and matching profile.

What you will experience

    Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges.
    Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall's different markets, business areas and locations through programme activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration.
    Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm, explains, “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”  

  

Your role as a Trainee - Property Development and Construction Management

You will join Property Development and Construction Management. We are involved in all phases of project development, from early-stage feasibility studies and planning to project execution and completion. Our focus is on managing and addressing construction-related issues throughout the development process to ensure successful project delivery.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to participate in and support feasibility studies, including meetings and activities aimed at enabling efficient project delivery. You will also gain experience in later project phases, working alongside Construction Managers on tasks such as cost control, contractor management, risk management, and other construction-related matters.

This is an excellent opportunity to gain insight into the entire construction and development process and contribute throughout all project phases. Typical responsibilities may include participating in, and eventually supporting, Real Estate Developers in negotiations and project planning during the early stages of development. You will also assist Construction Managers in documenting project deficiencies and quality issues, and over time develop the ability to independently evaluate construction-related challenges and propose solutions under the guidance of experienced colleagues.



Your responsibilities:  

    Support Construction Managers with the documentation of construction-related defects and project issues
    Participate in technical drawing reviews to ensure compliance with project requirements and construction standards.
    Support real estate developers in managing construction-related matters during feasibility study phase and early-stage project development.
    Provide administrative support across construction and development projects
    Collaborate with internal teams and external contractors to support efficient project delivery.

Kravspecifikation

Your qualifications as a Trainee - Property Development and Construction Management

    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Urban Development and Infrastructure, or a related field.
    Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

You should also recognize yourself in

    You are comfortable navigating different perspectives and balancing the interests of multiple stakeholders.
    You are proactive, curious, and eager to take initiative while maintaining a humble attitude and a willingness to learn.
    You are open-minded and receptive to new ideas, while also able to make sound decisions when needed.
    You have strong communication and collaboration skills and enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams.

Whether you aspire to become an energy specialist, project manager, digital expert, engineer or future leader, the International Trainee Programme offers opportunities to explore your potential and build a meaningful career.

As Cato, a former International Trainee based in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”  

To be considered for our traineeship, you should:  

    Have completed, or expect to complete, an academic degree before the programme starts in March 2027
    Have no more than one year of relevant work experience after graduation, excluding internships and working-student roles
    Be fluent in English
    Be available for the full-time programme from its start date
    Have the right to work in the country where the position is based, or meet the stated work-permit requirements
    Be open to mobility opportunities and collaborating across different locations.
    Demonstrate curiosity, initiative and growth mindset while sharing our values: Active, Open, Positive and Safe.

Location:

You will be working in the department Construction and Property Development and be located in Solna, Trollhättan or Gothenburg, (Sweden).

Ytterligare information

Our offer

“Vattenfall provides me with the steepest learning curve. We are a group that feels connected by our core values in line with the organization's values: Open, Active, Positive and Safe.

jobs.title: Sjåfør - Distribusjon - førerkort klasse B
jobs.description:
Sjåfør søkes til Leko Matter AS

Leko Matter AS søker flere pålitelige og serviceinnstilte sjåfører til distribusjon av matter og mopper i Oslo og omegn.

Arbeidet består hovedsakelig av levering og henting av matter og mopper hos våre bedriftskunder. Du vil ha en selvstendig arbeidshverdag med faste ruter og kundekontakt.

Det er en fordel om du er kjent i Oslo og omegn, gjerne gjennom tidligere arbeid med distribusjon, transport eller levering. Tidligere erfaring som sjåfør er imidlertid ikke et krav, da full opplæring vil bli gitt.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har førerkort klasse B

  • Behersker norsk eller engelsk

  • Er pålitelig, stabil og ansvarsbevisst

  • Trives med en selvstendig og aktiv arbeidshverdag

  • Er serviceinnstilt og komfortabel med kundekontakt

  • Gjerne er kjent i Oslo og omegn

Vi tilbyr:

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn

  • Ordnede arbeidsforhold

  • Fleksibel arbeidstid

  • Fem ukers ferie

  • Full opplæring

  • En selvstendig arbeidshverdag i et etablert norsk selskap

Pålitelighet og stabilitet er viktig for oss, og vi ønsker at dette så langt som mulig kan dokumenteres gjennom attester og referanser fra tidligere arbeidsforhold.

Søknad:

Send en kortfattet søknad på norsk eller engelsk, gjerne med CV og en beskrivelse av relevant arbeidserfaring.

Telefonhenvendelser og personlig oppmøte i forbindelse med stillingen ønskes ikke.

Mer informasjon om Leko Matter AS finner du på www.leko.no.

English summary

Leko Matter AS is looking for reliable and service-minded drivers for the delivery and collection of mats and mops in Oslo and the surrounding areas.

A category B driving licence is required. Previous professional driving experience is not necessary, as full training will be provided. Knowledge of Oslo and the surrounding areas is an advantage.

You must be able to communicate in either Norwegian or English. We are looking for reliable, responsible and stable employees who enjoy working independently and providing good customer service.

We offer competitive pay, flexible working hours, five weeks of holiday and good working conditions.

Please submit your application and CV in Norwegian or English. No phone enquiries or personal visits, please.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Leko Matter AS er en veletablert norsk bedrift med lang erfaring innen utleie, vask og distribusjon av matter og mopper til bedriftsmarkedet. Vi holder til på Langhus og betjener kunder i sentrale østlandsområdet. Vi legger vekt på høy servicegrad, kvalitet, pålitelighet og gode langsiktige kunderelasjoner. Leko Matter AS er Miljøfyrtårn-sertifisert. Se mer info om oss på våre nettsider.

jobs.title: Energieberater / Gebäudetechniker / Quereinsteiger* (m/w/d) in Dresden
jobs.description:
Dein Einstieg in die Zukunft der Immobilienwirtschaft – direkt an der Seite der Gründer und des Head of Growth & Revenue

Enerithm ist die digitale Antwort auf die drängendsten Fragen der modernen Immobilienwirtschaft. Mit unserer KI-gestützten SaaS-Plattform transformieren wir die klassische Energieberatung in einen hochgradig skalierbaren, normgerechten Prozess. Während der Markt unter dem Druck nationaler und europäischer Richtlinien (GModG, EPBD, etc.) steht, liefern wir die technologische Infrastruktur für die Dekarbonisierung einzelner Gebäude und ganzer Portfolios.

Unsere Bilanz spricht für sich: Mit einer jährlichen Wachstumsrate von über 100 % und einem Kundenstamm, der namhafte Branchenführer umfasst, haben wir den Proof-of-Concept eindrucksvoll erbracht. Hinter Enerithm stehen Gründer der TU Dresden, die fachliche Exzellenz und wissenschaftliche Fundierung in ein marktführendes Produkt übersetzt haben.

Egal, ob du als erfahrener Energieberater, technischer Quereinsteiger oder Berufseinsteiger nach dem Studium zu uns kommst – wir bieten dir den passenden Einstieg und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem innovativen GreenTech-Startup.

Aufgaben

Je nach Erfahrung übernimmst du folgende Tätigkeiten:

  • Prüfung und Qualitätssicherung von Energieausweisen inkl. Vor-Ort-Termin zur Datenaufnahme
  • Erstellung von Energieausweisen für Nichtwohngebäude inkl. Vor-Ort-Termin zur Datenaufnahme
  • Erstellung von Heizlastberechnungen und Energiebilanzen
  • Beratung zu KfW-Effizienzhäusern und nachhaltigen Sanierungen
  • Bearbeitung und Erstellung von Förderanträgen (BAFA, KfW)
  • Begleitung und Umsetzung von Energieeffizienzmaßnahmen

Qualifikation

Wir suchen sowohl erfahrene Fachkräfte als auch motivierte Einsteiger. Wichtig sind

uns:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung in einem relevanten Bereich (z. B. Architektur, Bauingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Umwelttechnik, Gebäudetechnik)
  • Alternativ: Berufserfahrung in einem technischen Bereich mit Interesse an Energieberatung (z. B. Bauleitung, Projektingenieurwesen)
  • Technisches Verständnis und analytische Fähigkeiten
  • Kommunikationsstärke – du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich erklären
  • Interesse an Weiterbildung und ggf. Zertifizierung als Energieberater

Benefits

  • Einstieg in ein schnell wachsendes Green-Tech-Startup mit direktem Impact
  • Praxisnahe Einarbeitung und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (inkl. Unterstützung bei der BAFA/KfW-Zertifizierung)
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, Prozesse mitzugestalten
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und hybrides Arbeiten
  • Attraktive Vergütung mit Entwicklungsperspektive

Interesse?

Dann schreib uns, warum du zu Enerithm passt und was dich antreibt.

Ein klassischer Lebenslauf ist schön, aber wichtiger ist uns dein Mindset und deine Motivation!

jobs.title: 100% Remote - 75k - Senior Fullstack-Entwickler*in  (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Hallo! Wir sind Applysia, ein HR-Tech-Unternehmen aus Münster. Unsere Software für die Personalauswahl wird von führenden Unternehmen und Beratungen weltweit genutzt, um Assessment-Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten.

Mit unserer Lösung vereinfachen und verbessern wir Assessment-Center nachhaltig, um Potenziale in Menschen vorurteilsfrei zu erkennen, zu fördern und zu entfalten. Mit Kompetenz, Vielseitigkeit und Engagement gestalten wir das Assessment des 21. Jahrhunderts. Unser Ziel: HR-Prozesse digitalisieren und Auswahlverfahren fairer, nachhaltiger und effizienter machen.

Aufgaben

Als Senior Fullstack Developer treibst du zusammen mit uns die Entwicklung unseres Backends, Frontends und unserer API voran. Du setzt neue Features eigenständig um und bist aktiv in Architektur- und Technologieentscheidungen eingebunden.

Uns ist es wichtig, eine Applikation zu entwickeln, die nicht nur leistungsfähig, sondern auch für jede*n Nutzer*in leicht verständlich und angenehm zu bedienen ist.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast bereits mit modernen Frameworks wie Ruby on Rails, Spring Boot oder Laravel entwickelt. Rails-Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber wir legen vor allem Wert auf deine umfassende Fullstack-Kompetenz.
  • Frontend-Entwicklung bereitet dir Freude. Wir nutzen Rails in Kombination mit Vue.js, um interaktive Features umzusetzen.
  • Du bist vertraut mit AWS oder hast Interesse, dich in AWS-Technologien einzuarbeiten.
  • Testing liegt dir am Herzen, egal ob Unit-, Integrations- oder End-to-End-Tests (z. B. mit Cypress).
  • Du hast Erfahrung im Arbeiten in agilen Teams mit einem CI/CD-Prozess und idealerweise mit GitHub Actions.
  • Du hast den Gesamtüberblick über die Applikation und liebst die Arbeit sowohl am Backend als auch am Frontend.
  • Du arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen und Technologien ein und löst komplexe Probleme kreativ.
  • Du möchtest ein Produkt maßgeblich mitgestalten, triffst gerne technische Entscheidungen und hast die Bedürfnisse der Kund*innen immer im Blick.
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Du bestimmst, wann du am produktivsten bist.
  • Freie Wahl der Arbeitsmittel: Mac, mechanische Tastatur, Plugins, IDE – du entscheidest, was du brauchst, und wir sorgen dafür.
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents: Wir legen Wert auf eine gute Unternehmenskultur – wir arbeiten zusammen, nicht nur nebeneinander.
  • Von Anfang an Verantwortung übernehmen, unterstützt durch regelmäßiges Feedback.
  • Raum für eigene Ideen, Erfahrungen und Eigeninitiative.

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess bei uns ab

Uns ist ein transparenter und fairer Auswahlprozess wichtig. Wir möchten dich und deine Fähigkeiten bestmöglich kennenlernen – gleichzeitig sollst auch du ein gutes Gefühl dafür bekommen, wer wir sind und wie wir arbeiten. Deshalb besteht unser Prozess aus drei klar strukturierten Schritten:

1. Kurzes Telefoninterview (ca. 30 Minuten)

In einem ersten Gespräch lernen wir uns gegenseitig kennen. Wir stellen dir die Position, unser Team und unsere Arbeitsweise vor und beantworten alle deine Fragen. Gleichzeitig interessiert uns, was dich motiviert, welche Erfahrungen du mitbringst und was du dir von deiner nächsten Rolle wünschst.
Warum? – Der persönliche Eindruck zählt. Wir möchten herausfinden, ob wir gut zueinander passen – fachlich und menschlich.

2. Eignungsdiagnostik (ca. 2–3 Stunden, flexibel einteilbar)

In diesem Schritt bitten wir dich, drei Bausteine zu absolvieren:

  • Coding Challege: Du kannst deine Coding Skills zeigen.
  • Einen kognitiven Leistungstest, der hilft, dein analytisches Denkvermögen objektiv zu erfassen.
  • Einen kurzen Persönlichkeitsfragebogen, der Aufschluss darüber gibt, wie du arbeitest, kommunizierst und Probleme angehst.

Warum? – Wir glauben an eine fundierte und faire Entscheidungsgrundlage. Unsere Diagnostik-Tools helfen uns (und dir), besser zu verstehen, wo deine Stärken liegen und wie du am besten ins Team passt – ganz ohne Bias.

3. Technisches Interview (ca. 60–90 Minuten)

In einem vertiefenden Gespräch mit unseren Entwickler*innen schauen wir uns gemeinsam die Ergebnisse der Challenge an, besprechen Lösungswege und tauschen uns über Architektur, Code-Qualität und deinen Entwicklungsstil aus. Dabei ist uns wichtig, dass du Fragen stellen kannst und wir auf Augenhöhe miteinander sprechen.

Warum? – Wir wollen sehen, wie du denkst, wie du Probleme angehst und welche Perspektiven du in unser Team einbringen kannst. Gleichzeitig bekommst du einen realistischen Eindruck davon, wie wir als Team arbeiten und mit welchen Technologien wir umgehen.

jobs.title: Co-Founder - Business, Finance & Commercial (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Kali Energy is a Berlin-based pre-seed startup developing industrial thermal energy storage technology to help decarbonize industrial process heat. Our founders are engineers with prior hands-on experience taking an industrial-scale thermal energy storage system from early-stage development through to manufacturing handover. We are now applying that experience to build a more efficient next-generation system.

We are currently validating our proof-of-concept test rig, applying for the EXIST Gründungsstipendium through our host university, and in active discussions with investors. EXIST is one path we are pursuing, not our only one.

This is not a standard employment role. It is an opportunity to join as a founding co-founder with equalownership over the company's commercial direction, from company registration onward.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a full-time co-founder to lead the business, finance, and commercial side of the company. You will complement our technical founding team and become the face of the company to investors and customers.

Both of us are engineers. We need someone who will challenge us on the business side, own fundraising, and talk to clients and investors directly.

Tasks

  • Own business and financial planning, including financial modelling, pricing strategy, and fundraising materials
  • Lead investor conversations, due diligence preparation, and grant or non-dilutive funding applications
  • Lead go-to-market strategy and early sales efforts in our target industry
  • Develop partnerships with relevant industry players
  • Manage company registration and commercial operations
  • Contribute to hiring as the team grows

Requirements

Must have

  • A background in business, finance, economics, or marketing, OR a technical degree combined with an MBA, OR project management experience with budget ownership, client-facing, or commercial delivery responsibility
  • Minimum 2 years of relevant experience (the more the better)
  • Genuine, demonstrated interest in energy, decarbonization, or climate tech specifically
  • Comfortable operating in an early-stage, ambiguous environment with no playbook
  • Based in or willing to relocate to Berlin
  • A completed degree from a German university, no older than 5 years, or completing within the next 2-3 months. This is required for our EXIST eligibility and is non-negotiable.

Nice to have

  • German language
  • Direct experience in B2B sales, fundraising, or grant applications
  • An existing network among industrial clients or investors in energy or climate
  • Financial modelling experience specific to early-stage or pre-seed companies
  • Exposure to industrial or heavy-industry sectors

If you are missing something from the Nice to Have list but believe you are the right fit, make your case. The degree requirement above is the one exception. That one is fixed.

Benefits

What We Offer

Equity:
A founding co-founder role with meaningful equity. Vesting schedule applies. Final terms discussed directly.

EXIST Stipend (if eligible):
If our EXIST application is approved, the programme provides a separate, non-dilutive personal stipend for 12 months, administered through our host university and Projektträger Jülich. This comes on top of your equity stake, not instead of it. Indicative rates: ~€2,500/month for a completed Master's, ~€3,000/month for a PhD. Final amounts are confirmed by our host university and PtJ, not by us.

Timeline:

Based on the process we have been given, an EXIST funding decision realistically lands around Q1 2027. We are looking to bring someone on board now, well before that. You would be building alongside us through the application process itself, not waiting on the outcome to start.

Process:

  • Initial interview (45 minutes)
  • Case study (48 hours to complete), followed by a presentation
  • Final terms conversation: equity, structure, and any remaining questions

How to Apply:
Send a short note about yourself and why this role interests you, along with your CV and LinkedIn.
Please include your graduation date and university.

jobs.title: Founder’s Associate / Assistenz des CTO (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Ort: Berlin | Start: ab sofort | Anstellung: Vollzeit

Mach mit uns die Welt leiser und effizienter.

Wir sind ABSORA – ein Deep-GreenTech-Startup in Berlin. Mit unserer patentierten HSA3-Technologie entwickeln wir völlig neue Lösungen für Leichtbau, Akustik und Filtration. Unser Ziel ist es, unsere Produktion von der Werkstatt bis zur hochautomatisierten Serienfertigung auszubauen und Europa als Produktionsstandort zu stärken.

Dafür suchen wir dich – ein organisatorisches und technisches Allround-Talent mit Hands-on-Mentalität, das Verantwortung übernimmt, dem CTO den Rücken freihält und operative Prozesse vorausschauend vorantreibt.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission

Du arbeitest direkt an der Seite unseres CTOs und stellst sicher, dass strategische Roadmaps in die Praxis umgesetzt werden. Kein Tag gleicht dem anderen: Mal steuerst du Schnittstellenprojekte zwischen F&E und Fertigung, mal strukturierst du technische Spezifikationen, koordinierst Partner oder findest kreative Lösungen für operative Herausforderungen. Wenn du gerne selbstständig arbeitest, mitdenkst und komplexen technischen Projekten Struktur verleihst, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt den CTO operativ und strategisch beim Aufbau unserer Technologie- und Fertigungsprozesse.
  • Du übernimmst das Projektmanagement für technische Meilensteine, Erprobungsphasen und F&E-Initiativen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung, Werkstatt, Produktion und externen Schnittstellen zusammen und hältst den Informationsfluss aufrecht.
  • Du bereitest Termine, technische Entscheidungsvorlagen, Präsentationen und Berichte auf den Punkt vor und übernimmst die Ablage technischer Daten.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Vorbereitung von Lieferantenentscheidungen, Patenten oder technischen Zertifizierungen.
  • Du begleitest den Aufbau einer modernen Serienproduktion organisatorisch und behältst den Überblick über Fristen und Ressourcen.

Qualifikation

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich (Wirtschafts-)ingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Metallurgie, Physik, Technologiemanagement oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation an der Schnittstelle von Technik und Organisation.
  • Erste Erfahrung im Startup-Umfeld, im technischen Projektmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Assistenz- bzw. Founder's-Associate-Rolle.
  • Gutes technisches Verständnis und Begeisterung für hardwarenahe GreenTech-Lösungen.
  • Du hilfst anderen gerne beim Lösen von Problemen, stehst dem Team unterstützend zur Seite und kommunizierst klar, wertschätzend und ohne Befehlston.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, denkst dich schnell in neue Themen ein und findest auch in dynamischen Phasen pragmatische Lösungen.
  • Teamgeist, Eigeninitiative und Lust, in einem innovativen GreenTech-Startup etwas aufzubauen.

Benefits

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Schlüsselrolle mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und direkter Zusammenarbeit mit dem CTO und Gründer.
  • Einblicke in die Skalierung einer patentierten Deep-Tech-Hardware von der Entwicklung bis zur Serienfertigung.

  • Ein motiviertes Team mit flachen Hierarchien und einer offenen Unternehmenskultur.
  • Die Chance, an einer GreenTech-Technologie mitzuarbeiten, die Industrie und Nachhaltigkeit verbindet.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann bewirb dich bei uns! Wenn du Lust hast, gemeinsam mit uns neue Prozesse, Technologien und Produktionslösungen zu entwickeln, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

jobs.title: Senior Mobile Security Developer
jobs.description:
Waracle are looking for a Senior Mobile Security Developer for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy, home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role, offering the flexibility to balance your professional and personal life, with 2 days a week spent connecting with colleagues in our London office or on client site.


The Role

As a Senior Mobile Security Developer, you will define squad-level technical architecture and technical approach. You are a technical expert who ensures quality, security, and compliance across projects, driving robust and scalable solutions.

This role will be pivotal in building, delivering, and driving the security of our mobile platform, while being an integral part of our full-stack mobile practice, contributing to end-to-end development and security excellence across both front-end and back-end mobile systems.

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Design and Delivery of a World-Class Security Framework: Lead the design and delivery of security services, including mobile penetration testing, research, consultancy, and advisory engagements.

  • Technical Strategy & Architecture: Define secure technical approaches, identify risks, and develop effective threat models and mitigation strategies.

  • Strategic Planning: Translate business objectives into technical strategy and ensure technical roadmaps align with long-term client goals.

  • Agile Practices: Expertise in Agile methodologies, with a focus on resolving impediments and driving adoption across teams.

  • Client Engagement: Communicate effectively with clients, manage expectations, and provide practical, risk-based security recommendations.

  • Continuous Improvement & Collaboration: Drive innovation, adopt emerging security practices, share knowledge, and support team success.


What you'll bring:

We are seeking a highly technical expert with a strong focus on mobile platform security. You should bring:

  • Mobile Security Expertise: Strong hands-on knowledge of Android and iOS security fundamentals, common mobile threats and vulnerabilities, security architecture, controls, and mitigation techniques.

  • Mobile Security Testing: Practical experience in mobile penetration testing, security assessments, threat modelling, and implementing or assessing security controls.

  • Security Problem Solving: A systematic and analytical approach to identifying, investigating, and resolving mobile security issues.

  • Authentication & Cryptography: Strong understanding of authentication, authorisation, cryptography, encryption, and secure design principles, with the ability to recommend appropriate cryptographic controls.

  • Continuous Improvement: A proactive approach to improving security practices, tooling, controls, and ways of working.

Desirable knowledge & experience:

  • Mobile Security Tooling & Analysis: Experience with reverse engineering, analysis techniques, and tools such as Burp Suite Pro, Frida, Objection, JADX, IDA Pro, Hopper, Radare, ADB, Apktool, YARA, Xcode, and Android Studio.

  • Mobile Development & DevSecOps: Knowledge of Android/iOS development, secure development practices, DevSecOps tooling, testing, and automation frameworks.

  • Development & Reverse Engineering: Familiarity with C, Java, Kotlin, Objective-C, Swift, JavaScript, Python or Bash, and ideally ARM/ARM64 assembly.

  • Security Research: Awareness of emerging security technologies, Cloud security, and developments in mobile operating systems, APIs, tools, and security libraries.

What to expect from our hiring process

  • 1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

  • 2. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. Depending on the role, this will be a focused take-home task (capped at 2–3 hours to respect your time) or a practical presentation.

  • 3. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

jobs.title: International Trainee  Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

Job Description

Shape the future of energy.

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives and contribute to solving one of society's most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall and contribute to the energy transition from day one.

About the traineeship.

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each of the trainee positions is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area and working location. This means that each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges and matching profile.

What you will experience

    Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges.
    Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall's different markets, business areas and locations through programme activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration.
    Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm, explains, “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”

Your role as a Trainee – Financial Analyst

You will join the Corporate Finance & Analysis team, a small team supporting the CFO and other members of executive management with analysis and decision support on strategic financial topics across the Group. Operating in a rapidly changing energy market, we work on a wide range of topics that help shape Vattenfall's long-term direction.

You will contribute to financial analyses and decision-support material used by key stakeholders across the organisation. You will gain exposure to topics such as forecasting, business performance analysis, valuation and broader strategic and financial matters, while developing an understanding of both Vattenfall's business and the European energy sector.

We combine detailed financial analysis with a broader business perspective and work closely with colleagues across different parts of the organisation. This is an opportunity to develop your analytical skills and gain insight into the financial management of one of Europe's leading energy companies.

Your responsibilities:  

    Financial analysis and forecasting
    Analysis of business performance and key financial drivers
    Preparation of presentations and decision-support material
    Monitoring financial, market and industry developments

Qualifications

Your qualifications as a Trainee – Financial Analyst

    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field, such as Industrial Engineering

You should also recognize yourself in

    Analytical and curious
    Structured and proactive
    Comfortable working with data and financial information
    A team player with strong communication skills

Whether you aspire to become an energy specialist, project manager, digital expert, engineer or future leader, the International Trainee Programme offers opportunities to explore your potential and build a meaningful career.

As Cato, a former International Trainee based in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”

To be considered for our traineeship, you should:

    Have completed, or expect to complete, an academic degree before the programme starts in March 2027
    Have no more than one year of relevant work experience after graduation, excluding internships and working-student roles
    Be fluent in English
    Be available for the full-time programme from its start date
    Have the right to work in the country where the position is based, or meet the stated work-permit requirements
    Be open to mobility opportunities and collaborating across different locations.
    Demonstrate curiosity, initiative and growth mindset while sharing our values: Active, Open, Positive and Safe.

You will be working in the department Corporate Finance & Analysis and located in Stockholm (Solna), Sweden.

Additional Information

Our offer

“Vattenfall provides me with the steepest learning curve. We are a group that feels connected by our core values in line with the organization's values: Open, Active, Positive and Safe. We all feel part of a movement that understands the importance of human connection, resilience, and curiosity in energy transition and sustainability.” - Rogier, former International Trainee based in Amsterdam.

The Vattenfall International Trainee Programme is the kickstart of your career within Vattenfall. Over the course of a year, you will combine meaningful work with structured development opportunities, networking, workshops and site visits across Vattenfall's business areas and locations. Each position comes with a competitive salary and excellent remuneration package. Read more about the elements of the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme here.

Application process

We welcome your application in English via the application button on this page. Please include an updated resume. When applying, you will fill out screening questions, including your motivation. No cover letter or motivation letter is needed. The deadline to apply is October 18th, 2026. Selection will start after the application period with online tests, followed by interviews between the end of October to end November.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm, explains, “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”

Your role as a Trainee – Analyst Group Strategy

You will join Group Strategy, where we shape Vattenfall's strategic direction and long-term development. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work closely with senior leadership and gain unique insight into how strategic decisions are developed and implemented across the company. You will collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders and contribute to initiatives that support Vattenfall's future development. As your knowledge and experience grow, you will gradually take on greater responsibility. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your expertise in strategy while bringing fresh perspectives and ideas to the team.

Your responsibilities:

    Supporting strategic analyses, portfolio-level discussions and company-wide strategic initiatives
    Helping structure complex questions and translate them into clear insights and recommendations
    Preparing strategic presentations, briefings, and communication material for senior stakeholders
    Supporting workshops, meetings, and stakeholder dialogues across the organization

Qualifications

Your qualifications as a Trainee - Analyst Group Strategy

    Master's degree in Business Administration, Management, Industrial Economics, or a related field with a strong business focus
    Previous internship experience within strategy, consulting, finance or a related area

You should also recognize yourself in

    Strong analytical skills, able to work with both details and the bigger picture
    Excellent communication skills, both verbally and in writing
    Strong stakeholder management skills
    Self-leadership and the ability to work independently
    Communication skills in Swedish or another Nordic language

Whether you aspire to become an energy specialist, project manager, digital expert, engineer or future leader, the International Trainee Programme offers opportunities to explore your potential and build a meaningful career.

As Cato, a former International Trainee based in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”

To be considered for our traineeship, you should:

    Have completed, or expect to complete, an academic degree before the programme starts in March 2027
    Have no more than one year of relevant work experience after graduation, excluding internships and working-student roles
    Be fluent in English
    Be available for the full-time programme from its start date
    Have the right to work in the country where the position is based, or meet the stated work-permit requirements
    Be open to mobility opportunities and collaborating across different locations.
    Demonstrate curiosity, initiative and growth mindset while sharing our values: Active, Open, Positive and Safe.

Location:

You will be working in the department Group Strategy and located in Stockholm (Solna), Sweden.

Additional Information

Our offer

“Vattenfall provides me with the steepest learning curve. We are a group that feels connected by our core values in line with the organization's values: Open, Active, Positive and Safe. We all feel part of a movement that understands the importance of human connection, resilience, and curiosity in energy transition and sustainability.” - Rogier, former International Trainee based in Amsterdam.

The Vattenfall International Trainee Programme is the kickstart of your career within Vattenfall. Over the course of a year, you will combine meaningful work with structured development opportunities, networking, workshops and site visits across Vattenfall's business areas and locations. Each position comes with a competitive salary and excellent remuneration package. Read more about the elements of the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme here.

Application process

We welcome your application in English via the application button on this page. Please include an updated resume. When applying, you will fill out screening questions, including your motivation. No cover letter or motivation letter is needed. The deadline to apply is October 18th, 2026. Selection will start after the application period with online tests, followed by interviews between the end of October to end November.

jobs.title: Senior GenAI Engineer (UK)
jobs.description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

Pigment is seeking an experienced GenAI Engineer with a strong CS background and experience with Large Language Models (LLM) to join our innovative and fast-paced team.
In this role, you will work on cutting-edge NLP projects and play a crucial part in developing and refining our product. If you are passionate about machine learning, have a strong background in natural language processing, and thrive in a collaborative and high-impact environment, we'd love to hear from you!
 
What you will do :
 
- Work on bleeding edge multi-agents features. This includes the improvement of rolled-out features and the conception of new ones.
- Have the opportunity to work on the whole stack. The AI teams have frontend, backend (C# and python), infrastructure and CI skills
- Work on AI features built on top of the Pigment computation engine that provides determinism, auditability and data visualizations
- Work on AI features with an ambitious product vision, that are actively used, have a real world impact and are built to last (high test coverage - you can focus on building the next step, not chasing bugs)
 
🎧Listen to our podcast on Pigment’s GenAI team
📖Read more about our vision: Agentic AI for Data Analysis
 
#LI-GP1
#LI-REMOTE
 

Requierements
  • MS or Ph.D. in Computer Science, or experience writing production-grade code
  • Strong programming skills in Python, and/or C#, Java, nodejs, or equivalent
  • Hands-on experience on prompting large language models. It can be through the usage of vibe coding tools, or having implemented GenAI features
  • Knowledge about the recent developments of agents is a plus
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Product oriented. GenAI challenges are mainly about translating a user need into a simple technical solution
  • If you are passionate about Generative AI and want to work on a cutting-edge business planning platform, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity at Pigment.
  • Bonus: experience working with kubernetes
  • Bonus: experience building agents using langgraph
  • Bonus: experience building and shipping complex products on top of LLMs
  • Bonus: experience building evaluation pipelines

    • What you will get
  • Competitive package
  • Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth
  • The best health insurance with Alan Blue entirely free for you and your family 
  • Weekly Lunch and Lunch vouchers (Swile card) to cover your lunch breaks with total flexibility
  • Subscription to Egym Wellpass (ex-Gymlib) for full access to gyms, studios, and wellness spaces across France
  • Trust and flexible working hours
  • Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, San Francisco, Toronto, Paris, and London
  • High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions
  • Remote-friendly environment
    • We conduct background checks as part of our hiring process, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially.
     
    Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability,  sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We may process your personal data in accordance with our HR Data Protection Notice.

Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.description: ΤΟΝ ΣΧΕΔΙΑΣΜΟ, ΑΝΑΠΤΥΞΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΦΑΡΜΟΓΗ ΣΥΣΤΗΜΑΤΩΝ ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗΣ ISO,ΤΗΝ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΔΙΑΔΙΚΑΣΙΩΝ ΠΙΣΤΟΠΟΙΗΣΗΣ, ΤΗ ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ, ΤΗΝ ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΣΥΜΜΟΡΦΩΣΗΣ ΜΕ ΤΑ ΑΠΑΙΤΟΥΜΕΝΑ ΠΡΟΤΥΠΑ ΚΑΙ ΚΑΝΟΝΙΣΜΟΥΣ, ΤΗΝ ΠΡΑΓΜΑΤΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΕΠΙΤΟΠΙΩΝ ΕΠΙΣΚΕΨΕΩΝ ΣΕ ΓΕΩΡΓΟΚΤΗΝΟΤΡΟΦΟΥΣ ,ΤΗΝ ΠΑΡΟΧΗ ΣΥΜΒΟΥΛΕΥΤΙΚΗΣ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗΣ ΓΙΑ ΘΕΜΑΤΑ ΠΟΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ, ΔΙΑΔΙΚΑΣΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΜΜΟΡΦΩΣΗΣ, ΤΗ ΣΥΝΤΑΞΗ ΕΚΘΕΣΕΩΝ, ΑΡΧΕΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΣΧΕΤΙΚΗΣ ΤΕΚΜΗΡΙΩΣΗΣ , ΠΤΥΧΙΟ ΓΕΩΠΟΝΟΥ , ΤΕΧΝΟΛΟΓΟΥ ΓΕΩΠΟΝΟΥ, ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ ΜΕ ΧΡΟΝΙΚΑ ΠΕΡΙΘΩΡΙΑ, ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟΤΗΤΑ, ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑΚΕΣ ΔΕΞΙΟΤΗΤΕΣ, ΚΑΛΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ MS OFFICE, ΑΡΙΣΤΗ ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑ ΜΕ ΠΕΛΑΤΕΣ. , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , MARIA IOAKIM , mioakim@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). jobs.description: ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΑΝΑΠΤΥΞΗ ΤΟΥ ΥΦΙΣΤΑΜΕΝΟΥ ΠΕΛΑΤΟΛΟΓΙΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΕΥΡΕΣΗ ΝΕΩΝ ΣΥΝΕΡΓΑΣΙΩΝ.  ΟΡΓΑΝΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΚΤΕΛΕΣΗ ΚΑΘΗΜΕΡΙΝΟΥ ΠΡΟΓΡΑΜΜΑΤΟΣ ΕΠΙΣΚΕΨΕΩΝ ΣΕ ΠΕΛΑΤΕΣ ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΛΕΓΧΟΣ ΑΠΟΘΕΜΑΤΩΝ ΣΤΑ ΣΗΜΕΙΑ ΠΩΛΗΣΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΣΤΙΣ ΑΠΟΘΗΚΕΣ ΤΩΝ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ.  ΔΙΑΣΦΑΛΙΣΗ ΟΡΘΗΣ ΤΟΠΟΘΕΤΗΣΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΠΡΟΒΟΛΗΣ ΤΩΝ ΠΡΟΙΟΝΤΩΝ ΣΤΑ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΗΜΑΤΑ.  ΣΥΝΤΟΝΙΣΜΟΣ,ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΥΛΟΠΟΙΗΣΗΣ ΠΡΟΩΘΗΤΙΚΩΝ ΕΝΕΡΓΕΙΩΝ.  ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΕΝΗΜΕΡΩΣΗ ΓΙΑ ΚΑΙΝΟΥΡΙΑ ΠΡΟΙΟΝΤΑ, ΠΡΟΣΦΟΡΕΣ ΚΑΙ ΕΜΠΟΡΙΚΕΣ ΕΝΕΡΓΕΙΕΣ.  ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗ ΔΙΑΔΙΚΑΣΙΩΝ ΕΠΙΣΤΡΟΦΗΣ ΠΡΟΙΟΝΤΩΝ (ΕΛΕΓΧΟΣ, ΚΑΤΑΧΩΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΙΑ ΠΑΡΑΛΑΒΗΣ) ΚΑΤΑΧΩΡΗΣΗ ΠΑΡΑΓΓΕΛΙΩΝ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ ΜΕΣΩ ΤΟΥ ΕΤΑΙΡΙΚΟΥ ΣΥΣΤΗΜΑΤΟΣ ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗ ΕΙΣΠΡΑΞΕΩΝ ΣΥΜΦΩΝΑ ΜΕ ΤΗΝ ΠΙΣΤΩΤΙΚΗ ΠΟΛΙΤΙΚΗ ΤΗΣ ΕΤΑΙΡΕΙΑΣ  , ΚΑΤΟΧΟΣ ΑΔΕΙΑΣ ΟΔΗΓΗΣΗΣ(MANUAL). ΑΡΙΣΤΕΣ ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑΚΕΣ & ΟΡΓΑΝΩΤΙΚΕΣ ΔΕΞΙΟΤΗΤΕΣ. ΑΝΑΛΗΨΗΣ ΠΡΩΤΟΒΟΥΛΙΩΝ & ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗ ΕΥΘΥΝΩΝ ΓΝΩΣΗ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΝΙΚΩΝ ΥΠΟΛΟΓΙΣΤΩΝ.  ΠΡΟΥΠΗΡΕΣΙΑ ΣΕ ΠΑΡΟΜΟΙΑ ΘΕΣΗ, ΙΔΑΝΙΚΑ ΣΤΟΝ ΚΛΑΔΟ ΤΡΟΦΙΜΩΝ, ΘΑ ΘΕΩΡΗΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΠΡΟΣΘΕΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ.  , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , SOPHIA PAPETTA , spapetta@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). ΣΥΛΛΟΓΗ ΧΡΗΣΙΜΟΠΟΙΗΜΕΝΩΝ ΣΚΕΥΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ ΤΩΝ ΤΡΑΠΕΖΙΩΝ ΚΑΘ' ΟΛΗ ΤΗ ΔΙΑΡΚΕΙΑ ΤΗΣ ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗΣ. ΣΥΝΕΡΓΑΣΙΑ ΜΕ ΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΩΠΙΚΟ ΤΗΣ ΚΟΥΖΙΝΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΤΟΥ ΜΠΑΡ ΓΙΑ ΤΗΝ ΟΜΑΛΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΓΚΑΙΡΗ ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ. ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΟΛΩΝ ΤΩΝ ΚΑΝΟΝΩΝ ΥΓΙΕΙΝΗΣ , ΚΑΛΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΗΣ Η/ΚΑΙ ΑΓΓΛΙΚΗΣ ΓΛΩΣΣΑΣ. ΕΥΓΕΝΕΙΑ, ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟ ΠΝΕΥΜΑ. ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ ΣΕ ΓΡΗΓΟΡΟ ΚΑΙ ΑΠΑΙΤΗΤΙΚΟ ΠΕΡΙΒΑΛΛΟΝ. jobs.title: Vernepleier/sosionom til tverrfaglig ruspoliklinikk - lengre vikariat
jobs.description:
Eikaklinikken søker en vernepleier eller sosionom til et lengre vikariat med snarlig tiltredelse.

Vikariatet er knyttet til fravær i personalgruppen. Vi har kjent behov for vikar fra våren 2027, og det er derfor gode muligheter for et sammenhengende vikariat over en lengre periode.

Hva vi ser etter

Stillingen innebærer selvstendig oppfølging av pasienter fra oppstart, og vi søker derfor en kandidat som allerede har solid erfaring fra målgruppen og god kjennskap til tjenesteapparatet i Oslo.

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • autorisasjon som vernepleier eller bachelor i sosialt arbeid

  • minimum tre års relevant erfaring fra arbeid med målgruppen

  • god kjennskap til Oslo kommunes organisering, bydelstjenester og aktuelle tilbud innen rus, psykisk helse og sosiale tjenester

  • erfaring fra tverrfaglig og tverretatlig samarbeid med kommunale tjenester i Oslo

  • erfaring fra samarbeid med spesialisthelsetjenesten

Vi legger særlig vekt på at du:

  • arbeider selvstendig og strukturert

  • gode evner til å finne løsninger

  • har gode relasjonelle ferdigheter

  • klarer å kombinere fleksibilitet med tydelige profesjonelle rammer

  • har god rolleforståelse og faglig dømmekraft

  • samarbeider godt med pasienter, kolleger og eksterne tjenester

  • trives i en liten virksomhet hvor ansatte må ta ansvar og bidra på tvers

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som vernepleier/sosionom vil du inngå i klinikkens tverrfaglige team og ha ansvar for oppfølging av egne pasienter. Oppfølgingen kan blant annet bestå av samtaler på klinikken, telefonkontakt, hjemmebesøk, aktivitet, følge til avtaler og samarbeid med andre tjenester. Kontaktperson har en sentral rolle i å koordinere oppfølgingen og bidra til tydelig ansvars- og rollefordeling rundt pasienten.

Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være:

  • individuell oppfølging og kontaktpersonansvar

  • kartlegging av pasientens behov og ressurser

  • samarbeid med leger og øvrige ansatte ved klinikken

  • samarbeid med kommunale tjenester, NAV og spesialisthelsetjenesten

  • deltakelse i ansvarsgrupper og tverrfaglige møter

  • dokumentasjon og annet faglig arbeid knyttet til pasientoppfølging

  • bidra til fagutvikling og kvalitetsarbeid ved klinikken

Vi tilbyr

  • en faglig variert arbeidshverdag med stor grad av selvstendighet og ansvar

  • arbeid i et lite, tverrfaglig miljø med korte beslutningsveier

  • mulighet til å arbeide tett og langsiktig med en kompleks pasientgruppe, med stort faglig handlingsrom og tett samarbeid mellom lege-, helse- og sosialfaglig kompetanse

  • ordinær arbeidstid på dagtid

  • lønn etter avtale

  • pensjonsordning i DNB med 4 % innskudd

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Eikaklinikken er en tverrfaglig klinikk for mennesker med rusmiddelproblemer og sammensatte helse- og livsutfordringer. Mange av våre pasienter har behov for langvarig, fleksibel og koordinert oppfølging, ofte i samarbeid med flere deler av hjelpeapparatet. Vi arbeider helhetlig og individuelt, med utgangspunkt i den enkeltes behov, mål og livssituasjon. Oppfølgingen skjer i tverrfaglige team bestående av leger, sykepleiere, sosialfaglig personell og miljøpersonale, og kan omfatte samtaler, praktisk støtte, hjemmebesøk, følge til avtaler og koordinering med kommunale tjenester, NAV og spesialisthelsetjenesten. Vi legger stor vekt på kontinuitet, tilgjengelighet, relasjon og tydelig ansvarsfordeling rundt den enkelte pasient.
