jobs.title: Enhetschef till socialtjänsten
jobs.description:
Ref: 20261870



Är du en engagerad och driven ledare som vill vara med och utveckla en verksamhet som gör skillnad för Malmöborna? Vi söker nu en enhetschef till avdelningen IFO Utredning Vuxna, där du får möjlighet att leda och utveckla verksamheten tillsammans med engagerade kollegor.

Arbetsuppgifter

I denna roll som enhetschef leder du fyra sektioner med fyra sektionschefer och omkring 60 medarbetare . Enheten ansvarar för att bedriva myndighetsutövning inom socialtjänst med inriktning på ekonomiskt bistånd och insatser för hemlösa personer. Du har ansvar för verksamhet, ekonomi och arbetsmiljö och ett övergripande ansvar för att driva och utveckla verksamheten.

Uppdraget riktar sig till några av samhällets mest utsatta Malmöbor, där ekonomisk utsatthet ofta kombineras med exempelvis hemlöshet och andra komplexa sociala utmaningar. I uppdraget ingår att leda en arbetsgrupp som bedriver stadens vräkningsförebyggande arbete och en verksamhet som bedriver arbete enligt metoden IPS (Individual placement and support) för personer som står mycket långt ifrån arbetsmarknaden.

En viktig del av rollen är att utveckla verksamheten utifrån förändringar i lagstiftning och nationella reformer, bland annat kopplat till bidragsreformen och samsjuklighetsreformen. Du omsätter förändrade krav och förutsättningar till tydliga arbetssätt och skapar förutsättningar för verksamheten att möta framtidens behov. Du arbetar nära dina chefskollegor med liknande uppdrag och förväntas aktivt bidra till ett gemensamt arbete, där ni tillsammans ser till helheten och skapar förutsättningar för en sammanhållen verksamhet.

I grunden handlar uppdraget om att leda en verksamhet som bedriver myndighetsutövning med hög kvalitet, rättssäkerhet och ett professionellt bemötande. Du säkerställer en hög ansvarsförmåga och servicenivå med Malmöbons bästa i fokus och skapar förutsättningar för medarbetarna att göra ett kvalificerat arbete för målgruppen.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har:

    Socionomexamen eller annan likvärdig universitets-/högskoleutbildning
    Erfarenhet av att ha arbetat som chef inom kommunal socialtjänst med ansvar för socialt arbete och myndighetsutövning med inriktning mot vuxna personer
    Erfarenhet av arbete med ekonomiskt bistånd, hemlöshet, skadligt bruk och beroende samt våld i nära relation, antingen genom direkt arbete inom området eller genom att ha lett verksamheter som arbetar med dessa frågor.
    Goda kunskaper om aktuell lagstiftning och förändringar till följd av bidragsreform och samsjuklighetsreform
    Förmåga att kommunicera väl på svenska i både tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har:

    Erfarenhet av att arbeta med utveckling, förändring och kvalitetsarbete
    Erfarenhet av samverkan med externa aktörer som t.ex. Region Skåne, Försäkringskassan och Kriminalvården.

Vi söker dig som är en trygg och kommunikativ ledare med god systemförståelse och erfarenhet av att arbeta i en politiskt styrd organisation. Du har god datavana och erfarenhet av digitala verksamhetssystem. Du uttrycker dig väl i tal och skrift och har förmåga att förklara, informera och vägleda medarbetare och kollegor. Du är utvecklingsinriktad, modig och positiv och motiveras av att driva arbetet framåt, även när förutsättningarna förändras. Samtidigt är du noggrann och angelägen om att arbetet håller god kvalitet.

Du är en god samarbetspartner som har lätt för att bygga och underhålla förtroendefulla relationer. Du ser samarbete som en förutsättning för att lyckas i uppdraget och arbetar aktivt för att skapa samverkan på olika nivåer – inom den egna verksamheten, mellan olika delar av organisationen och över organisationsgränser. Du tar initiativ till samarbeten och ser värdet i att tillsammans med andra hitta gemensamma lösningar. Genom att involvera relevanta aktörer bidrar du till att möta komplexa behov och skapa bättre förutsättningar för Malmöborna.

Om arbetsplatsen

Enheterna inom avdelning IFO Utredning Vuxna arbetar med socialt arbete och kvalificerat utredningsarbete som präglas av bra bemötande, välgrundade beslut och hög rättssäkerhet. Hos oss möter du en varierad social problematik och vårt uppdrag är att arbeta för att motivera och stimulera den enskildes möjligheter till egen försörjning, ett hållbart boende och ett självständigt liv. Vi har ett teambaserat arbetssätt där alla medarbetare tar ansvar för helheten.

Socialtjänsten står inför ett stort förändringstryck, inte minst till följd av ny lagstiftning, och förvaltningen utvecklar nu sin organisation för att möta framtidens behov och Malmöbornas krav på en modern och effektiv socialtjänst.

Som enhetschef inom Avdelning IFO Vuxen utredning ingår du i avdelningens ledningsgrupp tillsammans med avdelningschefen och sju andra enhetschefer. Tre enheter i avdelningen har huvudsaklig inriktning mot ekonomiskt bistånd och självförsörjning. Tre enheter har en inriktning mot samordnad biståndgivning för personer med sammansatt social problematik såsom försörjningshinder, hemlöshet, skadligt bruk och beroende och olika former somatisk eller psykisk sjukdom. Utöver detta finns en Mottagsenhet och en enhet för Stöd och samordning till avdelningens olika verksamheter. Tillsammans i ledningsgruppen sätter vi ut riktningen för verksamheten och lägger strategin för hur avdelningen ska genomföra sitt uppdrag och uppnå förvaltningens mål.

Vid Sveriges största arbetsmarknads- och socialförvaltning jobbar 2500 medarbetare varje dag för att stärka Malmöbor. Tillsammans med Malmöborna vill vi öka möjligheterna till egen försörjning, minska hemlöshet, bidra till att barn och unga ska få bra uppväxtvillkor och verka för att nyanlända ska få goda förutsättningar. Sök jobb hos oss, du kommer att göra skillnad.

Information om tjänsten

Anställningsform: Vikariat 1 år

Omfattning: Heltid

Antal tjänster: 1

Tillträde: 1 december eller enligt överenskommelse

Övrigt

Förstaintervjuer hålls 14 och 21 oktober på eftermiddagen.

Andraintervjuer hålls 29 oktober på eftermiddagen. Samtliga intervjuer äger rum på Kungsgatan 13.

Dina svar på urvalsfrågorna blir en viktig del i vårt urvalsarbete.

Malmö stad strävar efter att medarbetarna ska representera den mångfald som finns i vår stad. Vi välkomnar därför sökande som kan bidra till att vi som arbetsgivare kan uppfylla Malmöbornas behov.

Innan anställning erbjuds behöver du visa upp examensbevis från efterfrågad utbildning och id-handling: pass eller nationellt id-kort.

jobs.title: Business Controller needed!
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about combining finance, technology, and business to shape the future of sustainable transport? We are now looking for an experienced Business Controller to support strategic decision-making within Battery & Charging at our client. Join a dynamic team where your financial expertise can help drive business performance and the development of future solutions.

About the position

Perido are looking for an experienced Business Controller who wants to play a key role in supporting Battery & Charging within our client’s organization. The company is a world-leading supplier of transport solutions and together with partners and customers, they are driving the transition to a sustainable transport system. As part of the team, you will interact daily with engineering leaders, project managers, and finance colleagues across the company, giving you a broad network and excellent opportunities for professional development. The position is located at the company's headquarters in Södertälje.

Your daily tasks

In this role, you will act as a trusted Business Partner to R&D leaders, providing financial insights that support strategic decision-making and contribute to the successful development of future battery and charging solutions. The position includes a variety of ongoing responsibilities within finance and controlling, such as:

    Financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting
    Support decision-making through financial analysis, business cases, and scenario assessments
    KPI follow-up, reporting, and presentations
    Contribute to the development of future controlling processes, methods, and tools across company

You will report to the Head of R&D Controlling Battery & Charging and serve as a trusted Business Partner to R&D leaders, contributing to strategic decision-making, financial steering, and business performance as an active member of global management teams.

Your characteristics

To succeed in this role, you are analytical, structured, and business-oriented, with a strong curiosity and a genuine interest in understanding the business behind the numbers. You are eager to learn about products, technology, operations, and the key drivers behind successful R&D organizations. As a confident communicator, you enjoy collaborating with stakeholders across different functions and levels. You take a proactive and solution-oriented approach, always looking for ways to solve challenges, improve processes, and create value through teamwork.

Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!

Qualifications:

    Master’s degree in Economics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a related field
    At least 5 years of experience in Business Controlling
    An interest in electrification, battery technologies, and the transformation of the commercial vehicle industry
    Proven ability to translate financial data into actionable insights and drive business performance in a structured and analytical way
    Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and management teams in a complex and international environment
    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decisions across both finance and operational functions
    Excellent analytical and digital capabilities, including advanced skills in Excel, Power BI, and PowerPoint
    High integrity, curiosity, and an interest in understanding products, technology, operations, and the key business drivers behind successful R&D organizations

jobs.title: Human Resources Specialist
jobs.description:
About the position

Are you an HR professional looking to take the next step in your career? We are looking for an HR Specialist to join our Human Resources team at our manufacturing site in Mullsjö.

In this role, you will support managers and employees throughout the employee lifecycle and contribute to efficient, compliant, and business-focused HR processes. You will provide HR support to approximately 260 employees and their managers and work closely with the HR Manager and HR Remuneration Expert, as well as managers, employees, union representatives, occupational health providers, and external partners.

The role reports to the HR Manager.

You will have the opportunity to develop within employee relations, labour law, compensation and benefits, and HR process improvement while working alongside experienced HR professionals. This is an excellent opportunity to take on greater responsibility, broaden your HR expertise, and continue developing within the profession.

Responsibilities

    Provide day-to-day HR support and guidance to managers and employees.
    Coordinate HR processes throughout the employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, and offboarding.
    Support employee relations matters and advise managers on HR-related topics.
    Coordinate rehabilitation, workplace adjustments, and return-to-work processes in collaboration with managers and occupational health providers, including administration and follow-up in relevant systems.
    Support collaboration with union representatives and help ensure compliance with Swedish labour law, collective agreements, and company policies.
    Maintain employee data and HR documentation, ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, GDPR compliance, and high data quality.
    Support payroll and benefits administration in collaboration with the HR Remuneration Expert, including providing backup support when required.
    Support performance management, employee development, and engagement initiatives.
    Prepare HR reports, KPIs, and analyses to support business and HR needs.
    Identify opportunities for improvement and contribute to the continuous development and digitalization of HR processes.
    Participate in HR projects, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives.  

Requirements

    Relevant education in Human Resources, such as a Bachelor's degree or a YH qualification.
    A few years of experience in operational HR, preferably within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
    Good knowledge of Swedish labour law and collective agreements.
    Experience working with HR systems and digital HR tools such as SuccessFactors, Hogia, and MedHelp.
    Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
    Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
    Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and an analytical mindset.
    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications  

    Experience with payroll administration.
    Experience with employee benefits or compensation-related matters.

Who You Are

You are a service-minded and proactive HR professional who enjoys supporting managers and employees in a practical and business-oriented way.

You take ownership of your work, build trust through professionalism and integrity, and thrive in a collaborative environment. You are organized, solution-oriented, and comfortable balancing operational HR responsibilities with continuous improvement initiatives.

What we offer

At Kongsberg Automotive, you will join an international industrial company where people and business performance go hand in hand.

You will have the opportunity to work broadly across the HR field, develop your expertise, and collaborate with colleagues both locally and globally. We offer a supportive work environment, competitive benefits, occupational pension, a wellness allowance, and additional benefits under the Swedish Engineering Industries Agreement (Teknikavtalet)

Application / Contact

Please register your CV/resume and cover letter.

jobs.title: Betekenisvol werk in de (gehandicapten)zorg
jobs.description:
Grensarbeid maakt bekend : open sollicitatie voor functies in de zorg: Betekenisvol werk in de (gehandicapten)zorg.

Wie ben jij? En waar ben je naar op zoek? Wij willen jouw unieke talenten benutten en jou in je kracht zetten. Van daaruit zoeken wij samen met jou naar een passende baan!

Bij Radar geloven we in het zien van de hele persoon. Wat we daarmee bedoelen? Dat je niet alleen kijkt wat iemand nodig heeft, maar vooral wat iemand kan en in zich heeft. Zo kijken we naar onze cliënten, maar ook naar onze collega’s.

Heb je al de nodige ervaring in de (gehandicapten)zorg en weet je precies wat je zoekt? Of sta je nog aan het begin van een (nieuwe) loopbaan en weet je nog niet precies wat je wil?

Inge en Faye van de afdeling recruitment kijken graag samen met jou op welke plek jouw talenten het best tot hun recht komen. Laat ons weten waar jij naar op zoek bent!

Wie zijn onze cliënten?

Bij Radar geloven we dat je je gelukkiger voelt, als je iets voor een ander kunt betekenen. We verbinden cliënten met medewerkers en familieleden. Met vrienden en verenigingen. En met de buurt of wijk waarin ze wonen. Zo bouwen we netwerken om hen heen met mensen die er voor elkaar willen zijn, op welke manier dan ook.

Onze cliënten hebben een licht, matige of ernstige (verstandelijke) beperking, autismespectrumstoornis of een ontwikkelingsachterstand. Wij geloven in een leven vol mogelijkheden, en daarom bieden wij ondersteuning in elke levensfase. Of het nu gaat om wonen, werken, leren of vrije tijd, wij staan klaar om de cliënt te helpen zijn of haar leven op een unieke manier vorm te geven.

Welke functies vind je bij ons?

Bij Radar hebben we verschillende zorgfuncties waarin jij voor onze cliënten het verschil maakt. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan:

Locatie-assistent
Ondersteuner
Begeleider
Persoonlijk begeleider
Gespecialiseerd begeleider

Ook hebben wij functies binnen Radar die indirect een bijdrage leveren aan de zorg. Denk aan administratieve functies, functies op de afdeling HRM, Finance & Control en Facilitaire zaken.

jobs.title: Persoonlijk Begeleider Meezenbroek
jobs.description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor de Stichting Radar een persoonlijk begeleider Meezenbroek.

Dit is hoe jouw werkdag uit ziet

De wekker gaat, je vertrekt naar werk. Jouw werkdag start vroeg met het wekken en verzorgen van onze cliënten. In totaal wonen 20 ouder wordende cliënten met een beperking op onze woonvorm. Na het wekken, volgt het ontbijt. Een moment van samen zijn. Cliënten die naar de dagbesteding extern gaan, help je op weg.

Om 9:00 uur verzamelen jij en je collega's zich op kantoor voor de overdracht. Jullie bespreken de bijzonderheden van de afgelopen dagen en vandaag. Op Meezenbroek is een dagbesteding op locatie. De dagbesteding medewerker start na de overdracht met opstarten van de dagbesteding en jij bent bezig met telefoontjes, post, afspraken begeleiden of gewoon een goed gesprek met een van de cliënten. Je houdt je ook bezig met de informele zorg. Jij bent de schakel tussen onze locatie en de wijk en regelt wat de wijk kan betekenen voor onze cliënten.

Rond 12:00 uur is het lunchtijd. Samen met de cliënten lunch je aan tafel. Er wordt gekletst en soms gewoon in stilte genoten. Na de lunch gaan de cliënten verder met de activiteit op de dagbesteding. Jij gaat verder met de telefoontjes, post, het begeleiden van afspraken en de één-op-één contactmomenten met cliënten. Rond 16:00 uur komen de cliënten die extern naar de dagbesteding zijn geweest terug, vaak met verhalen en blije gezichten.

Je werkt in een team van 23 collega's, waaronder ook vrijwilligers en stagiaires. Gedurende de dag kom je je collega's regelmatig tegen en door het portofoonsysteem sta je altijd met elkaar in contact.

Aan het einde van de middag neemt het avonddienst team de dienst over. Zij koken en eten samen met de cliënten en collega's. Er is tijd om met elkaar in gesprek te gaan en de dag te bespreken. Daarna volgt de avondzorg. Sommige cliënten hebben alleen aansturing tot verzorging nodig, anderen hulp bij het wassen. De dag wordt afgesloten met een gezamenlijk koffiemoment met de cliënten in een huiselijke sfeer.

Voor het einde van elke dienst wordt afgestemd met collega's en worden de werkzaamheden gerapporteerd.

Omdat onze cliënten 24/7 begeleiding nodig hebben, werk je in wisselende diensten, inclusief weekenden en slaapdiensten. We vinden het belangrijk om rekening te houden met jouw privé situatie. In samenspraak met het team stemmen we af hoe we de beste begeleiding kunnen bieden en rekening kunnen houden met jou als individu.

Samen bouwen we aan een sterk team waarin we van elkaar leren, elkaar ondersteunen en onze cliënten de beste zorg bieden. Word jij onze nieuwe collega?

  • Een diploma van een opleiding in sector zorg en welzijn op minimaal mbo-niveau 3. Denk aan SPW, MMZ, verzorgende IG, verpleegkundige, social work enz
  • Affiniteit met de ouder wordende cliënt
  • Een out of the box denker
  • Actief in het betrekken van de buurt en wijk bij de zorg voor onze cliënten
  • Positief, teamspeler
  • Snel schakelen in verschillende ondersteuningsvragen
  • Sociale vaardigheden: tact, inlevingsvermogen en motivatiekracht
  • Regie voeren bij opstellen, uitvoeren, bijstellen en reflecteren op ondersteuningsplannen (vanaf mbo-niveau 4)
  • Lef, eigenaarschap en nieuwsgierigheid
  • Bereid tot het werken in een onregelmatig dienstrooster

jobs.title: Data-analist
jobs.description:
Grensarbeid zoelt voor de gemeente Sittard-Geleen een data-analist.

Als Data-analist/scientist bij de gemeente Sittard-Geleen werk je aan thema’s die je dagelijks om je heen ziet: leefbaarheid in wijken, tevredenheid van inwoners, duurzaamheid, verkeer, zorg en nog veel meer. Je helpt collega’s én bestuurders om betere keuzes te maken op basis van jouw analyses, dashboards en adviezen. Denk hierbij aan: inzicht bieden in het leerlingenverloop en het ontdekken van trends, indicatoren opstellen om buurten en wijken met elkaar te vergelijken en denk je mee over het logisch plaatsen van ondergrondse afvalcontainers in de stad.

Je werkt aan uiteenlopende vraagstukken, waarbij jouw analytische skills en frisse blik helemaal tot hun recht komen. Je draait mee in onderzoeken en projecten — van het analyseren van inwonerpeilingen tot het bouwen van dashboards over leefbaarheid of mobiliteit. Je werkt samen met beleidsmakers, data-engineers, geo-specialisten en andere analisten. Je bouwt dataproducten van begin (ruwe data of vragen van collega’s) tot eind (presentatie, publicatie of visualisatie). Zo draag jij bij aan een slimmere, datagedreven gemeente.

Je komt terecht in een enthousiast datateam met: Data-analisten, Geo-informatie analisten, Data engineers en Business informatie analisten.

Waar ga je mee aan de slag?

  • Je analyseert en combineert data uit verschillende bronnen over de stad, buurten en inwoners om nieuwe inzichten en verbanden zichtbaar te maken — van inwonerpeilingen tot het gebruik van voorzieningen
  • Je maakt dashboards en datavisualisaties in Power BI die collega’s helpen betere keuzes te maken
  • Je helpt mee met het opzetten en uitvoeren van onderzoeken, waaronder het opstellen, controleren en analyseren van vragenlijsten
  • Je zorgt voor het (door)ontwikkelen van veelgestelde vragen en werkt mee aan voorspellende datamodellen
  • Je krijgt de ruimte om te experimenteren met tools of andere technieken die jou interesseren
  • Je helpt mee om data op een duidelijke en toegankelijke manier beschikbaar te maken voor collega’s en inwoners.
  • Je hebt HBO werk- en denkniveau en affiniteit met data, onderzoek of digitalisering
  • Je bent proactief: je ziet kansen en mogelijkheden, neemt initiatief en wacht niet af tot iemand je vertelt wat er moet gebeuren
  • Je werkt secuur en gestructureerd: je leest goed, volgt stappen zorgvuldig en hebt oog voor details, fouten en inconsistenties
  • Je vindt het leuk om dingen uit te pluizen, verbanden te leggen en daar iets moois van te maken (zoals een dashboard)
  • Ervaring met Power BI, SQL of Python/R is een pluspunt
  • Je denkt in oplossingen, stelt slimme vragen en durft met een frisse blik naar bestaande processen te kijken
  • Je communiceert makkelijk met mensen van verschillende afdelingen en weet je verhaal goed over te brengen
  • Je wilt bijdragen aan een gemeente die eerlijk, slim en mensgericht werkt — met behulp van data.

jobs.title: PhD student in energy engineering
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.

The Division of Energy Science is seeking a doctoral student in Energy Engineering. Your research will focus on modelling and analysing sustainable forest-based fuels for gas turbines and their potential role(s) in the transition to a fossil-free energy system.

Energy Engineering is a part of the Division of Energy Science in the Department of Engineering Science and Mathematics, which is a subject-wide department with many successful research groups and recognized educational programs. In Energy Engineering, we have a close collaboration with industries and organizations in both research projects and student projects. The research is of international quality, and we collaborate with researchers around the world. Within the area of Energy system analysis, the research is targeted at the transition to a sustainable future, including but not limited to, studies related to new technologies, process integration and policy measures, as well as overall energy system aspects at local, national and supranational levels. We collaborate interdisciplinary with several social science subjects.The research is based on applying the IEA-ETSAP TIMES model framework. The TIMES research group has a strong national and international reputation and is a sought-after partner in academic and public contexts. The research includes energy system optimization models, sustainable energy and climate transition, scenario analysis, and applied system analysis.



Subject description

Energy Engineering concerns the development of technologies and processes in order to build a sustainable energy supply. The research focuses on bioenergy technologies and energy efficiency in industry and society.



Project description

The project is part of the Swedish national competence centre CESTAP (Competence cEntre in Sustainable Turbine Fuels for Aviation and Power) (phase 2), which is jointly funded by the Swedish Energy Agency, academic partners, and industry. This PhD project will focus on exploring potential roles of sustainable forest-based fuels for gas turbines in mobile (mainly aviation) and stationary (for power) applications. The research will apply an energy systems perspective, considering developments across the energy system, future need for energy and electricity, climate and other environmental goals, resource limitations, etc.To identify cost-efficient pathways towards a future fossil-free and resource-efficient Swedish energy system, the PhD candidate will first develop a module for the existing TIMES-Sweden model, and thereafter, apply the model to analyse different feedstocks, biofuel production routes, and turbine applications under different scenarios.



Duties

A PhD position means being part of a research group where you, in collaboration with others, carry out scientific research work. You also take academic courses (some mandatory, some of your own choice), and you may try teaching (as part of departmental duties).

The research work will include, for example:

    Collect and analyze relevant data and information.
    Develop and use TIMES-based models.
    Scenario analysis and communicate results from the analyses.
    Write scientific journal articles both individually and in collaboration with others.
    Present research results nationally and internationally.
    Active participation in seminars within the research group.
    Support less experienced TIMES model users (towards the second half of the PhD).

Departmental duties include teaching assistantship in two undergraduate courses, Sustainable Energy Systems and Environmental Systems Analysis, as well as supervising master’s student projects within the master’s program in Energy Engineering.



Qualifications

MSc or an equivalent degree in Environment and Energy, Physical Resource Theory, Operational Research, or similar areas. Advanced knowledge of written and spoken English is required. You should be able to communicate both within the academic community and with external industry stakeholders.

Below are considered important merits:

    Understanding of energy systems and their development, particularly at national level.
    Knowledge and skills in energy engineering.
    Basic knowledge and understanding of modelling and quantitative analytical methods.
    Ability to approach, formulate, and analyse scientific problems.

Additional merits for this specific position:

    Experience of modelling energy systems, particularly at the national level.
    Experience of optimisation modelling and/or other mathematical models.
    Experience in scenario analysis, related to climate or other environmental goals, or energy transitions.
    Knowledge of sustainable energy transitions.
    Ability to understand Swedish and make yourself understood in a conversation in Swedish, as some information is only available in Swedish and knowledge exchange will occur in a Swedish setting with Swedish industry stakeholders.

For further information about the specific doctoral program:

Technical Sciences - Luleå University of Technology (ltu.se)



Information



Employment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other departmental duties may be added with a maximum of 20%. Placement: Luleå, Sweden. Starting: by agreement (no earlier than January 1st 2027).

For each position, a preliminary salary range is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role.

For further information, please contact:Anna Krook Riekkola, Professor, (+46) 920-492552 anna.krook-riekkola@ltu.se

jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Facility Project Manager for a company in Gothenburg. Start is ASAP, 6 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg.

Assignment description

Facility Project Manager/Facility Management Lead

The Facility Management Team is responsible for overseeing and optimizing the organization’s facility portfolio, ensuring efficient operations, cost effectiveness, and a high-quality working environment. This role serves as a key point of contact for facility-related matters, including negotiations, contract management, landlord relations, and the strategic development of workplace solutions.

﻿

Role and Responsibilities:

Facility Contract Management: Manage assigned facility-related contracts, including existing agreements and potential new engagements. Ensure contracts are aligned with organizational needs and deliver value in terms of service, cost, and quality. Monitor and steer contract durations proactively. Will be asked to lead negotiations, terminations, and subleasing opportunities, as well as any required contractual modifications.

Landlord and External Interface: Be an interface with landlords and external stakeholders. Maintain a comprehensive overview of assigned lease agreements and ensure strong, professional relationships are upheld.

Facility Utilization and Optimization: Support the team to continuously monitor and evaluate facility usage. Identify trends and opportunities to enhance the working environment while improving space efficiency and reducing operational costs.

Strategic Improvement Initiatives: Lead initiatives aimed at improving workplace functionality, employee experience, and cost performance within the facility domain.

Project Leadership: Lead facility-related changes and development projects, ensuring timely delivery, stakeholder alignment, and successful implementation. Be actively involved in office updates and relocations.

Commercial & Asset Management: Support the disposal and management of facility assets (such as furniture and equipment. Maintaining existing assets are in good order and fit for purpose.

Governance, Safety & Compliance: Be part of the safety walks for assigned common office areas to ensure compliance and promote a safe working environment.

Insurance Portfolio Management: Support Head of Facility Management Team and the Company insurance broker to coordinate the GTEU insurance portfolio, ensuring coverage and compliance requirements are met.

﻿

Qualifications and skills required for the role

    

8-12+ years of experience in Facility Management, Engineering, Business Administration or related field

    

Knowledge of working in R&D and Design environments

    

Experience in budget management and cost management

    

Experience in negotiations and contract management

﻿

Personal attributes

    

Financial acumen and cost management

    

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

    

Great negotiation skills

    

Project management lead skills

    

Strong commercial awareness

    

Has a hands-on approach to finding solutions

    

Full Driving license required.

﻿

IT/SW requirements (if applicable)

Office 365 & Sharepoint, SAP knowledge is meritorious but not a must

This role requires fluency in English and Swedish.

This is a full-time consultant position in Gothenburg through Incluso. Start is ASAP, 6 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg.

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

jobs.title: Senior Group Accountant – IFRS & Consolidation
jobs.description:
The Group Accountant will be an important member of the Group Accounting team, contributing to accurate and timely consolidated financial reporting across the Group. The role supports the monthly, quarterly, and annual closing cycles and helps ensure that financial information provided to management, external stakeholders, and regulatory bodies is complete, reliable, and compliant.

The consultant will also help maintain consistent accounting practices throughout the organization, support consolidation and reporting activities, perform financial analysis, and contribute to the continuous improvement of accounting processes and controls.

Key Responsibilities

The consultant will:

    

Support monthly, quarterly, and annual Group closing and consolidation activities, including preparing, reviewing, and validating consolidation entries.

    

Work closely with subsidiaries and relevant internal functions to ensure complete, accurate, and timely financial reporting.

    

Perform financial analyses and prepare documentation supporting management, statutory, and external reporting.

    

Support the preparation of IFRS financial statements, including disclosures and notes for quarterly and annual reporting.

    

Maintain and validate data in the Group consolidation system, ensuring consistency across entities.

    

Support the development, implementation, and documentation of Group accounting principles, policies, and procedures.

    

Participate in initiatives aimed at improving Group accounting, financial reporting, consolidation processes, and related systems.

    

Liaise with auditors and coordinate supporting documentation, explanations, and audit evidence.

    

Identify opportunities to strengthen accounting processes, internal controls, reporting quality, and efficiency.

Competence Requirements

The consultant should have:

    

5–7 years of relevant finance experience, preferably from a global corporate accounting function and/or an audit firm, including 2–3 years of hands-on Group Accounting and financial reporting experience.

    

Previous experience with compliance and financial reporting for listed companies – mandatory.

    

Experience with SOX compliance and reporting requirements for U.S.-listed companies is considered an advantage.

    

A university degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or an equivalent field.

    

Strong knowledge of IFRS and a good understanding of Group consolidation principles.

    

Practical experience with financial reporting and monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing processes.

    

Strong Excel skills for financial analysis, reconciliations, and reporting.

    

Experience working with consolidation systems; previous experience with AARO is highly desirable.

    

Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Personal Profile

The consultant should be proactive, self-driven, and comfortable taking ownership of tasks and resolving issues independently. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills are important, as the role involves close collaboration across different entities and functions.

The successful consultant should also have a structured and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy and quality.

jobs.title: Pædagogisk assistent til vuggestue
jobs.description:
Børnehytten søger en dedikeret pædagogisk assistent til vores vuggestue.

Hvem er vi: 

Vi er en privat integreret daginstitution beliggende i hjertet af Kettinge. Vi er normeret til 12 vuggestuebørn og 29 børnehavebørn. Vi har tæt samarbejde med forældrebestyrelse og det lokale forenings- og forretningsliv.

Huset rummer nærhed, omsorg og sammenhold for børnene såvel som for kollegaerne. Vi har fokus på trivsel og tryghed og vægter derfor bl.a. forældrekontakten højt. Vi er gode til at arbejde sammen og spille hinanden gode i hverdagen. Grundet husets størrelse er der en naturlig god relation til børnene på tværs af stuerne og vi kan hurtigt træde til på alle stuer, hvis behovet opstår. 

Børnehytten støder op til en tidligere grusgrav, der nu fungerer som rekreativt område med bålhytte, naturlegeplads, kunstige søer med fisk og mange andre muligheder for udfoldelser med børnene. Derudover har vi vores egen legeplads der er opdelt i vuggestue og børnehave, hvor vi prioriterer at børnene kommer ud hver dag. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du nyder at være en del af udelivet uanset vind og vejr, da vores børn også elsker at hoppe i vandpytter, kigge på biller og finde regnorme.

I vuggestuen er værdien af tid central for vores pædagogiske arbejde. Tid til nærvær, tid til fordybelse og tid til at skabe små betydningsfulde øjeblikke der danner fundamentet for børnenes læring, udvikling, trivsel og dannelse. Vi har fokus på at skabe udviklende læringsmiljøer, hvor alle børn – uanset behov og forudsætning -har mulighed for at deltage i meningsfulde fællesskaber.

Vi forventer af dig:

Du er uddannet pædagogisk assistent og gerne med erfaring fra dagtilbudsområdet. Du er empatisk, omsorgsfuld og vægter arbejdet med relationer højt. Du er nysgerrig og legende i din tilgang til børnene og vægter tid, tillid og tryghed højt hos både store og små.

Du skal have en naturlig interesse og nysgerrighed på sproglig udvikling og brugen af det i hverdagen.

Du kan i samarbejde med dine kollegaer på stuen, planlægge aktiviteter og evaluere disse med udgangspunkt i den nye styrkede pædagogiske læreplan.

Du kan samarbejde med din kollegaer, om at vurdere børnenes trivsel og udvikling og ved behov iværksætte konkrete tiltag. Du skal kunne se det enkelte barn og bidrage til at udarbejde handleplaner, indstillinger, koordinere tværfagligt samarbejde med mere.

 

Om stillingen:

Vi tilbyder en ansættelse hurtigst mulig eller fra 1/11-26 i en 32 timers stilling efter gld. overenskomst.

Ansøgningsfrist: 23/9-26 Samtaler forventes afholdt i uge 40.

Send din ansøgning og CV til leder@boernehytten.dk

 

Kontakt gerne leder: Tinni eller souschef Stine - 53841514 - Man-Fredag kl. 9-15, for mere information.

jobs.description:

From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. In this role you will play a key role in:

Your profile

Application

jobs.description:
Haemme lounasravintolaamme iloista, ratkaisukeskeistä ja aurinkoisen asiakaspalvelutaidon omaavaa Asiakaspalvelupäällikköä.

Haemme tehtävään moniosaajaa, jolla on vahva ammattitaito ja ymmärrys sekä keittiön että salin toiminnoista. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat asiakaspalvelu, salaattien ja lämpimien lisäkkeiden valmistaminen, vitriini- ja salaattituotteiden valmistamista, kassatyöskentelyä, astiahuoltoa, inventointia, raaka-aineiden tilaamista ja sekä muita ravintoloan yleisiä tehtäviä. Työskentelet toimipisteessä yksin.

Toivomme, että sinulla on tehtävään sopiva koulutus ja vahva kokemus vastaavista tehtävistä. Odotamme, että olet asiakaspalvelu- ja myyntihenkinen, ja haluat olla mukana kehittämässä ravintolan toimintaa ja palvelua.

Sinulla löytyy intohimoa ja näkemystä hyvän ruoan ja palvelun tekemiseen sekä asiakaslähtöistä että taloudellista ajattelutapaa. Sinulla on myös loistavat vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot asiakkaiden kanssa toimimiseen. Sinulla on hyvä paineensietokyky, ja olet tottunut työskentelemään nopeasti muuttuvissa tilanteissa, kiireenkin keskellä. Pystyt kommunikoimaan asiakkaiden kanssa sujuvasti suomen ja englannin kielellä. Keittiötuntemus katsotaan eduksi. Edellytämme hygieniapassia.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja merkityksellisen työtehtävän, ja saat tueksesi lämminhenkisen ja välittävän työyhteisön. Innostumme teknologioista, jotka auttavat arjessamme, joten saat ammattitaitosi rinnalle myös nykyaikaiset työkalut. Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan omaan työhösi ja kehittämään ammattitaitoasi.

Lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle:

- monipuolisen päivätyön herkullisia makunautintoja hakevien asiakkaiden parissa
- osaamisen ja tehtävänmukaisen palkan, palkitsemme myös onnistumisista
- liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hierontaedun
- lakisääteistä laajemman työterveyshuollon 24/7
- työvaatteet ja työkenkätuen
- mahdollisuuden jatkuvaan kehittymiseen ja koulutuksiin

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa aluepäällikkö, yhteystiedot löydät ilmoituksen alaosasta.

Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä meille hakemuksesi sekä ansioluettelosi. Huomioithan, että aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana, ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Antell tekee aidosti hyvää! Antell tarjoaa herkullisia makunautintoja noin 60:ssä lounas- ja henkilöstöravintolassa ympäri Suomen. Arjen iloisten lounashetkien lisäksi tarjoamme asiakkaillemme ihania makuja ja elämyksiä kokouksissa ja muissa tilaisuuksissa. Haluamme olla mukana rakentamassa asiakkaidemme hyvinvointia. Osaamisemme ytimessä on monipuolinen, hyvää tekevä ja herkullinen ruoka. Syyskuusta alkaen olemme osa Sodexo-konsernia.

jobs.description:

The role sits between Product Development and Production, ensuring high-quality, timely, and well-planned footwear production from start to finish. Travel to production markets to assist with supplier onboarding and launches and to train local sourcing teams during industrialization and initial orders

    

Review bulk materials and samples with sourcing teams

    

Maintain product trackers and ensure completion of all critical production gates

    

Analyze CBDs and negotiate prices for core styles

    

Project-lead the quick-strike critical path and different approval gates

    

Manage our tooling budget, tooling ordering, amortizations, and follow-up

ARE YOU THE ONE?

We're looking for someone with most of the following:

    

5+ years of experience in footwear production/sourcing, including costing, materials, fit, wear, quality, and testing

    

At least 2 years of that experience within a brand

    

Strong analytical and negotiation skills

    

Organized and technical, with solid planning and forecasting ability

    

Able to balance several complex priorities running at once

    

Solution-oriented, with an uncompromising eye for product quality

    

Willing to travel to our production markets

jobs.title: Gruppledare för vuxengruppen inom IFO
jobs.description:
Individ och familjeomsorgen (IFO) i Smedjebacken har gjort en omorganisation och söker nu två gruppledare till verksamheten. Den här annonsen rör gruppledartjänsten för vuxengruppen.

Verksamheten består totalt av 20 medarbetare fördelat på tre grupper, en administrationsgrupp, barn- och familjegrupp och en vuxengrupp. Hela verksamheten leds av en verksamhetschef.

Vuxengruppen handlägger ärenden rörande ekonomiskt bistånd, skadligt bruk och beroende, våld i nära relation, sociala hyreskontrakt, dödsboärenden, insatser rörande aktivitetsplikten, fältarbete samt övrig vuxenärenden. Både myndighetsutövande personal och behandlande öppenvårdspersonal ingår i gruppen. Gruppen består av 8 tjänster, tre socialsekreterare ekonomiskt bistånd, en fältassistent, två behandlare, en socialsekreterare aktivitetsplikt och en socialsekreterare skadligt bruk och beroende.

Vi är en liten verksamhet som hjälps åt och stöttar varandra med fokus att få en sådana bra verksamhet som vi kan för medborgarna i Smedjebackens kommun! Hos oss får du möjlighet att tillsammans i en ledningsgrupp och med drivna medarbetare utveckla verksamheten utifrån nya Socialtjänstlagen.



Arbetsuppgifter

Som gruppledare leder, inspirerar och handleder du medarbetare i din grupp. Du fördelar ärenden och har regelbundna ärendegenomgångar med både myndighetsutövande personal och behandlare personal. Du medverkar och säkerställer att gruppen utför arbetsuppgifterna på ett rättssäkert sätt och med god kvalitet.

I din roll fungerar du som tillgängligt stöd där du arbetsleder, coachar och metodhandleder i det dagliga arbete. Rollen är en operativ roll samtidigt som det krävs ett strategiskt arbete tillsammans med verksamhetschefen och den andre gruppledarkollegan. I uppdraget ingår att du samarbetar med andra aktörer, både internt och externt. Du företräder även Familje- och utbildningsnämnden i Förvaltningsrätt, Tingsrätt och Kammarrätt. Du ska också föredra ärenden på Familje- och utbildningsnämndens individutskott.

Du ingår i ledningsgruppen som träffas en gång i veckan för att planera verksamheten, samordna arbetet och driva utvecklingsarbete tillsammans. Du är en viktig del i det systematiska kvalitetsarbetet och bidrar till att utveckla din grupps arbete såväl som hela verksamhetens arbete. Du bidrar till att utveckla arbetssätt och metoder utifrån verksamhetens behov, mål och utifrån gällande lagstiftning.

Kvalifikationer

    Du har en socionom eller annan beteendevetenskaplig utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer är likvärdig.
    Du behöver ha goda kunskaper inom Socialtjänstlagen och dess olika områden.
    Du har B-körkort.
    En god förmåga att uttrycka dig i svenska, tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av socialtjänst och av ledarskap i någon form.

Personliga egenskaper

Du är trygg och engagerad med förmåga att skapa delaktighet och engagemang i arbetsgruppen.

Du stöttar medarbetare i deras utveckling samtidigt som du skapar förutsättningar för dem att lyckas i sina uppdrag.

Du behöver vara strukturerad och noggrann och har förmåga att hålla många bollar i luften även fast tempot ibland kan vara högt.

Du tar egna initiativ, driver utvecklingsarbete framåt och arbetar självständigt inom ditt ansvarsområde.

Du behöver kunna samarbete både extern och internt.

Vi erbjuder

Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats i en välkomnande kommun med engagemang, trygghet och framtidstro. Vi tror på dialogen som verktyg för utveckling och värnar om korta beslutsvägar och prestigelöst förhållningssätt. Arbetsmiljöarbetet står i fokus där målsättningen är att arbetslivet ska vara hållbart, hälsosamt och tryggt för alla medarbetare. På smedjebacken.se kan du läsa mer om de förmåner vi erbjuder.  

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Intervjuer kommer ske löpande under ansökningstiden. Vid behov kan provanställning tillämpas



ÖVRIG INFORMATION

I samband med anställningserbjudande kommer kandidaten som erbjuds tjänsten att behöva styrka sitt medborgarskap. Det kan personen göra med pass alternativt personbevis tillsammans med ID-handling. Om du inte är medborgare i Sverige, EU, EES eller Schweiz måste du uppvisa att du har ett giltigt arbetstillstånd eller är undantag från skyldigheten att ha arbetstillstånd. Anställning kan ske först efter kontroll av arbetstillstånd, vilket krävs enligt utlänningsförordningen.

Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt all kontakt med annonsörer och bemanningsföretag i rekryteringsprocessen då urval av rekryteringskanaler redan bestämts för denna rekrytering.

Läs mer på smedjebacken.se om hur vi hanterar dina personuppgifter enligt GDPR. All rekrytering sker digitalt och via vår externa länk till rekryteringssystemet Webcruiter. Vid problem av registrering av CV var god kontakta http://https://talentech-support.freshdesk.com/sv-SE/support/login/new. Har du skyddade personuppgifter kontaktar du personalavdelningen genom kommunens växel så får du hjälp med din ansökan.

    Collaborate globally in a diverse and inclusive organization
    Contribute to solutions that shape the future of manufacturing

You develop innovative and scalable software solutions that bridge digital design and physical manufacturing. Working closely with global teams, you enable smarter and more efficient production through automation and advanced data-driven approaches.

    Develop automation solutions that support the journey toward lights-out production
    Translate product requirements into actionable shop floor solutions
    Contribute to methodologies for robust and state-of-the-art software solutions

jobs.title: Sykepleier/vernepleier - 100 % fast stilling, Bjørkelangen hjemmetjenester
jobs.description:
Fra dørmatte til dørmatte.

Som sykepleier i hjemmetjenesten får du ikke bare bruke kompetansen din – du får bruke den overalt! Du er både gjest i andres hjem, fagperson, problemløser, GPS-navigatør, teknologi-trygg og ikke minst - en person som møter folk der de lever livene sine: hjemme. Her er ingen dager like, og det er akkurat det som gjør det spennende.

Bjørkelangen hjemmetjeneste består av sykepleiere, vernepleier, hjelpepleiere, helsefagarbeidere og assistenter. Vi har hovedbase i Helsehuset og er en lystig gjeng som yter tjenester til innbyggere i alle aldre. Vi jobber målrettet og tverrfaglig med hverdagsmestring som arbeids-metode for at pasientene skal ha mulighet til å bo hjemme lengst mulig med god livskvalitet, og søkelys på egne ressurser. Vi har fokus på ernæringsoppfølging og kartlegger dette systematisk.

Internt i distriktet har vi organisert et demensteam hvor alle pasienter og brukere med en demensdiagnose/kognitiv svikt er samlet i egen gruppe. Med det formål å gi bedre kontinuitet og kvalitet på tjenesten for pasienter og deres pårørende. Teamet ledes av koordinerende sykepleier, hvor det jobber dedikerte hjelpepleiere og helsefagarbeidere.  Opplever du det meningsfullt å gi personer med demens og deres familie en bedre hverdag? Da er dette stillingen for deg.  

Aurskog Høland har i dag 4 hjemmetjenestedistrikt med Rømskog, Aurskog, Hemnes og Bjørkelangen. Vi i gang med en spennende omstrukturering hvor vi også skal se på distriktsinndeling og hvordan vi kan utnytte sykepleieressursene på beste måte på tvers av distrikter – for å møte framtidens utfordringer.  Er det en reise du har lyst til å være med på?

Vi har ledige følgende stilling:

  • Sykepleier/vernepleier - 100 % fast stilling med for tiden arbeid hver 3. helg. Mulighet for hinkehelg.
  • Ved innføring av Årsturnus vil det bli mulighet for langvakter.

Kommunen har gode betingelser i forbindelse med helgearbeid.

Sykepleiere må regne med å jobbe som ressurssvakt på kveld og helg. Som ressurssykepleier bidrar du til sømløs overgang mellom sykehus og hjem, deriblant mottak og kartlegging av nye pasienter. I tillegg er det punktinnsats i alle distrikter, hvilket gjør at du får mange spennende utfordringer.

Hvorfor hjemmetjenesten?
Fordi fremtidens helsetjeneste skjer der folk bor. Her kombineres høy faglighet med fleksibilitet, selvstendighet og stor påvirkningskraft. Du får en jobb med mening, og kollegaer som heier på deg med leder på laget.

Hva du faktisk kommer til å gjøre:

  • Være på farta – men aldri alene. Du jobber selvstendig, men har alltid erfarne og kloke kollegaer i ryggen.
  • Bruke hodet – og hjertet. Du får jobbe med hele pasientforløpet og være med å styrke hverdagsmestringen hos folk som virkelig trenger deg.
  • Teste nytt – vi er en arbeidsplass i utvikling og jobber aktivt med nye metoder og velferdsteknologi. Det betyr at du får være med på å forme fremtidens helsetjenester – mens du bruker de gode, gamle verktøyene dine også.
  • Jobbe turnus – med dagvakter, kveldsvakter og hver tredje helg. Turnusen planlegges i samarbeid med leder og tillitsvalgte – vi mener nemlig at livet utenfor jobb også teller.
  • Bruke hele deg – ingen dager er like i hjemmetjenesten. Du får brukt både fagkunnskap, dømmekraft og kreativitet – og du vil møte mennesker i hele spekteret av livssituasjoner.

Hva du må ha i sekken før du ruller ut på oppdrag:

  • Norsk autorisasjon som sykepleier eller vernepleier.
  • Fordel med relevant videreutdanning eller erfaring fra lignende tjeneste. 
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne, og du er ikke redd for å bruke stemmen din, hverken i dokumentasjon, eller i dialog med brukere og kolleger.
  • Søkere utenfor Skandinavia må ha bestått språkprøve på nivå B2.
  • Førerkort klasse B.

Hvem er du?

  • Tar initiativ og sprer god stemning, enten det er i lunsjen eller midt i en travel vakt.
  • Står stødig i rollen som sykepleier, og klarer å være både selvstendig og samarbeidsvillig på én gang.
  • Holder hodet kaldt når tempoet blir høyt, og hjertet varmt når det trengs mest.
  • Løsningsorientert. Tenker «hvordan kan vi få det til?» i stedet for «dette går ikke».
  • Er fleksibel og tilpasningsdyktig, for her skjer ting fort.
  • Bygger tillit og trygghet.

Hva du får igjen for innsatsen (bortsett fra takknemlige brukere og fantastiske kollegaer):

  • Lønn etter gjeldende tariff og avtaler.
  • Gode forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger.
  • IA-avtale.

Personlig egnethet blir vektlagt ved alle ansettelser.

Politiattest må framlegges før tiltredelse.

Vår visjon er muligheter, miljø og mangfold. Sammen gjør vi det umulige mulig, velger grønt først og lar ulikhetene forme vår felles fremtid. Vi har et ansvar for fortid, nåtid og skaper et samfunn i takt med sin samtid, og vi legger til rette for at Aurskog-Høland er et godt sted å leve, bo og arbeide.

Våre verdier som ligger til grunn for alt arbeid som skjer i kommunen er; Åpenhet, Tillit og Samhandling.

Vår kommune har fokus på et inkluderende arbeidsliv og er opptatt av at arbeidsstyrken skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet. Likeverd, likestilling og mangfold er en del av kulturen vår, og vi har nulltoleranse for diskriminerende praksis og oppførsel.  

Etter søknadsfristen vil det bli utarbeidet en offentlig søkerliste, i samsvar med Offentleglova § 25. Vi gjør oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkeren kan bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har bedt om ikke å bli oppført på den offentlige søkerlisten. Søkere vil bli varslet i forkant dersom anmodning om unntak fra offentlighet ikke tas til følge. 

Alle attester/tjenestebevis og vitnemål må lastes opp sammen med søknad og CV i rekrutteringsportalen, EasyCruit innen søknadsfristen. Har du utdanning fra utlandet legger du ved godkjenning fra HK-dir. https://hkdir.no/utdanning-fra-utlandet. 

Ønskes ytterligere opplysninger om stillingen, ta gjerne kontakt med virksomhetsleder Elisabeth Sletner Fagersand, mobtelf 920 46 554 , elisabeth.sletner.fagersand@ahk.no


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kommunen ligger under en time fra Oslo, Gardermoen og Charlottenberg, og kun 30 minutter fra Lillestrøm og store deler av Romerike. Vi er Oslos nærmeste villmark med et rikt dyreliv og et flott kulturlandskap, og med flere tettsteder der Bjørkelangen er kommunesenteret. Aurskog-Høland kommune er en fremtidsrettet organisasjon der medarbeiderne er den viktigste ressursen for at vi skal lykkes i å skape det mangfoldige og gode liv for våre innbyggere og gjester. Det gjør vi best sammen, og som ansatt er vi opptatt av å gi deg ansvar og spennende arbeidsoppgaver, samtidig som vi legger til rette for faglig utvikling. Aurskog-Høland ble som én av tre kommuner nominert som Årets kulturkommune 2023-2024, ligger på første plass på Romerike i saksbehandling av byggesaker, og havnet i 2022 på 14. plass over landets best styrte kommuner. Vi ønsker oss flere initiativrike og dyktige medarbeidere som setter pris på å bli utfordret og som aktivt bidrar i løsningen av kommunens oppgaver. Vi er en kommune i vekst. Det gir oss mange muligheter i tiden fremover. Vi kan tilby spennende og utviklende oppgaver.

jobs.title: Systems Associate (Graduate/Entry-level opportunity)
jobs.description:
Hi, I'm Tom Clark - CIO, CISO, and hx employee #9. I'm the executive in charge of our Systems & Security function. I joined in 2020 at seed stage, and I've been here through Series A, Series B, and everything in between - watching us grow from nine people to more than 250. I’m six years in, and I've never been more excited about what's ahead.

Fun fact: I didn't come from insurance. I came from TV and media - if you've ever used BBC iPlayer, ITVX, or listened to Capital Radio, I helped make them. I ended up in insurance and became, perhaps unexpectedly, one of the industry's biggest cheerleaders.

I know what you're thinking: insurance isn't cool. I can change your mind in five minutes, or your money back. And the best bit? What we're building with hxOS is cooler still. We take a product-centric, customer-centric view to internal IT - the same rigour and craft you'd bring to any customer-facing product. That's what makes this role different, and it's what I'm most excited about.

Let’s speak soon.
- TC

 

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry: which risks to take, and how to price them. These are decisions that shape real-world outcomes - whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision. We help them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally. We are already trusted by nearly 60 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do: from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

About the SYSSEC team

hxOS is hx's internal operating system. It's the platform every person in the company uses and builds on: devices, meeting rooms, core applications, SSO, AI tools, data infrastructure, security and compliance. The Systems & Security (SYSSEC) team builds it, runs it, and keeps improving it. It'll never be finished. That's the point.

hxOS is as much a vision as a current reality. The foundations are solid, day to day runs well because it has to, nothing gets built on shaky ground. The more ambitious layers - federated, AI-native, product-led infrastructure that the whole business builds on - are what the team is building now.

About the role

The Systems Associate is one of the most visible faces of SYSSEC. They're the first point of contact for everything coming into the team, and the work ranges widely: a day might move from troubleshooting a device, to helping a team get more out of a new AI integration, to contributing to a piece of infrastructure the whole company will rely on. What ties it together is ownership: of the service experience, of the queue, and progressively of the platform itself.

The career story here is real. This person becomes hxOS's internal expert, the colleague people turn to when they want to understand what's possible, get more out of their tools, or navigate something new. That's a rare combination of technical depth, operational credibility, and genuine impact at the centre of how the company works.

This is an Associate/IC1 role, suited to a talented graduate or someone with a year or two behind them.

What you'll be doing

Own the front door. Triage, prioritise, route, and keep stakeholders informed on everything coming into SYSSEC, applying an ITIL/ITSM lens to how work arrives, gets handled, and gets resolved. How it feels to reach out to SYSSEC starts and ends with how this person shows up.

Improve the service, continuously. Good enough today is a problem tomorrow. Look for recurring patterns, find root causes, and change the conditions that created them, through better templates, self-serve paths, proactive communication, and process work that makes repeat tickets rarer over time.

Build things that reduce the work. Scripts, automations, integrations, paved-road workflows. Engineer toil out of the system rather than just processing it, and contribute to the broader hxOS integration layer: connectors, routing logic, self-serve tooling that makes the platform more capable over time.

Be a partner to the business. As the internal expert in hxOS, help colleagues get more out of their devices, applications, and AI tools. This isn't ticket resolution, it's helping people understand what's possible and removing friction between them and a platform designed to make them better at their jobs.

Contribute to strategic delivery. Around 20% of the role is higher-leverage work: contributing to platform design, supporting infrastructure decisions, and building the technical foundations needed to take on bigger challenges over time.

What good looks like

Reliable under volume. Owns a queue without being chased, keeps work moving and stakeholders informed, and holds the same standard whether it's a routine request or a change that touches critical infrastructure.

Builds rather than just processes. Comfortable writing scripts and configuring automations, thinks in repeatable patterns rather than one-off fixes, and treats "make the next version of this job smaller" as the actual goal.

Already AI-native, not AI-curious. Uses AI tools as a natural part of everyday work: triage, documentation, automation scaffolding, first-pass review. Has judgement about where it helps and where it doesn't, rather than reaching for it by default.

Figures things out unprompted. Given a problem, researches it, tests it, forms a view, and comes back with a recommendation rather than a question. Comfortable with ambiguity, applies feedback fast, and is honest about what they do and don't know yet.

Why hx

You'll become hxOS's internal expert: the person colleagues turn to when they want to understand what's possible, get more from their tools, or work through something new. It's a rare mix of technical depth, operational credibility, and real visibility at the centre of how the company runs, with a clear path from owning the queue to shaping the platform itself.


You're joining a generational business at a real inflection point. hx isn't an early-stage bet. We have nearly 60 of the world's largest insurers as customers, exceptional NRR (genuinely rare) at 125%+, billions in premium flowing through the platform, and backing from a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery. You get the rare combination: a varied craft role with the freedom to build, and the strong backing of a company that's already winning.



Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual well-being allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

Additional Perks:

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular hackathons, lunch & learns, and socials, both remote and in-person, to foster collaboration and creativity.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, fully stocked snacks and drinks, and a fun, creative office at The Ministry.

  • Access to cutting-edge AI tools and experimentation budget, giving you the freedom to test, learn, and innovate ahead of the market.

 
 

Interview process

  1. Introductory Interview with Head of Talent

  2. Hiring Manager Deep Dive with Luke

  3. Meet the team + Skills Assessment

  4. Values Interview with Tom Clark

  5. We offer!

 
 

Our Commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do; it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you’re energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 

Next Steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

jobs.title: Lead Legal Counsel, IP
jobs.description:
Introduction to Role & Team

At Bumble, our mission is to create a world where healthy and equitable relationships and friendships thrive, and our Legal team plays an important role in protecting the ideas, brands, technology, and experiences that bring that mission to life. As Lead Legal Counsel within our IP team, you’ll be a senior subject-matter expert helping Bumble navigate complex intellectual property questions across our brands, products, technology, content, and creative work. You’ll independently lead significant IP matters and shape practical strategies in close partnership with colleagues across Legal, Marketing, Creative, Brand, Design, Product, and Engineering, combining Courage and Curiosity with strong commercial judgement. You’ll also help us explore the opportunities and risks created by AI and other emerging technologies, using AI thoughtfully in your own work while applying human judgement, care, and accountability to the outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Shape and execute Bumble’s global intellectual property strategy in partnership with Legal leadership, translating business, brand, product, and technology priorities into practical approaches to protection, portfolio management, licensing, and enforcement.

  • Take ownership of significant matters across Bumble’s international trademark, copyright, patent, domain name, trade secret, and broader digital asset portfolio, working with external counsel and specialist providers to protect strategically important intellectual property.

  • Collaborate with purpose across Marketing, Creative, Brand, Design, Product, and Engineering, providing practical rights-clearance and IP advice from early concept and development through launch, including trademarks, copyright, publicity rights, creator and talent rights, user-generated content, and third-party materials.

  • Independently lead complex IP enforcement and dispute matters, including infringement, oppositions, litigation support, and evidence management, applying commercial judgement to determine where action can deliver meaningful protection for Bumble’s brands and innovation.

  • Advise on the creation, ownership, protection, licensing, and commercialisation of Bumble-developed intellectual property, and draft and negotiate sophisticated IP arrangements including licences, coexistence agreements, assignments, merchandising arrangements, technology agreements, and strategic partnerships.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on patent strategy, software development, open-source software, and innovation protection, while advising on emerging IP questions involving generative AI, training data, provenance, ownership, licensing, and infringement risk.

  • Take ownership of IP priorities from insight to impact by supporting due diligence for significant partnerships, investments, and acquisitions and by developing practical playbooks, precedents, training, and self-service guidance that help teams identify and manage IP risk consistently.

  • Champion Bumble’s values of Excellence and Respect by providing clear, pragmatic advice to senior stakeholders and maintaining an agile mindset as legal, technology, and business priorities evolve. Use approved AI tools where appropriate to strengthen legal research, review, summarisation, and knowledge management, while carefully assessing outputs for accuracy, privacy, bias, and responsible use.

 

About You

  • You are qualified as a solicitor in England and Wales, or hold an equivalent qualification in another European jurisdiction.

  • Typically requires 8+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

  • You bring deep intellectual property expertise, particularly across trademarks, copyright, brand protection, licensing, portfolio management, rights clearance, and technology-related IP matters, developed in-house, in private practice, or through a combination of both.

  • You have strong experience advising consumer technology or similarly complex businesses on intellectual property issues involving software, digital content, product innovation, AI, and emerging technologies, and can independently develop practical solutions to significant or unusual legal questions.

  • You are an accomplished drafter and negotiator who can manage sophisticated IP and technology arrangements and translate complex legal concepts into clear recommendations that enable informed commercial decisions.

  • You collaborate with purpose and build trusted relationships with senior partners across different disciplines. You take ownership of challenging matters, see work through from insight to impact, and adapt your approach with an agile mindset as priorities and information evolve.

  • You combine sound commercial judgement with strong organisational and project-management skills, distinguishing material business risks from theoretical ones while effectively managing multiple priorities, international portfolios, external advisers, and specialist providers.

  • You demonstrate Curiosity, Courage, and Excellence in how you work, and you are comfortable identifying and using AI opportunities to improve effectiveness and insight while exercising appropriate human judgement and applying AI responsibly, inclusively, and with care for confidentiality and data privacy.

 

Benefits & Perks

  • Annual personal learning & development budget

  • Private Medical Insurance (PMI)

  • Private Dental Insurance

  • Babylon Health app

  • Mental health support

  • Enhanced parental leave, including a highly competitive maternity package

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Subsidised gym membership

  • ‘Double matched’ pension contributions up to 6%

  • Premium App Access

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI Fluency

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.

Final Compensation

Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations.

Inclusion at Bumble Inc.

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc).

AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring

At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly.

Fraudulent Candidate Detection

Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.

🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. The Job, in a Nutshell

Orbital's London office isn't just a place to sit - it's where culture comes to life, where collaboration gets real, and where the best version of our company shows up every day. We need someone to own that.

As Workplace Experience Manager, you'll be the person who makes in-person time feel intentional, energising, and genuinely worth showing up for. You'll spot what needs improving before anyone else does, elevate what's already good into something exceptional, and care deeply about the details that most people never notice - but everyone feels.

This isn't a head-down admin role, and it's not a purely strategic one either. We want someone who can define what "great" looks like and then go make it happen - someone equally at home rethinking the summer party concept and making sure the snacks never run out.

You'll report into our Head of Operations and be based in our London office five days a week.

What You'll Do

Elevate the Workplace Experience

Our office should feel like the best version of Orbital - energising, considered, and somewhere people genuinely want to be. You'll own that. Not by waiting for someone to point out a problem, but by constantly asking what would make this better - and then making it happen.

You will:

  • Assess what’s working and what isn’t, and proactively improve it

  • Refine layout, flow, rituals, and small details that shift perception

  • Raise standards without being asked

You’ll play a central role in shaping our new London office and ensuring the space supports how we work.

Deliver events and rituals that matter

From Wednesday lunches to the summer party, from All Hands to company off-sites - every in-person moment is a chance to reinforce culture, build real connection, and make people feel good about where they work. You'll own the events calendar end-to-end and make sure every event is considered, well-executed, and genuinely worth people's time.

  • Manage vendors and budgets confidently

  • Create simple communication plans to drive attendance and engagement

  • Design lightweight feedback loops, analyse results, and continuously improve

Run a flawless operation

Great workplace experience starts with a workplace that just works. Snacks stocked. Meeting rooms set up. Vendors sorted. You'll build the systems and habits that keep the fundamentals running so smoothly that nobody has to think about them - because you already have.

You will own:

  • The overall standards and day-to-day functioning of the office environment

  • Vendor relationships, facilities coordination, and office supplies

  • Organising weekly lunches and keeping snacks stocked

  • Health & safety essentials

  • AV and meeting room setup (calls work, screens connect, rooms are ready)

  • Desk booking software: managing the platform and ensuring it reflects real attendance patterns

  • Meeting room scheduling and utilisation: preventing friction and resolving booking issues

You’ll proactively monitor how the office operates, spotting and resolving issues before they surface.

Own the first impression

Whether it's a candidate walking in for their first interview or a new joiner arriving on day one, you're often the first face of Orbital people meet in person. That moment matters more than most people realise. You'll make sure it's warm, considered, and sets exactly the right tone.

Working closely with the People and Talent teams, you will:

  • Be the welcoming face for candidates on interview days, stepping in as the on-site host when the Talent team aren't available

  • Send welcome emails to new joiners ahead of their start date and add them to the new starter programme calendar

  • Meet new joiners on their first day and lead the office induction alongside IT

  • Act as the primary office point of contact throughout the onboarding period

  • Reinforce and strengthen our employer brand through every in-person interaction with candidates and new joiners

A brilliant office initiative that nobody knows about isn't brilliant. You'll make sure people are informed, excited, and showing up - by communicating clearly, consistently, and with real personality.

Oppdal er fjellbygda i Midt-Norge, også kjent for Norges største alpine skiområde.
