jobs.title: Hyggelig familiemann (41) søker tilkallingsassistenter til arbeid på dagtid!
jobs.description:
Om meg:

Jeg er en 41 år gammel mann som bor i en kjekk leilighet i Sandnes. Jeg deler leiligheten med min samboer, datter (11 år) og katten vår. Jeg sitter i rullestol og har sterkt nedsatte krefter i armer, hender og bein på grunn av sykdommen min. Jeg trenger derfor hjelp til alle praktiske gjøremål og har derfor fått innvilget BPA – brukerstyrt personlig assistanse.

Det er en ny og spennende erfaring for meg å ha assistent, men jeg ser fram til å bli kjent med deg og utvikle et godt samarbeid. Jeg trives godt med å jobbe sammen med andre, så dette kan fort gå veldig bra. Jeg er utdannet og jobber som lærer fra hjemmekontoret mitt noen timer i uka. Det er derfor viktig at du kan jobbe selvstendig, men med tilstrekkelig veiledning fra meg når det er nødvendig.

 

Stilling: Jeg har behov for tilkallingsassistenter som kan jobbe ved fravær og ved skoleferier.

 

Arbeidstid:

Arbeidstiden din vil hovedsakelig være fra kl. 08.30 til 14.00 alle hverdager (mandag-fredag). Det vil ikke være helgearbeid i denne stillingen. 

 

Arbeidsoppgaver:

Husarbeid

Matlaging

Assistanse til personlig stell ved behov

Assistanse med påkledning

Assistere i fysioterapiøvelser 

Assistanse ved toalettbesøk

Kjøre meg til lege/sykehus og annen oppfølging ved behov

Være med på turer ut til handling eller annet

 

Jeg søker deg som kan være mine armer og bein når jeg trenger det. Det er et pluss om du liker å lage mat og kan jobbe selvstendig. Også fint at du er positiv, løsningsorientert og tåler litt galgenhumor. Jeg ser fram til å møte deg!

Vi tilbyr (Prima Assistanse)

  • En meningsfull jobb som bidrar til likestilling
  • Lønn og arbeidsvilkår etter tariffavtale
  • Grundig opplæring og tett oppfølging
  • En selvstendig jobb med varierte oppgaver


Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.description:
Stilling
Fagarbeidere/assistenter i 50-80% stilling, fast. Arbeidstid: Natt. Pr. tiden arbeidsted i tilrettelagt hjemmeomsorg, omsorg for barn og ungdom i hjemmet. 

Antall stillinger vurderes ut i fra behov og ut ifra ønskede stillingsstørrelser. Søknader vil bli behandlet fortløpende. 

Beskrivelse av arbeidssted
Helse- og omsorgstjenestene i Rauma består i dag av 4 virksomheter: Koordinerende avdeling, Rauma Helsehus, Hjemmebasert omsorg og Bo -og habiliteringstjenesten. Helse-og omsorgstjenesten omfatter alle aldersgrupper. Virksomhet hjemmebasert omsorg består av hjemmesykepleie, hjemmehjelp, omsorgsboliger/bofelleskap/bokollektiv med og uten bemanning. Helse- og omsorgstjenesten er i stor grad samlet i Rauma helsehus, som gir økt mulighet til å danne et unikt tverrfaglig miljø.

Arbeidssted er i tjenestemottakers hjem. 

Arbeidsoppgaver

  •  Den enkelte pasient/bruker skal gis et helhetlig og koordinert helse- og omsorgstjenestetilbud
  •  Tjenesten tilstreber at pasienter/brukere skal kunne bo og leve gode liv i egne hjem
  •  Tett samarbeid med pårørende
  •  Fokus på hverdagsrehabilitering
  •  Bruk av velferdsteknologi i daglig tjeneste
  •  Bidra til kvalitet i tjenestetilbudet
  •  Bidra til tverrfaglig samhandling både innad i kommunen og med spesialisthelsetjenesten

Arbeidsområde

  • Individuell oppfølgning av pasienter/brukere etter vedtak
  • Vektlegge brukermedvirkning
  • Samhandling med andre faggrupper, tjenester og pårørende
  • Delta i kontinuerlig forbedringsarbeid 

Kvalifikasjonskrav

  • Må ha gode norskkunnskaper skriftlig og muntlig, minimum nivå B2
  • Må ha gode digitale ferdigheter 

Ønskelige kvalifikasjoner

  • Relevant arbeidserfaring med barn og unge
  • Fagbrev som helsefagarbeider
  • Førerkort kl B dersom kombinasjonsstilling

Personlige egenskaper

  • Du evner å jobbe selvstendig
  • Du er samarbeidsvillig
  • Du er fleksibel og tilpasningsdyktig

Vi tilbyr

  • Meningsfull jobb 
  • Individuelt tilpassa opplæring
  • Gode pensjonsordninger

Søknad 
Rauma kommune tar kun imot elektroniske søknader. Søkerveiledning: Søkerveiledning - Rauma kommune  eller personal@rauma.kommune.no. Det er viktig at du tar deg tid til å besvare spørsmålene vi stiller, og registrerer din utdannelse og kompetanse i søknadsskjemaet. Last opp aktuelle attester og vitnemål i PDF format. Lenke til vitnemålsportalen kan sendes kontaktperson. Dokumentasjonen danner grunnlag for beregning av lønn.

Vær oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søker kan bli offentliggjort selv om søker har bedt om å ikke bli ført opp på søkerliste, jf. Offentlegloven. 

Ansettelse
Ansettelse skjer i henhold til gjeldende lover, reglementer og avtaleverk, herunder medlemskap i pensjonsordning. Avlønning etter sentral Hovedtariffavtale ut fra kvalifikasjoner og ansiennitet. 

Politiattest
Ved tilsetting må gyldig politiattest iht. helse- og omsorgstenestelova § 5-4, jf. politiregisterloven § 39 første ledd, fremlegges. Politiattesten skal ikke være eldre enn 3 måneder.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Velkommen til Verdens beste kommune for naturglade mennesker! Hos oss kan du både ha en givende jobb og en aktiv fritid. Du har kort vei til naturopplevelser uansett hvor du befinner deg i kommunen. Kommunesenteret Åndalsnes ligger innen 1-2 timers kjøretur til Molde og Ålesund lufthavn, og Raumabanen gjør at du kan reise miljøvennlig med tog. Kommunen har et bredt og ambisiøst næringsliv og satser aktivt på turisme og gode opplevelser for alle. Kjente turistmål som Trollstigen, Romsdalseggen, Rampestreken og Romsdalsgondolen finner du her, og vi har et spennende og variert kulturliv med Rauma kulturhus som motor. Norsk Fjellfestival, Trollveggen Triathlon og RaumaRock er tre av folkefestene som skaper liv og røre. Det er mange tilbud om fritidsaktviteter for både barn og voksne, i alle deler av kommunen. Velkommen til Naturgledekommunen Rauma!

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
We at Rocsole are experts in electrical tomography and its application to industrial process monitoring. Our unique SeeBeyond technology helps customers detect and visualize liquids, solids, and interfaces in demanding industrial environments. Our LiquiDetect and SoliDetect products support safer, more efficient, and more sustainable operations. Our customers include major industrial and energy companies around the world.

We are looking for an **Automation Engineer** to join **#TeamROCSOLE**!

In this position, you will create and maintain electrical and automation documentation for Rocsole products, including wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, cable drawings, and other related technical documentation. You will provide technical support throughout the product lifecycle and contribute to customer projects, commissioning activities, troubleshooting, and after-sales support together with Rocsoles Technical Support team.

You will work closely with our product development, production, and technical support professionals. Your responsibilities will include supporting electrical and functional testing, maintaining accurate product documentation, and ensuring that product modifications are properly reflected in drawings and technical materials.

You will also participate in factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), commissioning, and startup activities. When required, you will support customers remotely or on-site. Occasional international travel is therefore part of the role.

The right candidate is a structured and detail-oriented professional with strong problem-solving skills. You are comfortable working independently, but you also collaborate effectively with colleagues, customers, and other stakeholders. You take pride in producing accurate technical documentation and providing professional support in practical engineering situations.

**Your main responsibilities will include:**

- Creating and maintaining wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, cable drawings, and related technical documentation for Rocsole products

- Ensuring that electrical documentation meets Rocsoles quality standards, applicable requirements, and customer needs

- Updating drawings and documentation when product modifications and engineering changes are implemented

- Supporting production personnel with electrical and automation-related technical issues

- Supporting electrical and functional testing of products before shipment

- Participating in verification and validation activities for new products and product modifications

- Supporting commissioning and startup activities together with Rocsoles Technical Support Specialist

- Participating in factory acceptance testing (FAT) and site acceptance testing (SAT)

- Providing remote and on-site technical support when required


**We expect you to have:**

- A bachelors degree or equivalent qualification in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or another relevant technical field

- Relevant work experience in electrical schematic and wiring diagram design

- Experience with SolidWorks Electrical, DraftSight, or equivalent electrical design tools

- Basic knowledge of PLCs and automation systems

- Strong attention to detail and a structured, systematic approach to your work

- Good problem-solving, communication, and customer service skills

- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

- Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English

- Willingness to travel internationally on occasion


Equivalent competence acquired through relevant work experience may also be considered.

**The following will be considered an advantage:**

- Experience in designing and documenting 230 VAC industrial electrical systems

- A valid SFS 6002 Electrical Safety Training certificate

- Knowledge of the SFS 6000 electrical installation standards

- Experience with industrial instrumentation and sensors

- Experience with industrial communication networks

- Understanding of Ex, ATEX, or IECEx requirements


Our company embraces personal and professional growth. If you are looking for practical engineering challenges and an opportunity to develop your expertise in industrial automation, instrumentation, and sensor technology, this could be the right place for you.

Our office is located in Kuopio, Finland, where your workstation and colleagues are waiting for you. The position is full-time and permanent. Occasional international travel is required.

**We shape the future of industrial process monitoring. Come join us! More info at: https://rocsole.co/AutEng**

jobs.title: Technical Sourcer
jobs.description:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

As Technical Sourcer at Arago, you will own the search for some of the most sought-after engineers in the world. We build hardware that has never existed before, and finding the people who can build it requires going far beyond standard recruiting channels.

You will own the full sourcing motion: mapping talent pools, building precise searches, crafting outreach that resonates with passive candidates, and building long-term relationships with high-priority profiles. Working directly with hiring managers and founders, you will develop a deep understanding of each role and the technical landscape around it, then go find the right people, wherever they are.

Responsibilities

  • Build highly targeted searches for Arago's most critical roles, ASIC architects, packaging engineers, mixed-signal verification, SW systems leads

  • Craft outreach that engages passive candidates and builds long-term relationships with high-priority targets

  • Develop creative sourcing strategies: GitHub, research communities, referral networks, X-Ray etc.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers to build customized sourcing strategies

  • Own candidate tracking, pipeline metrics, and funnel data with a structured approach

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

We're Looking For

  • Proven sourcing experience in deep tech, semiconductors, or AI hardware, not just software

  • X-Ray search skills and comfort sourcing across GitHub, LinkedIn, and non-traditional channels

  • Demonstrated success sourcing passive senior technical talent

  • Ability to run multiple complex searches in parallel without dropping quality

  • Genuine curiosity about the technology, you need to understand what you're sourcing for

  • A long-game mindset: relationship building over transactional outreach

Nice to Have

  • Sourcing experience in technical domains

  • Proven track record of filling hard-to-find roles

  • Experience writing outreach that actually gets replies

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with multiple open roles simultaneously

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago.

jobs.title: Chargé.e d'Administration RH (H/F)
jobs.description:
À propos d'ILLUIN Technology

ILLUIN Technology est le leader français de l'IA Générative souveraine et de confiance. Nous développons des modèles de langage (LLM) propriétaires et une plateforme technologique de pointe pour permettre aux entreprises et aux organisations de déployer l'IA générative en toute sécurité, en gardant la maîtrise de leurs données.

Adossé au fond privé Seven2, Illuin est entré dans une phase d’investissement et de forte croissance depuis le début de l’année. Dans ce contexte d’accélération, le Groupe recrute un/une Chargé(e) d’Administration RH afin de sécuriser et de professionnaliser l’ensemble des processus administratifs liés au cycle de paie et à l’expérience interne des Illuiners.

Votre Mission

Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction Administratif et Financier, en lien étroit avec les équipes opérationnelles, vous êtes le/la garant(e) du contrôle interne de la paie et de la fiabilité des données sociales. La paie est externalisée auprès d’un prestataire : votre rôle n’est pas de la produire mais d’en assurer la préparation, le contrôle et la coordination de bout en bout.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement dynamique et agile, dans un contexte de structuration où vous devrez faire preuve de rigueur, de polyvalence et être force de proposition afin de contribuer à l’avancement d’un vaste panel de missions tels que :

  • Pilotage et contrôle de la paie externalisée

    • Collecte, consolidation et transmission des éléments variables de paie au prestataire (entrées/sorties, absences, variables, primes, notes de frais impactant la paie) selon un calendrier de paie maîtrisé ;

    • Contrôle de la saisie des temps par les salariés (suivi des congés etc) ;

    • Collecte des déclarations sociales produites par le prestataire (DSN, charges sociales, organismes de prévoyance et de mutuelle) et suivi des éventuelles anomalies jusqu’à résolution ;

    • Rapprochement de la paie avec la comptabilité en lien avec le CFO et l’expert comptable (écritures de paie, provisions congés payés, comptes de tiers sociaux).

  • Administration du personnel et cycle de vie collaborateur

    • Gestion administrative des entrées : DPAE, rédaction des contrats et avenants, affiliations mutuelle et prévoyance, visites médicales, création des dossiers collaborateurs ;

    • Suivi des évolutions en cours de vie (avenants, mobilités, changements de temps de travail) et des sorties (documents de fin de contrat, coordination avec la paie et le management) ;

    • Suivi des absences, congés, arrêts de travail, IJSS et dossiers de prévoyance ;

    • Gestion des dispositifs collectifs et avantages (titres-restaurant, mutuelle, mobilité durable, remboursements transport) ;

    • Tenue et fiabilisation des obligations administratives : registre unique du personnel, affichages, archivage et conformité RGPD des données sociales.

  • Coordination des prestataires et interlocuteurs externes

    • Interlocuteur(trice) de référence du cabinet de paie : animation du rythme de collaboration, cadrage des livrables, respect des échéances et arbitrage des points bloquants ;

    • Point de contact avec les organismes externes (URSSAF, organismes de retraite et de prévoyance, médecine du travail, OPCO, mutuelle) en lien avec le prestataire et le CFO;

  • Data & Process Owner RH

    • Élaboration et documentation de l’ensemble des processus administratifs RH et de l’outillage associé (SIRH), dans un contexte de croissance et avec la perspective d’intégration de nouvelles entités ;

    • Garantie de la qualité et de la cohérence de la donnée sociale entre le SIRH, la paie et les outils Finance.

  • Conformité sociale et missions ponctuelles

    • Veille sur la réglementation sociale et l’application de la convention collective, avec appui de conseils externes sur les sujets complexes ;

    • Contribution aux obligations et échéances annuelles (index égalité professionnelle, déclarations obligatoires, préparation des audits) ;

    • Participation aux projets de structuration de la fonction People : déploiement ou évolution du SIRH, automatisation des processus, préparation des instances représentatives du personnel.

Profil Recherché

Il s’agit d’un poste évolutif, à la fois du fait de la croissance et de l’ambition du Groupe mais aussi de la variété des chantiers rencontrés laissant ainsi la place à l’expression des appétences de chacun.

  • Formation en Ressources Humaines, gestion de la paie ou droit social (Licence/Master, titre professionnel gestionnaire de paie)

  • Une expérience confirmée en administration du personnel et en gestion ou contrôle de la paie, en entreprise ou en cabinet

  • Bonne connaissance des mécanismes de paie et du cadre légal et conventionnel français ; une connaissance de la convention Syntec est un plus

  • Notions et curiosité appréciées sur les outils SIRH, l’automatisation des processus et l'A appliquée aux fonctions support

Nous recherchons un profil autonome et force de proposition faisant preuve d’une grande rigueur et d’un sens aigu de la confidentialité. Vous devrez faire preuve de curiosité, de polyvalence et d’une capacité d’adaptation pour évoluer sur plusieurs sujets de front demandant un regard critique, ainsi que d’un vrai sens du service auprès des collaborateurs.

Ce que propose le poste

  • Un périmètre complet, de la paie à l’administration du personnel,

  • La possibilité de construire son propre périmètre et sa fonction de zéro, en proposant les outils et les processus qui structureront la fonction People.

jobs.title: Account Executive Firm Expansion
jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

Afin d’accompagner notre croissance et répondre à nos enjeux 2026, nous ouvrons un nouveau poste au sein de l’équipe Sales en charge de la relation avec les clients SMEs des cabinets comptables partenaires de Pennylane.

Tu auras un rôle central en étant le point de contact privilégié des cabinets comptables souhaitant déployer Pennylane chez leurs clients

En effet, depuis 1 an, nous accélérons fortement dans l’acquisition de nouveaux cabinets comptables. L’outil Pennylane prenant tout son sens lorsque les Experts Comptables et leurs clients travaillent ensemble dessus, c’est dans leur intérêt d’équiper au maximum leurs clients.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

  • En échangeant avec les cabinets comptables partenaires pour identifier les SMEs de leurs portefeuilles les plus à même de pouvoir s’équiper de Pennylane.

  • En mettant en place des actions commerciales terrains (évènements physiques, webinaires, journée portes ouvertes) afin de faire connaître Pennylane auprès des SMEs de nos cabinets comptables partenaires.

  • En gérant de l’ensemble du cycle de vente de Pennylane sur ces SMEs (Qualification, Démo, Closing).

Tu travailleras main dans la main avec:

  • Les Account Executives Cabinets Comptables : ils sont en charge de vendre Pennylane à un maximum de cabinets comptables.

  • Les Account Managers : ils gèrent la relation commerciale avec le cabinet comptable et la coordination des projets de monétisation des SMEs avec nos cabinets comptables partenaires.

 

A quoi ressembleront tes débuts chez nous?

 

3 premiers mois :

  • Tu apprends à connaître Pennylane, sa vision, ses équipes afin de t'y sentir pleinement intégré

  • Tu intègres la sales academy afin de connaître parfaitement le rôle de chacun et de saisir le fonctionnement de l'équipe sales au global

  • Tu es formé par ton manager afin de prendre tes marques au sein de l'équipe

  • Tu montes en compétences sur l’outil

  • Tu prends en main tes prospects, accompagné par ton manger

  • Tu deviens autonome sur des ventes simples

4 à 8 mois

  • Tu gères en autonomie tes premières ventes complexes

  • Tu traites des leads de plus en plus complexes et stratégiques pour l'entreprise

  • Tu participes aux améliorations des process au sein de l'équipe et partage tes bonnes pratiques

  • Tu collabores avec les autres équipes de Pennylane (customer care, produit, sales...) afin de transmettre tes retours clients et participer à l'amélioration continue de notre plateforme

Et ensuite... :

  • Tu deviens un(e) AE confirmé (et donc un expert du produit), et tu es capable de gérer n'importe quel type de lead

  • Tu es owner d'un ou de plusieurs side project.s

  • Tu contribues activement à la mise à jour des process dans notre base interne (Notion)

  • Tu participes au mentoring et à la formation des nouveaux arrivants dans l'équipe

Process de recrutement

- Un premier entretien avec Orane : Senior Business Recruiter (30 min)

- Un deuxième entretien de fit avec Stan, Manager de l’équipe (45 min)

- Une mise en situation + case study avec Stan, Manager de l’équipe et un membre de l'équipe (1h)

- Un Final Round avec Jacob, Head of Sales SMEs (45 min)

- Un Team Fit Interview avec les membres de l'équipe (45 min) - sur site

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

  • Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

  • Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. jobs.title: Chef de Projet Fonctionnel – Migration Comptable (Télétravail complet possible)
jobs.description:
Et si ton expertise comptable devenait le pont entre les cabinets et la technologie qui va transformer leur métier ?

Chez Pennylane, on a une conviction forte : les experts-comptables méritent des outils à la hauteur de leur métier. Des outils qui leur font gagner du temps sur les tâches répétitives, pour qu'ils puissent se concentrer sur ce qui compte vraiment : le conseil, l'accompagnement, la relation client. C'est pour ça qu'on a construit une plateforme tout-en-un qui réunit experts-comptables et dirigeants sur le même outil.

Aujourd’hui, nous recrutons une personne ayant exercé comme collaborateur ou collaboratrice comptable en cabinet, ayant déjà participé idéalement à une ou plusieurs migrations vers un nouveau logiciel comptable. Ta connaissance du métier et des réalités quotidiennes des cabinets te permettra de les accompagner au mieux dans la migration de leurs données comptables vers Pennylane.

🌍 Pennylane, c'est quoi ?

Pennylane est une fintech française parmi les plus dynamiques du pays, actuellement en pleine expansion à l'échelle européenne.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoia, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leurs débuts

🎯 Ton rôle

Tu rejoins l'équipe Partner Solutions Specialists, composée intégralement d'anciens comptables. Une équipe qui comprend les enjeux des cabinets de l'intérieur, et qui les accompagne avec le bon niveau d'expertise métier, de rigueur et d'empathie.

En tant que PSS Front, tu es l'expert métier en contact direct avec toutes les parties prenantes pendant les projets de migration. Tu travailles en binôme avec le PSS Back (Partner Solutions Architect), qui prend en charge l'intégration et les aspects techniques. Toi, tu es le visage du projet côté cabinet : celui ou celle qui cadre, qui rassure, qui fait avancer.

C'est un rôle exigeant, au croisement de la gestion de projet, de l'expertise comptable et de la relation client, avec une vraie dimension de conseil et d'amélioration continue.

📋 Tes missions au quotidien

Audit et analyse des besoins fonctionnels

  • Planifier, préparer et animer les réunions avec les cabinets — du lancement au Retex, en passant par les briefings, cadrages et restitutions

  • Analyser les besoins métiers à partir des retours terrain et des expériences de migration

  • Rédiger la documentation et les user stories pour faciliter la compréhension des autres équipes

  • Animer des ateliers et webinaires — certains centrés sur les usages métiers, d'autres plus transverses

Gestion de projet de migration

  • S'assurer que les migrations suivent un cheminement clair et documenté, pour toutes les parties prenantes (internes et externes)

  • Adapter la démarche en fonction des situations, tout en veillant au respect des process existants pour garantir une vraie collaboration inter-équipes

  • Communiquer régulièrement sur l'alignement entre les solutions techniques et les besoins métiers

  • Être le relais d'information vers le PSS Back, en charge de l'intégration, de la correction et du contrôle

Préparation métier et paramétrage

  • Contribuer à la configuration de Pennylane pour l'adapter aux processus métiers existants des cabinets

  • Participer aux tests fonctionnels pour valider que la solution répond aux exigences métiers avant la migration

Support post-migration et recettes

  • Collaborer avec les équipes PSS Back sur le débogage et la résolution des problèmes métiers après migration

  • Conduire des tests fonctionnels intermédiaires et finaux pour valider les solutions

  • Contribuer aux rapports post-migration et proposer des axes d'amélioration

Automatisation et optimisation des processus

  • Identifier et prioriser les besoins en automatisation et en optimisation

  • Participer à leur mise en œuvre via de la documentation, des feedbacks ou des propositions concrètes

  • Suivre la satisfaction métier après chaque évolution

Veille, R&D et amélioration continue

  • Assurer une veille produit et métier pour garantir la pertinence des fonctionnalités

  • Proposer des améliorations sur l'existant et signaler les manques ou dysfonctionnements

  • Contribuer à la transformation des besoins en solutions actionnables, pour l'interne comme pour l'externe

Collaboration Front / Back

  • Connaître les enjeux des tâches du PSS Back et pouvoir intervenir ponctuellement sur la production selon les besoins

🙋 Le profil qu'on recherche

  • Formation comptable : IUT GEA, BTS CGO, DCG, DSCG, Master CCA — tu as les bases solides

  • Expérience en cabinet d'expertise-comptable, idéalement avec une ou plusieurs migrations déjà vécues

  • À l'aise à l'oral comme à l'écrit, tu interagis avec les comptables de manière claire, professionnelle et crédible

  • Sens du service et de la relation client : tu comprends les besoins, tu y réponds, et tu entretiens une vraie relation de confiance dans la durée

  • Capable de travailler en autonomie comme en équipe, avec une vraie flexibilité pour t'adapter aux évolutions rapides du produit

  • Envie d'apprendre en continu et de rester à jour sur les évolutions fonctionnelles de Pennylane

  • Anglais niveau A2 minimum

Les "nice to have"

  • À l'aise dans un environnement startup

  • Anglais niveau B1

  • Bon esprit de synthèse et vraie pédagogie

  • Proactivité et autonomie marquées

⚙️ Le process de recrutement

  1. Un premier échange avec un Business Recruiter — pour se découvrir et poser les bases

  2. Un entretien avec un Team Leader PSS — pour rentrer dans le fond du poste

  3. Un cas pratique avec un Partner Solutions Specialist — pour voir comment tu travailles concrètement

  4. Une dernière rencontre avec le ou la Head of Partner Success — pour valider l'alignement sur la vision et la culture

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

💻 Un Mac

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra :

Tu ne coches pas toutes les cases ? Postule quand même. On sait que les profils les plus intéressants sont rarement des copies conformes d'une fiche de poste. Ce qui compte, c'est ta trajectoire, ta façon de penser, et l'envie de contribuer à quelque chose qui a du sens.

Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 3500+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product Demo

  • Meet the team

  • Article on our seed round of 5,5M$

Your mission
As a Business Development Representative intern, you'll be on the front line of our growth engine. Your job is to generate qualified meetings with healthcare leaders who are overwhelmed by missed calls and inefficiencies, and show them how Vocca can change the game.

You'll hunt, qualify, and open doors so our Account Executives can close. You'll learn how to prospect like a pro, pitch like a consultant, and build the foundations of a sales career — with the goal of joining us full-time at the end of your internship.

Expected outcomes

1 month:

  • Master our pitch, our CRM, and our outbound playbook.

  • Book your first qualified meetings with healthcare prospects.

3 months:

  • Consistently hit monthly meeting targets through a mix of outbound calls, emails, and LinkedIn outreach.

  • Own inbound qualification: every lead gets a fast, thoughtful response.

  • Share field insights with Sales & Marketing to improve targeting.

End of internship (5-6 months):

  • Be performing at or near full quota, ready to hit the ground running as a full-time BDR.

  • Have tested and proposed new outbound tactics (copy, sequences, channels).

  • Convert to a full-time contract (CDI) if you perform well.

Who you are
This is for you if:

  • You're ambitious, competitive, and hungry to prove yourself.

  • You thrive on challenges and don't shy away from the grind of outbound sales.

  • You have excellent communication skills: clear, confident, and persuasive.

jobs.title: Clinical Data Manager RWD/RWE
jobs.description:
À propos de Lifen

Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales peuvent transformer le système de santé, à condition qu’elles soient accessibles. Mieux les faire circuler, c’est réduire la charge administrative, mieux coordonner les soins et accélérer la recherche clinique.

Depuis 2015, nous développons des solutions qui aident les professionnels de santé à partager les informations médicales et les chercheurs à exploiter des données de santé. Plus de 150 personnes travaillent chez Lifen, depuis nos bureaux et à distance. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé en France.

Notre équipe

L’équipe Clinical Ops intervient au cœur de nos projets de recherche clinique fondés sur des données de santé. Elle transforme des documents médicaux en données structurées, nécessaires à la constitution de cohortes patients et à la préparation des exports utilisés dans nos projets de recherche.

Aujourd’hui, l’équipe structure environ 100 à 200 cas patients par semaine. Notre ambition : tripler cette capacité dans les 9 prochains mois, tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité des données.

Pour y parvenir, nous cherchons une personne capable de reprendre le management de l’équipe, mais surtout de piloter le flux de production, d’anticiper la charge et de porter une démarche d’amélioration continue avec les équipes Produit, IA et Engineering.

C’est un rôle à la croisée du management opérationnel, de la RWD et de l’amélioration de processus.

Ce que tu feras chez nous

Ta première mission sera de reprendre le pilotage de la production des cohortes afin d’en améliorer simultanément la qualité, la capacité de traitement et le niveau d’automatisation.

Concrètement, tu seras amené·e à :

  • Manager et faire grandir l’équipe Clinical Ops, en donnant un cadre clair aux priorités et en organisant l’activité quotidienne.

  • Anticiper la charge et piloter la capacité de production afin de limiter les bottlenecks et de mieux absorber les variations de volume.

  • Construire les outils de pilotage nécessaires pour avoir une vision fine du flux : volumes de patients, capacité de traitement, taux d’erreur, points de blocage et charge de l’équipe.

  • Construire et orchestrer une roadmap d’amélioration continue permettant progressivement d’augmenter la capacité de traitement.

  • Porter cette roadmap auprès des équipes Produit, IA et Engineering : rendre les besoins opérationnels visibles, suivre les livrables R&D et créer le rythme nécessaire pour que les améliorations soient effectivement délivrées.

  • Garantir la qualité des cohortes et contribuer à la préparation des exports de données nécessaires aux projets de recherche.

Ce que nous attendrons de toi

Dans les premiers mois, nous attendrons de toi que tu développes une compréhension très fine du flux Clinical Ops : où se trouvent les blocages, comment évolue la charge et quels leviers permettent réellement d'améliorer la production.

Ton succès se mesurera notamment à ta capacité à mettre en place un pilotage fiable de l’activité, à réduire les erreurs et les bottlenecks et à créer, avec les équipes Produit et R&D, un rythme d’amélioration continue suffisamment soutenu pour accompagner notre changement d’échelle.

À horizon 9 mois, l’objectif est clair : passer d’environ 100–200 à 300–600 cas patients structurés par semaine, sans multiplier les ressources par trois.

Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

Nous chercherons en priorité trois éléments dans ton parcours :

  • Une expérience réussie en startup ou scale-up, dans un environnement où les process, outils et responsabilités restaient à construire.

  • Une expérience concrète de la Real-World Data / Real-World Evidence, idéalement autour de la constitution ou de l'exploitation de cohortes patients.

  • Un background santé ou scientifique te permettant de comprendre les enjeux liés aux données médicales et à la recherche clinique.

Nous attendons également :

  • Une expérience confirmée de management d’équipe opérationnelle.

  • Une expérience de structuration et de pilotage d’une activité complexe à partir de données et de KPI.

  • Une capacité à passer d’un problème opérationnel très concret à un plan d’amélioration structuré.

  • Une expérience de collaboration étroite avec des équipes Produit, Data/IA ou Engineering.

  • Une capacité à faire avancer une roadmap transverse et à créer de l’accountability autour des livrables.

Nice-to-have

  • Un parcours en data management, biostatistiques, épidémiologie ou dans un domaine scientifique proche.

  • Une expérience de structuration de registres, bases de données de santé ou cohortes RWD.

  • Une familiarité avec les enjeux de recherche clinique et les interactions avec les autorités de santé.

  • Une bonne compréhension des usages de l’IA et de l’ingénierie appliqués aux données de santé.

Ta manière de travailler

Tu as une vraie “just do it mentality” : face à un problème imparfaitement cadré, tu commences par comprendre les faits, tu structures le problème et tu mets rapidement en place les premières solutions.

Tu es particulièrement à l’aise dans les environnements où il faut créer les outils plutôt que simplement les utiliser. Si le dashboard dont tu as besoin pour piloter ton équipe n’existe pas, tu es capable de le définir et de le mettre en place.

Tu es structuré·e et organisé·e, mais pas bureaucratique. Tu sais entrer suffisamment dans le détail du flux pour comprendre les problèmes réels, tout en gardant une vision d’ensemble et en priorisant ce qui aura le plus d’impact.

Enfin, tu sais faire avancer des équipes sur lesquelles tu n’as pas nécessairement d’autorité hiérarchique. Tu rends les problèmes visibles, explicites les priorités et crées le rythme nécessaire pour transformer les décisions en améliorations concrètes.

Nos valeurs

Embrace Complexity — Tu aimes comprendre un flux de données complexe, en identifier les points de rupture et transformer cette complexité en décisions concrètes.

Bienveillance — Tu accompagnes une équipe au quotidien avec exigence, écoute et clarté.

Real Impact — Tu améliores la qualité et la disponibilité des données qui permettent de faire avancer des projets de recherche clinique.

Process de recrutement

Échange de préqualification avec Laura, Talent Acquisition Manager, 30 minutes. Nous faisons connaissance, revenons sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les grandes lignes du poste. C’est aussi le moment de répondre à tes premières questions sur Lifen, l’équipe et le contexte.

Entretien avec le VP Reasearch, 60 minutes. Nous revenons plus en détail sur ton parcours, ton expérience en RWD et en constitution de cohortes, ainsi que sur ton expérience de management et de pilotage d’activités opérationnelles. L’objectif est aussi de comprendre la manière dont tu structures et fais évoluer une organisation dans un environnement en croissance.

Use Case avec des membres des équipes Clinical Ops et Produit, 60 minutes. À partir de situations concrètes, nous échangeons sur ta manière de structurer une cohorte RWD, d’analyser des problématiques opérationnelles et de construire des plans d’amélioration. Ce sera également l’occasion d’aborder la manière dont tu gères les enjeux humains et la collaboration avec des équipes transverses.

Cultural alignment avec deux membres de Lifen, 45 minutes en visio. Ce temps permettra d’échanger sur ta façon de travailler, ton niveau d’autonomie, la collaboration au quotidien et l’adéquation avec nos valeurs.

jobs.title: Operations Manager, Offer Operations
jobs.description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 6 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🦾 Our Offer Operations team

Joko helps millions of users earn cashback automatically, whether they shop online through affiliate links, activate coupons, or pay in-store with their linked bank card. Behind each of these experiences, there's an operational engine that needs to work flawlessly: transactions must be tracked, cashback must be caught, offers must be reliable, and merchants must perform as expected. When this engine breaks, users don't get paid — and trust erodes fast.

Offer Operations owns that engine. The team's mission is to guarantee the reliability and continuous improvement of Joko's core monetization mechanics — across affiliate tracking, coupons, card-linked bank integrations, gift cards, and merchant performance. It's a technical, data-heavy, high-stakes scope that sits right at the heart of what makes Joko's product work.

🎯 What you will do

As an Operations Manager, your main mission is to own one of the processes that decides whether millions of Joko users actually get the cashback they're owed. You'll report to David Le Pahun, our Offer Operations Lead. The role blends four things: analysing data, designing how the process should work, solving problems with AI, technologies or in the last resort outsourcing, and managing projects.

  • Analyse data. You'll build the dashboards that tell you — and everyone else — whether your part of the system is healthy: how many transactions are being correctly tracked and rewarded, what's silently breaking down, whether user experience is suffering.

  • Design the process. You decide how merchants get set up on our platform: their cashback rate, which purchases qualify, how we connect to their systems. A lot of this doesn't have a playbook yet — you'll be writing a good chunk of it as you go.

  • Solve problems with technology. A merchant might be showing users a coupon that doesn't actually pay out. A batch of card purchases might not match cleanly to any merchant we track. You'll dig into why, then fix it choosing the right solution for it: automating it with AI, improving one of our internal tools (built on Retool) and if a human is required, you'll build the right playbook to outsource it.

  • Manage outsourced resources. You'll manage the outsourced team members who help you operate at scale — briefing them, training them, checking their work is actually good — while juggling several of these issues at once and deciding what matters most.

  • Partner cross-functionally. With Product & Engineering when the fix is structural, and with the commercial team when it's really about a merchant relationship.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: around 2–5 years of experience, ideally with exposure to Operations, Product, or a technical/data-driven environment.

  • AI-native: you genuinely believe in what AI can do, and you already use it as part of how you work — not as a buzzword, but as a real way to automate the repetitive parts of your job and move faster on the rest.

  • Ops mindset: you think in systems — monitoring → detection → investigation → resolution → prevention. You instinctively look for what can break and build safeguards so it doesn't happen again.

  • Tech acumen: you're comfortable in a technical environment — tracking, APIs, integrations — and can hold your own in a conversation with Engineering.

  • Analytical skills: you're data-driven and comfortable navigating dashboards, investigating anomalies, and making decisions based on metrics.

  • Attention to detail: the devil is in the details, and you have a talent for spotting flaws where others don't.

  • Communication: clear written and verbal communication skills; you're not afraid to defend your decisions with demanding stakeholders (including merchants and the outsourced teams you'll be directing).

  • Education: Top-tier engineering or business school background. International experience and a double degree are a clear plus.

  • Languages: fluent in written and spoken English. Mastering French is not required.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in fairness in artificial intelligence, available at the Department of Informatics, in the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group.

Starting date as soon as possible/by agreement. The fellowship period is three (3) years.

Depending on the candidate and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended either for compulsory work consisting of e.g., teaching and supervision duties and research assistance up top four years.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is the Department of Informatics at Blindern, Oslo. 


Project description

The PhD fellow will be affiliated with the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group at the Department of Informatics and supervised by associate professor Anne-Marie George.

We are looking for a motivated and academically strong candidate to work on a project within fairness in artificial intelligence and machine learning. The candidate will investigate how to formally define, measure and reconcile different, at times conflicting, notions of fairness in AI systems, as well as the theoretical relationships between them.

Possible directions for the project include (the final scope will be developed together with the candidate, and it is not necessary to cover all topics):

  • Group fairness: developing and analysing algorithms and metrics for ensuring fair treatment of groups defined by protected attributes (e.g. gender, age, ethnicity, …).
  • Theoretical relations between fairness notions: studying the mathematical relationships, trade-offs, and impossibility results connecting different fairness definitions.
  • Intersectional fairness: exploring fairness guarantees for combinations of multiple protected attributes, and addressing the challenges of subgroup fairness, such as computational complexity, statistical reliability and data sparsity for fine-grained subgroups.

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in informatics/computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a closely related field. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Documented competence in machine learning at Master level
  • Documented programming skills
  • Minimum three documented mathematics or statistics courses with passing grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 30.11.2026 to complete the final exam.

Desired qualifications:

  • Programming experience, e.g. in Python, particularly for machine learning
  • Experience with machine learning theory, evaluation metrics, algorithmic fairness, statistics, or optimization is an advantage

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. For more information see:
http://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Strong analytical skills and critical thinking
  • Enthusiasm, creativity, self-motivation, perseverance and initiative
  • Ability to take responsibility for your work — including troubleshooting, acquiring additional skills and asking for help when needed

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you

  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

How to apply

jobs.title: Linear : Business Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**Type**: Full-time and permanent

**Location**: Helsinki

**Application deadline**: 20.09.2026

_Linear, a Finnish SaaS company founded in 2018, is well on its way to become the next Nordic tech success story: a strong product, a large market ready for change, and the ambition to redefine how an entire industry works._

_The company has grown into Finlands most used real estate software, with its platform already reaching customers across 20 countries. Were now looking for a BI professional to help turn its data into the next stage of international growth._

**Why Linear, why now?**

Linear is on a mission to modernize the real estate industry by replacing outdated tools with a single, powerful platform. Its core product, the Linear platform, brings together the most important tools real estate professionals need in their daily work, from sales and customer management to marketing. Behind the platform is a vast amount of data, covering the full customer journey from the first contact to completed deals, all running through Linears ecosystem.

Linear has established a market-leading position in Finland and is now expanding internationally. As the company and its products grow, so does the opportunity to make better use of the data already flowing through the platform. **_This is where you come in._**

We are looking for a **Business Intelligence Analyst** who combines hands-on BI skills with commercial curiosity. Someone who wants to join Linear not just for the role, but for what they are building together. A person who wants to understand customers, challenge existing solutions, and take real ownership of what reporting and analytics could become at Linear.

**What will you be doing?**

Your initial focus will be on developing the reporting capabilities within Linears SaaS product for its customers. You will work hands-on with Power BI, SQL, and Excel to build reporting solutions that help customers understand their business and make better use of their data.

You will also work directly with customers to understand their challenges, ask the right questions, and turn business needs into practical and visually appealing BI solutions. You will have considerable freedom to shape how reporting develops – from identifying what customers actually need to building and productizing solutions that can serve a growing international customer base.

As Linear grows, so can your role. You can take increasing ownership of the BI product, contribute to its commercial development, and eventually help build a broader analytics offering around it. **What makes you a great fit?**

We are looking for a person to take full ownership of Linears reporting and help shape its future. You are excited by the opportunity to join a scale-up and contribute to its international growth. Rather than being discouraged by things that are still taking shape, you see the opportunity to build, improve, and leave your own mark.

You combine this mindset with a solid foundation in BI and a genuine interest in business. Power BI, SQL, and Excel are familiar tools to you, but you also want to understand the customers and business behind the data. You ask questions, connect different perspectives, and think about how your work can create value beyond the report itself.

You thrive when you are trusted with responsibility rather than handed a detailed task list. You take initiative, find out what you dont yet know, and bring your own ideas into the discussion. And if your background is more technical – for example, you have end-to-end data pipeline experience or have worked in data engineering – we also encourage you to apply if the broader business and ownership side of the role resonates with you.

**We expect you to have:**

- Professional experience with Power BI and the ability to independently build practical BI solutions

- Good SQL skills and an understanding of databases and working with data

- Ability to connect hands-on BI work with customer and business needs

- A proactive and independent approach to solving problems and taking ownership in a fast-evolving growth company environment

- A mindset oriented towards business and growth

- Professional proficiency in English and Finnish and the ability to work directly with clients in Finnish


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience collaborating with customers or business stakeholders to understand reporting needs

- Interest in productization, analytics, product thinking, or future product ownership

- Understanding of performance optimization for large datasets

- Curiosity toward new tools, automation, or AI-assisted development


**We can offer you:**

- The freedom to take ownership of BI and influence what gets built, why it matters, and how it develops

- A chance to productize data into solutions and see their impact with customers and across new international markets

- Room to grow toward BI product ownership and help shape Linears broader analytics offering over time

- An environment where you can test ideas and turn good ones into action without layers of heavy decision-making

- An opportunity to join Linears option program and have a personal stake in the companys future


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by Linear. The ideal start time in the role is as soon as possible. The role will be located in Helsinki, and we hope you are able to visit the office from time to time as part of a flexible hybrid model, especially during the onboarding phase.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary. You can familiarize yourself with Linear here: https://linear.fi/en/. For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalents Recruitment Consultant Veera Kokko (+358 44 783 5666, veera.kokko\[at\]atalent.fi).

jobs.title: Scientist / Senior Scientist in Mass Spectrometry-based Proteome Research
jobs.description:
About Us

The Helsinki Proteomics Center (HPC) is a state-of-the-art technology platform operating across two life-science campuses at the University of Helsinki. Dedicated to advancing proteomics research, we provide cutting-edge services and collaborate with researchers to explore protein functions, interactions, and dynamics. This position is based at the Viikki Proteomics Unit, which is part of the Helsinki Proteomics Center.

Your Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist / Senior Scientist to join the Viikki Proteomics Unit. This is primarily a hands-on core-facility position: the appointee will help deliver reliable proteomics services, support facility users, maintain robust daily operations, and develop methods that can be implemented across the HPC service portfolio. The role is therefore best suited to a collaborative scientist who is motivated by enabling the research of others as well as advancing proteomics technology.

Key Responsibilities

Research and Development
* Investigate and evaluate new sample preparation protocols for bottom-up proteomics, including protein digestion, peptide clean-up, enrichment of post-translationally modified peptides, and handling sub-nanogram protein quantities.
* Optimize protocols for sensitivity, specificity, and reproducibility, and evaluate new MS data-acquisition and analysis workflows for implementation as new or improved HPC services.


Operational Support
* Perform day-to-day technical operation of the high-resolution LC-MS/MS systems.
* Prepare customer and internal samples using validated facility protocols.
* Participate in routine maintenance of existing equipment, quality-control checks, and troubleshooting.
* Maintain accurate records of instrument usage, downtime, maintenance, and experimental procedures.


Collaboration and Communication
* Work closely with HPC colleagues to maintain an efficient, safe, and well-organized core-facility laboratory, and coordinate priorities to deliver high-quality results within agreed timelines.
* Advise facility users on experimental design, sample requirements, available technologies, instrument capabilities and limitations, and realistic expected outcomes.
* Prepare clear reports, discuss results and appropriate next steps with users, and provide evidence-based recommendations to HPC leadership on new platforms, methods, and technologies.


Administrative Duties
* Oversee inventory and coordinate procurement to ensure uninterrupted operation of the Viikki Proteomics Unit.
* Work with service contract providers to restore operations of the LC-MS/MS system promptly after system downtime.


Qualifications

Educational Background
* Master's degree required; Ph.D. preferred in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, or a related life science discipline.

Experience
* 2+ years of research experience with proteomic or related technologies.
* Strong background in protein chemistry is required.
* Experience in mass spectrometry-based proteomics is highly preferred.

Technical Skills
* Proficiency in using both vendor-specific and publicly available software tools for MS data analysis.
* Detail-oriented both at the lab bench and with record-keeping.
* Good command of English, both written and spoken.


Soft Skills
* Excellent time management and organizational abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a collaborative, service-oriented team environment.
* Willingness to learn, standardize, document, and routinely apply a range of sample preparation protocols.
* Ability to provide demonstrations and training to facility users with varying levels of proteomics experience.
* Motivation to expand data-analysis expertise and contribute to user support and reporting.


What We Offer
* The salary is based on the Finnish university salary system, depending on qualifications and experience.
* The University of Helsinki provides occupational health services, staff well-being resources, access to sports facilities, and extensive opportunities for professional development.
* You will join a world-class research community, work with cutting-edge technologies, and collaborate with leading experts in the field.


Join Us
Employment is expected to start on November-December, 2026, or as agreed. The position is initially offered for two years with the possibility of extension. A 6-month trial period will be applied. The formal title of the position will be determined according to the appointee's qualifications and experience: Research Coordinator/Postdoctoral Researcher / Specialist (for an appointee with a MSc).

How to Apply
Applications should be submitted through the University of Helsinki Recruitment System at [application link] by clicking the "Apply now" button.
For the relevant application enclosers and further information, please see our website.
Application deadline: September 30, 2026

jobs.title: Can you combine structured project delivery with a practical understanding of manufacturing and factory operations?
jobs.description:
Bergen Engines is entering an important phase of factory development and production ramp-up. To support this, we are strengthening the Special Projects team with one to two Project Managers who can lead cross-functional initiatives and help turn our operational ambitions into practical, executable projects. Reporting to the Head of Special Projects, you will work closely with Manufacturing, Assembly, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, HSE, Facilities and Finance. The project portfolio is expected to include assembly-capacity and ramp-up initiatives, factory layout and material-flow improvements, tooling and facility investments, CAPEX projects and other operational-improvement activities required to increase manufacturing capability towards 2028.     Your key responsibilities
  • Define project scope, objectives, deliverables and success criteria.
  • Develop and maintain credible project plans covering milestones, resources, costs and dependencies.
  • Coordinate cross-functional project teams and ensure clear ownership of actions.
  • Identify and manage project risks, issues, changes and key decisions.
  • Maintain accurate forecasts and escalate constraints or decisions early.
  • Support business cases, investment requests and CAPEX governance where applicable.
  • Work directly with factory teams to understand constraints and implement practical solutions.
  • Drive projects relating to capacity, throughput, assembly flow, material readiness, layout, tooling and process improvement.
  • Provide concise and transparent progress reporting to project sponsors and relevant governance forums.
  • Ensure that projects are delivered safely, on time, within approved cost and with measurable operational benefits.
  • Coordinate effective handover of completed projects into the responsible operational organisation.
Who are we looking for?  We are looking for people who combine structured project delivery with a practical understanding of manufacturing and factory operations. You may already work as a Project Manager, or you may have led substantial projects or workstreams within Manufacturing, Assembly, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Facilities or another relevant area.   Your qualifications: 
  • Education within technical fields and knowledge of manufacturing. If you have particularly long and relevant experience the education requirement may be disregarded. 
  • 8-10 years of experience from related role.
  • Experience from planning and delivering cross-functional projects or significant work packages.
  • A good understanding of complex engineering or manufacturing environments.
  • The ability to convert broad objectives into clear actions, milestones and accountabilities.
  • A practical and visible approach, including working directly with teams on the factory floor.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of project costs, benefits and priorities.
  • A strong commitment to safety, quality and sustainable operational improvement.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Fluent skills in both writing and orally in English and preferably also in Norwegian.
Knowledge of Bergen Engines’ products, manufacturing processes, assembly operations and internal systems will be an advantage. A formal project-management or relevant technical qualification is beneficial, but a demonstrated record of successful delivery is equally important.   Your personal characteristics
  • Ability to work independently towards goals. 
  • A good team player. 
  • Good cooperative and communicative skills. 
  • Structured and analytical. 
  • Curious and outgoing, not afraid to ask questions and suggest improvements. 
  • The confidence to challenge constructively, resolve obstacles and escalate decisions when necessary.
  • Strong coordination and stakeholder-management skills.
 

Why choose Bergen Engines?

For more than 80 years, Bergen Engines has delivered world-class power and propulsion systems to customers around the globe. Today, we're playing a key role in the maritime industry through innovative and efficient engine technology.

From our headquarters in Bergen, Norway, we work closely with customers worldwide, combining Norwegian engineering expertise with international reach. As part of the Langley Holdings Power Solutions Division, we're investing in growth, new markets, and the people who will help drive our future success.

These positions offer an opportunity to:
  • Contribute directly to Bergen Engines’ future manufacturing capability.
  • Lead visible projects with tangible operational impact.
  • Work across multiple functions and broaden your business experience.
  • Help shape how strategic factory projects are planned, governed and delivered.
  • Develop further within project management and operational leadership.

 

What we offer:

  • At Bergen Engines, you'll have the opportunity to work with advanced technology, international customers and colleagues who are passionate about what they do.
  • Meaningful work that contributes to a more sustainable future.
  • An international environment with exciting growth opportunities.
  • Professional and personal development in a technology-driven company.
  • Competitive salary and company-wide bonus scheme.
  • Flexible working hours and strong work-life balance.
  • Excellent pension and insurance arrangements.
  • Company cabin at Kvamskogen and employee discount programs.
  • Active sports clubs and social activities.
  • Occupational health services.
  • A highly skilled team that supports and challenges each other.

 

Are you ready to join our team?

At Bergen Engines, you'll join one of Norway's leading industrial technology companies and help deliver the power solutions that keep the world moving.

Work location is our headquarters and production facility at Hordvikneset, approximately 20 km north of Bergen city centre.

The position reports to Head of Special Projects- Nanda Kishore. 

For questions please contact: Nanda per mobile +4748286461 or e-mail nanda.kishore@bergenengines.com

Application deadline: 20.09.2026. Applications will be reviewed continuously.


Bergen Engines bygger og utvikler medium speed-motorer til landbaserte anlegg og til applikasjoner i den maritime næringen. Våre motorer er kjent for kvalitet og pålitelighet, og har en ingeniørtradisjon som strekker seg tilbake til 1855 da Bergen Mekaniske Verksted (BMV) ble etablert. Bedriften bygde sin første dieselmotor i 1946, og siden den gang har over 7500 motorer blitt levert der over halvparten fortsatt er i drift i dag. Tidligere kjent som Rolls-Royce Bergen Engines, ble bedriften en del av det britiske, privateide ingeniørselskapet Langley Holdings plc. 31. desember 2021.
