This role will be based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

You’ll build the systems that let any knowledge worker leverage fast, scalable databases without having to become a DBA.

You’ll be a hands-on technical leader, helping set the architectural direction and roadmap as we take a new product from early alpha to general availability. You’ll work directly with early customers to shape foundational technical and product decisions. Then, together, we’ll work on scaling as adoption and workloads grow.

This is a backend-leaning role with work spanning the stack. You might build the systems that provision and manage a fleet of customer Postgres instances, design how user-defined schemas evolve safely, or make complex queries execute efficiently. You’ll also follow those systems into the product: improving how a table loads, how users understand a slow operation, or how an agent safely works with their data.

You’ll help shape the architecture and the product together. Some problems call for a better abstraction, others for a better default, and others for rethinking what we ask the user to do in the first place. You’ll work with teammates and customers to find those answers, ship practical solutions, and evolve them as usage grows.



Our stack includes Postgres, Go, TypeScript, Node.js, and React.




ABOUT THE TEAM:

The people who understand a business best aren’t always the people who can build its software. A support lead knows how tickets should be triaged. An operations manager knows how inventory should move. But turning that knowledge into a reliable system often means finding an engineer, provisioning a database, and building an application.

We’re building database infrastructure for everyone else. We want everyday knowledge workers to bring their data into Notion, connect it, and build workflows around it. And do so with the power of a real database (Postgres!) and the approachability of a tool they already know.

AI agents make that opportunity even bigger: helping people build and operate systems they couldn’t have created on their own.

For our team, this is much more than putting a friendly interface on Postgres. It means making hard database problems disappear from the user’s workflow without sacrificing correctness, performance, or flexibility. How do you let someone reshape a live database as easily as editing a document? Make the right indexes exist without asking someone to become a DBA? Let a weekend experiment grow into a company’s system of record without anyone having to rearchitect it?




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Take a new product from alpha to general availability. Work with early customers to understand what matters, iterate on feedback, and help shape what we ship.

 - Make real customer workloads fast. Improve query execution, indexing, and client data loading so performance holds up as datasets grow and workflows become more demanding.

 - Build systems businesses can trust with their data. Make schema changes, concurrent writes, permissions, and recovery reliable enough for customers to build essential workflows on top.

 - Make powerful capabilities approachable. Turn database provisioning, migrations, and indexes into a reliable, easy-to-use product experience that gives people the power of a database without the burden of managing one.

 - Build for the customers who come next. Automate database provisioning and fleet operations, strengthen observability, and evolve the architecture so we can serve many, many customers.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Production relational database experience (e.g., Postgres or MySQL). You’ve made decisions about schemas and indexes, analyzed database performance, and debugged issues involving transactions, locking, or concurrency. Your experience goes beyond accessing a database through an ORM.

 - Engineering experience and technical leadership. You bring 10+ years of experience building and operating production software, with a track record of setting technical direction and leading complex, cross-team initiatives from concept through delivery. You identify the most important problems to solve, turn ambiguous goals into a technical strategy, and align engineers and partner teams around a practical plan. You stay hands-on while helping others make better decisions through design reviews, mentorship, and clear technical guidance.

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals. You’ve built services that need to remain correct under concurrency and failure. You can reason about retries, partial failures, consistency, and the trade-offs involved in reliable reads and writes.

 - A systematic approach to performance. You use query plans, traces, profiles, and experiments to find bottlenecks and verify improvements. You’re willing to follow a problem across storage, services, and client code rather than stopping at a team boundary.

 - Product judgment. You’re interested in who will use what you build, not just how it works. You can turn a customer’s problem into a technical approach and recognize when a better default or simpler workflow would solve it more effectively.

 - Willingness to work across the stack. You bring backend depth, but you’re comfortable learning unfamiliar systems and working in client code when that’s what delivering a good experience requires.

 - Fluency with AI-assisted engineering. You use AI to accelerate exploration, implementation, and testing while taking responsibility for understanding and validating the result.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience managing fleets of databases or building database platforms, including provisioning, upgrades, backups, and recovery.

 - Deep Postgres expertise, such as advanced query optimization, performance tuning, or workload isolation for large datasets and high-concurrency workloads.

 - Experience building query layers, sync engines, change-data-capture pipelines, permission systems, or other reusable data abstractions.

DIRECTEUR / DIRECTRICE D'HÔTEL - SAISON D'HIVER (H/F)
jobs.description:
**Entreprise**

Madame Vacances est un acteur majeur de l'hôtellerie et des résidences de tourisme en France, proposant des séjours dans des destinations variées, de la montagne à la mer. Rejoindre nos équipes, c'est partager notre passion pour l'accueil et contribuer chaque jour à offrir à nos clients des vacances inoubliables.

**Poste**

**Des clients heureux, des équipes heureuses, avant tout**

Nos Directeurs d'hôtel vivent et respirent la satisfaction client. Ils savent qu'un service exceptionnel repose sur toute une équipe partageant la même philosophie : nos clients consacrent un budget important à leurs vacances et méritent un excellent séjour.

**Contrat, rémunération et conditions**

Pour la saison d'hiver, nos Directeurs commencent généralement autour du 1er décembre et terminent environ une semaine après la fermeture de l'hôtel. Ils bénéficient d'un contrat cadre, avec l'autonomie et la flexibilité liées à leurs responsabilités. Le logement est fourni pendant toute la durée du contrat. Une prime de fin de saison peut être attribuée selon les performances.

Rémunération mensuelle indicative selon l'expérience et l'établissement :

- Plus de 65 chambres : 4 000 à 4 500 € brut, ou 6 000 à 6 500 € pour un couple assurant ensemble la direction.

- 40 à 65 chambres : 3 300 à 3 800 € brut, ou 5 000 à 6 000 € pour un couple.

- Hôtels plus petits : 2 500 à 3 300 € brut, ou 4 500 à 5 200 € pour un couple.

**Profil et responsabilités**

Nos Directeurs arrivent dans un hôtel préparé pour la saison : personnel recruté, fournisseurs référencés, produits et services définis et organisation mise en place. Leur mission est de faire fonctionner cette organisation efficacement, tout en assurant les dernières ventes localement lorsque des chambres restent disponibles.

Ils consacrent l'essentiel de leur temps aux clients et aux équipes : organisation des plannings, management des responsables de service, communication avec le siège, suivi du reporting et présence active dans l'établissement.

Dans un hôtel, les imprévus font partie du quotidien : absences, problèmes techniques, neige, arrivées tardives, clients difficiles ou services particulièrement chargés. Nos Directeurs sont donc avant tout des personnes de terrain, capables de retrousser leurs manches lorsque nécessaire.

Cela peut signifier aider au bar, faire la plonge, préparer des chambres avec l'équipe housekeeping, déneiger une terrasse, porter des bagages ou prendre personnellement en charge un client rencontrant un problème.

Ils dirigent par l'exemple, assument leurs responsabilités et trouvent des solutions sans attendre systématiquement l'intervention du siège.

Ils veillent à ce que les équipes soient ponctuelles, professionnelles, correctement présentées et pleinement tournées vers le client. Ils gèrent les problématiques RH quotidiennes, assurent la bonne organisation des plannings et veillent à une excellente communication entre les différents services.

Qu'ils excellent dans la délégation ou préfèrent être très présents sur le terrain, nos Directeurs savent intervenir personnellement lorsque la situation l'exige.

**Ce qui compte, c'est le résultat**

jobs.title: Business Operations & Strategy
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This is an opportunity to serve as a key partner and advisor on Notion’s Business Operations team, working primarily with our Engineering, Product, & Design teams. Business Operations is a cross-functional team that partners with senior leaders across the company, focusing on high-impact strategic projects and analysis. In this role, you’ll work hand-in-hand with leadership to identify, structure, and act on the most challenging strategic and operational questions impacting our business.



This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Build trusted relationships with cross-functional leaders to define and implement strategy across all Notion products, driving increased value to our users and our business

 - Structure complex, ambiguous strategic problems for the Notion leadership team, defining clear hypotheses and building detailed business cases and quantitative models that will inform and influence our approach

 - Work closely with cross-functional leaders to define and manage key drivers of business performance, identifying areas of opportunity and incorporating them into your work

 - Develop a comprehensive understanding of our competitive positioning by using, assessing, and developing insights about peer businesses to inform your recommendations

 - Deeply understand Notion customers and the broader market landscape to uncover insights that inform your recommendations

 - Create scalable solutions that combine a broad vision for what is possible with an understanding of the practical demands that constrain them




SKILLS YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years of strategy experience, including 2+ years of experience in management consulting or a related field

 - Excellent quantitative and financial modeling skills, with the attention to detail and quality bar required for decisions that affect products and the business

 - Outstanding executive-level written and verbal communication skills; can operate independently with senior stakeholders and manage relationships, deliverables, and timelines with minimal supervision

 - Genuine enthusiasm for and proficiency with AI tools; we use AI across the board to move faster and work smarter, and you do too

 - Hands-on fluency with modern AI tools such as Notion AI, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar; you actively experiment with new models and workflows and use judgment to apply them responsibly

 - Data self-sufficiency, including working knowledge of SQL and the ability to access, assess, and synthesize relevant data without relying on outside support

 - Comfort working in a high-growth, constantly changing environment with passion and enthusiasm




NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in strategy and operations in B2B SaaS businesses

 - Experience with pricing & packaging, especially for AI products



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $175,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Position: 5-Axis CNC Machine Setter / Operator Company: N & E Precision Engineering Location: Longford, Ireland Salary: €38 to €42K / annum Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent Reporting to: Production Manager About the Role N & E Precision Engineering is seeking an experienced 5-Axis CNC Machine Setter / Operator to join our precision engineering team in Longford. The successful candidate will be responsible for setting up, proving out and operating CNC milling machines to manufacture high-precision components in accordance with engineering drawings, specifications and quality requirements. The role will involve working with 3-, 4-, and 5-axis CNC machining, with previous CNC programming experience being a significant advantage. Key Responsibilities • Set up and operate CNC milling machines, including 3-, 4-, and 5-axis equipment. • Prepare tooling, workholding, offsets and machine settings. • Read and interpret engineering drawings, tolerances and GD&T requirements. • Program, edit and prove out CNC programs where required. • Manufacture precision components to the required quality standards. • Carry out first-off and in-process dimensional inspections using appropriate measuring equipment. • Make authorised program and offset adjustments where required. • Maintain accurate setup sheets, tooling lists and production documentation. • Identify and report machine, tooling or quality issues. • Maintain CNC machines and the working area in a clean, safe and organised condition. • Work closely with Production, Quality and Maintenance teams. • Follow all company health and safety and quality procedures. Requirements • Previous experience as a CNC Setter / Operator in a precision engineering or manufacturing environment. • Experience with CNC milling and 4- or 5-axis machining. • Ability to read and understand engineering drawings. • Experience with dimensional inspection and precision measuring equipment. • Good understanding of CNC tooling, offsets and machine setup. • CNC programming experience is a significant advantage. • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality and safety. • Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Working Hours The successful candidate may be required to work either: • Day Shift: 8:00 am – 4:30 pm • Evening Shift: 4:30 pm – 1:00 am Shift allocation will depend on operational requirements. Career Opportunity This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced CNC professional to join a precision engineering environment and further develop their 5-axis machining, setup and programming skills. Candidates with previous aerospace or other high-precision manufacturing experience are particularly encouraged to apply. How to apply? Please forward CV to gustavo.cainelli@guspes.com Application Process: We aim to respond to all applicants within 10 working days. Our dynamic portfolio – including ultra-long range flagship LiDAR sensor Falcon, mid-to-short range LiDAR sensor Robin and perception service software platform OmniVidi – powers automotive and ITS solutions for partners like NIO, Faraday Future, Exwayz and Hexagon. Senior Director of Sales, Europe

SIMPL Business Unit — Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS)

Seyond

Location: Germany preferred (open to strong candidates elsewhere in Europe)

Reports to: Philip Lassner, Head of Global ITS Business (ex-US/China)

Team: SIMPL Business Unit — LiDAR-based smart intersection and highway detection

Employment type: Full-time

About Seyond SIMPL

SIMPL is scaling its international footprint across Europe, APAC, and emerging markets, and is building out dedicated regional sales leadership to match the growth already underway in the Americas.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Director of Sales to build and lead SIMPL's sales function across Europe — a role modeled on the regional sales leadership Seyond has already established in the Americas. You will report directly to Philip Lassner, Head of Global ITS Business, and will sit above SIMPL's country-level sales representatives across Europe, giving the region a single accountable sales leader for the first time.

This is a player-coach role. What You'll Do

  • Build and lead SIMPL's European sales organization, recruiting, onboarding, and coaching country and regional sales representatives.

  • Fluent English required; German or another major European language is a plus.

Competitive base and incentive package, benchmarked to Director-level sales leadership roles in the European technology/industrial sector. Final compensation band to be confirmed following market benchmarking.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Marketplace
jobs.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Mirakl Connect Engineering team lead by Jean-Yves Cazac, Engineering Director. The team consists of approximately 50 engineers covering the full Mirakl Connect product scope, from seller onboarding and experience to marketplace integrations and channel management. Together, you'll be shaping how sellers and brands connect, operate, and grow across multiple marketplaces worldwide.

In this role, you will directly lead 2 squads — Seller Experience and Channel Integration — representing approximately 12 engineers based between Paris, & Bordeaux, with close collaboration with colleagues based in the US.

Location: Based in Paris or Bordeaux office with one day of remote work per week.

 

Your Impact

  • Lead and develop two engineering squads responsible for the seller journey on Mirakl Connect and integrations with external marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart, and Zalando, ensuring reliable delivery and a high engineering bar across both teams.
  • Partner closely with Product and Design to define priorities, translate business needs into execution plans, and make trade-offs that balance delivery speed, quality, and technical sustainability.
  • Drive the technical direction of your scope — challenging architectural choices, ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable, and raising best practices in testing, observability, and incident management.
  • Develop your people: coach engineers and tech leads, identify growth opportunities, run performance and career conversations, and contribute to attracting strong talent into the organization.
  • Build a strong operating model for your teams — improving ways of working pragmatically, protecting team focus, fostering ownership, and enabling effective collaboration with distributed and international stakeholders.

 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • At least 4 to 5 years of experience managing engineering teams, with a track record of leading teams of 5 to 6 engineers or more, ideally across multiple squads.
  • Proven experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, channel management, feed management, catalog or order management — or a closely related domain.
  • A solid Java background — you may no longer be hands-on today, but you have the depth to challenge architectural decisions, assess technical trade-offs, and manage a team of Java engineers with credibility.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver in a demanding and fast-moving environment, while protecting team focus and adapting your management approach to the existing context.
  • Experience collaborating with international and cross-functional stakeholders across time zones.

Skills:

  • Engineering leadership: ability to set direction, delegate effectively, and develop people at all levels.
  • Execution in complexity: capable of managing delivery, priorities, and trade-offs across multiple teams simultaneously.
  • Technical judgment: able to engage in Java architecture discussions, challenge integration design choices, and guide engineers on complex distributed systems.
  • Fluent English: able to lead discussions, challenge decisions, and collaborate autonomously with US-based and international partners.

 

Tech Stack

  • Java (recent versions)
  • Spring Framework
  • SQL
  • Cloud platforms
  • Microservices architecture

 

Languages

  • French: Full professional proficiency
  • English mandatory: Full professional proficiency — approximately 50% of your working time will be in English

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

  1. 30/45 min call with a Talent Acquisition to discuss your key projects, ask technical questions, and present the position in details
  2. 1 hour Hiring Manager interview 
  3. 2x45 min STAR interviews to assess your alignment with our values and meet other stakeholders

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

jobs.title: Kloakarbejder
jobs.description:
Kloakmedarbejder med erfaring søges - ansøger uden erfaring kommer ikke i betragtning

Vi søger dig, der bor i området omkring Roskilde, Slangerup, Hillerød eller det nordlige Sjælland - du kører ud fra din hjemadresse.

Bor du uden for området, men tænker, at stillingen passer perfekt til dig, så send endelig en ansøgning alligevel – måske er det netop dig, vi står og mangler.

Er du klar til en spændende og varieret hverdag i en virksomhed, der har gang i mange forskellige opgaver?

Vi leder efter dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere, der vil være med til at levere service og løsninger inden for skadedyrsbekæmpelse, kloakopgaver, tv-inspektion og entreprenøropgaver i hele Danmark.

Hvem er vi?

Vi er en virksomhed med 28 ansatte, der arbejder i et dynamisk og udfordrende miljø, hvor ikke to dage er ens. Vi løber stærkt, men vi værdsætter sammenhold og gode kolleger, der støtter hinanden i en travl hverdag.

Vi søger dig, der:

• Der har erfaring med kloakarbejder og gerne uddannet som minimum rørlægger, gerne kloakmester eller anlægsstruktør.

• Har kørekort B eller BE og er klar på at bruge en del tid bag rattet.

• Er kunde- og serviceminded med en høflig og præsentabel fremtoning.

• Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret da du kommer til at køre alene – men også trives i et team.

• Har en positiv indstilling, god ordenssans og er mødestabil.

• Er fleksibel og klar til at håndtere både lange og korte arbejdsdage.

Vi tilbyder:

• Et selvstændigt job med frihed under ansvar.

  • Du bliver tilknyttet fast korrdinator så du er aldrig alene, hvis du får brug for hurtig hjælp.

• Afvekslende opgaver som servicearbejde, montering af rottespær og mindre entreprenøropgaver.

• Firmabil.

• Løn efter aftale, inkl. pension og sundhedssikring.

• 6. ferieuge.

• En arbejdsplads med gode kollegaer og stærkt sammenhold.

• Fri hver anden fredag

Ansøg nu!

Er du klar til nye udfordringer og en hverdag med variation og udvikling?

Send din ansøgning til anjadahl@email.dk eller kontakt os direkte på 51337072 spørg efter Pelle.

Vi ansætter løbende, så vent ikke med at sende din ansøgning – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Les conditions
- CDI
- Temps plein
- Répartition sur 5 ou 6 jours
- 38 heures par semaine

La structure
Vous rejoindrez un établissement médical pluridisciplinaire implanté à Rogliano, à proximité de Cosenza, en Calabre. L'établissement est spécialisé dans le diagnostic, le traitement, la prévention et la réadaptation, avec une prise en charge personnalisée reposant sur des technologies modernes et une équipe multidisciplinaire. En outre, le service de médecine physique et de réadaptation est conventionné avec le Service national de santé italien et prend en charge les pathologies du système musculo-squelettique et du système nerveux. Les patients bénéficient d'examens d'imagerie réalisés sur place et d'un parcours de rééducation intégrant thérapies manuelles et techniques modernes.

- Rémunération selon la convention collective nationale italienne CCNL AIOP RSA, niveau D2

- Prendre en charge les troubles de la communication, du langage, de la parole et de la déglutition
- Évaluer les patients et établir des bilans orthophoniques précis
- Mettre en place des programmes de rééducation personnalisés
- Collaborer avec les équipes médicales et paramédicales dans une approche multidisciplinaire
- Suivre l'évolution des patients et adapter les prises en charge
- Contribuer à la qualité et à la continuité des soins

- Logement pris en charge pendant les 6 premiers mois
- Accompagnement administratif pour faciliter l'installation en Italie
- Contrat à durée indéterminée proposé en priorité avec possibilités de collaboration indépendante selon profil
- Équipe pluridisciplinaire et prise en charge personnalisée des patients
- Accès à l'imagerie et aux techniques de rééducation sur site

Rogliano bénéficie d'un emplacement proche de Cosenza, ville universitaire et culturelle, et offre un accès rapide à la diversité des paysages de la Calabre, entre zones littorales et massifs intérieurs, pour des sorties nature et une qualité de vie agréable.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Notion EMEA Recruiting team acts as trusted business partners who craft a thorough, inclusive, and curated interviewing experience. We believe hiring exceptional talent, at the right time, is the best path forward to achieve our company’s ambitious goals.

We’re looking for a Go-to-Market Recruiter to support our growth across key Go-to-Market (GTM) teams in EMEA, with an emphasis on Sales. In this role, you'll help shape our recruiting strategy, manage full-cycle hiring efforts, and ensure a delightful yet rigorous hiring process.

This role will be based in Paris. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Serve as a trusted recruiting partner to leaders across the GTM org, owning the full recruiting lifecycle from sourcing through successful close

 - Design and implement creative sourcing strategies to attract diverse top talent across EMEA markets

 - Ensure scalable and structured hiring plans with consistent evaluation processes while creating thoughtful candidate experiences

 - Partner with cross-functional teams including Total Rewards, People Operations, and People Partners to drive holistic talent strategies

 - Leverage AI tools, to innovate recruiting processes and provide data-driven insights on market conditions

 - Champion and scale best practices while thoughtfully adapting for regional nuances




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in high-growth, technical, GTM functions

 - Fluency in French and English

 - Proven track record of identifying, qualifying, and closing exceptional talent across various levels

 - Experience coaching and advising hiring managers through our recruiting process while keeping talent density as a priority

 - Ability to build diverse candidate pipelines and guide hiring managers in creating inclusive teams

 - Outstanding communication, attention to detail, and interpersonal skills with a commitment to delivering high-quality recruiting experiences

 - Ability to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Passionate about leveraging technology and AI to transform recruiting processes



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.description:

Tu seras au cœur de son développement sur toutes les plateformes web/iOS/Android.
Chez Hello Watt, nous sommes convaincus que l'IA transforme en profondeur le métier de développeur. Nous cherchons des ingénieurs enthousiastes à l'idée d'explorer et de définir, ensemble, les contours de ce que sera demain notre nouveau métier de développeur.
Tes missions :
- Implémenter de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur l'application Hello Watt (web/iOS/Android)

- Développer les intégrations api de pilotage d'appareil : onduleurs solaires, thermostats, bornes de recharge de véhicules électriques

- Intégrer des fonctionnalités de flexibilité énergétique et d'effacement (programmation intelligente, pilotage selon les signaux de production solaire/tension du réseau, etc.).

- Maintenir un haut niveau de qualité sur le code, qu'il soit écrit à la main ou généré par IA via des revues exigeantes, des tests solides et la mise en place d'outils pour améliorer les agents IA.

- Contribuer activement à l'outillage et aux workflows IA de l'équipe : prompts et conventions partagés, garde-fous, quality gates et boucles de feedback pour améliorer en continu la qualité du code généré

- Concevoir l'évolution de l'architecture de la plateforme

Profil recherché
À l'ère où l'IA accélère la production de code, nous cherchons des ingénieurs qui ne se concentrent pas uniquement sur l'implémentation: poser les bons problèmes, comprendre les utilisateurs, et tenir l'architecture sur le long terme.
Compétences clés recherchées :

- User & UX focus : sensibilité forte à l'expérience utilisateur et à la valeur livrée

- System architecture : vision système, capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture web modulaire, scalable et maintenable

- AI-native mindset : pratique avancée des outils d'IA pour le développement, esprit critique sur leurs sorties, et envie de contribuer à élever la pratique de toute l'équipe

Compétences techniques recherchées :
- Expérience confirmée en développement web avec python (Django, Flask, Sanic, FastAPI.) et avec un framework javascript (React, Vue, Angular.)

- Au moins 5 années d'expérience dans un poste similaire, au sein d'un environnement de travail mettant l'expérience utilisateur au coeur des préoccupations

- Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement : typage & lint de code, tests unitaires et fonctionnels, documentation, revues de code, architecture modulaire par domaines métie

Autres compétences recherchées :
- Volonté de travailler sur des produits à impact

- Goût pour les belles choses

- Volonté de progresser, individuellement et en équipe

- Enthousiasme à explorer comment l'IA peut élever notre métier, nos produits et nos workflows

Environnement technique:
Backend
- Language & Frameworks : Python avec Django (REST APIs, ORM, Admin)

- Orchestration de taches: Celery

- Cache : Redis

Frontend Web
- Language : TypeScript / JavaScript

- Framework: ReactJs

- Styling : Design System Hello Watt + Tailwind CSS

- Approche hybride : Webviews intégrées via CapacitorJS (compatibilité iOS/Android)

- Partage de code : Réutilisation du code web en natif

Base de Données
- SQL : MySQL pour les données relationnelles

Infrastructure & Déploiement
- Cloud Provider : AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, S3, RDS, etc.)

Outils & Collaboration

Tu veux utiliser la data pour proposer des services permettant de réduire l'empreinte carbone et les factures d'énergie ?
Ne cherche plus, viens chez Hello Watt !
Nos valeurs :
- Impact more : nous accompagnons les particuliers dans la transition énergétique et nous utilisons la tech pour leur permettre de maîtriser leur consommation. Nous visons grand pour maximiser cet impact.

jobs.title: Chief of staff/GTM to Raphaël Vullierme (Hexa Partner)
jobs.description:
About Hexa

Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies.

We are a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe that designs, builds and launches category-defining startups. We are today recognized as one of the best venture studios in the world, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds.

We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign. We are passionate about B2B software, particularly AI-native and agentic SaaS, fintech, climate tech, etc.

Hexa is in full growth mode, with three early-stage activities: our Ventures programs Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint which help entrepreneurs go from zero to one, and a PE program, Hexa Scale, which takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds.


The AI-native vertical at Hexa: WTF

WTF (“Walk The Frontier”) is leading Hexa’s effort at the frontier of AI model and led by Raphaël Vullierme, a repeat founder who built Luko France #1 online home insurer now part of Allianz, previous CEO of OpenJet an uber for private aviation, and started out launching ventures at Rocket Internet. We build companies with Europe’s best founders, global from day zero, with offices in Paris and San Francisco.

We’re building across three theses:

  1. Physical AI / Defense / Infrastructure to answer European sovereignty need.
    This means we are building real technology with very fast time to market and value by moving atoms and not only bits.

  2. AI is the buyer.
    Buying decision are being taken by Agent or from an AI analysis. AI process more data and is less irrational / emotional than human. Cost to compare, switch, quote is trending to 0. This will have an enormous impact on market, what get sold or buy way beyond retail and ecommerce. This will much more transformative to the economy than the efficiency gains most AI startup currently focus on.

  3. Financial Services & Regulated business.
    Raphael was CEO of a full stack & regulated insurer. AI is eating the moat of large Financial institution and we are working to re-invent risk and capital is being moved and allocated.

We started in Jan 26 and so far WTF has had a very prolific year building 3 companies. The 2 first raised large seed 4 from TopTier VC 4month after the inception in 2 very different vertical.

  • WaniWani Agentic Commerce Infrastructure for financial services. Leading Banks, Insurers such as Chubb, Satender, BPI, Axa, Generali runs their AI distribution (selling insurance/mortgage to AI agent - on chatGPT/Gemini…) on Waniwani platform. Several million in ARR reach on Year 1 with US being fastest growing market.

  • Pelagon is building a foundational acoustic AI model for autonomous maritime protection, deployed across a distributed network of underwater and surface vectors to give European navies real-time understanding of underwater threats. Working with several EU navies and deployed commercially.

It is a rare role to build category-defining companies learn how they get built, from the inside, at the frontier of AI. High intensity team, high challenge, high worker and learned.

The mission

We’re looking for a Chief of Staff to be the execution backbone of WTF: right hand to Raphaël and to our founders, bringing an operator’s rigor to fast-moving, still-forming teams. The role splits into two:

80% - real company-building

Hands-on helping our founders operate their companies across the whole lifecycle, from early discovery and scoping a new idea, through founder search, to building and scaling once it’s live.

  • Go-to-market, your main focus: you own GTM for each company: positioning, first customers, sales, pricing, go-to-market experiments, and the tools, automations and trackers needed to run them. Hexa’s central pool covers product and design; GTM sits with you. You are part of the company and our growth depend on you.

  • In the operational rhythm of each company: weekly kick-offs, product meetings, end-of-week recaps. You own the cadence, objectives set, notes written, decisions tracked, and leverage AI so we focus our time on building and selling not writing down plans.

  • The founders’ first port of call on anything outside their own scope, and the interface between the ventures and the rest of Hexa (Finance, Legal, Talent, Comms), pulling in the right resource when a project needs it.

20% - studio operations

  • How we run as a studio: keeping the machine sharp and the founder pipeline full.

  • Discovery transforming new ideas into tangible opportunities: discovery outreach and meeting, market sizing, value chain, positioning, the opportunity note that gets a project greenlit.

  • Growing the founder pipeline: working with the Talent team on the sourcing strategy for each new project, gathering top talent in the industry and making WTF visible to the best potential founders and ecosystem players.

  • Building visibility: working with the brand team on Raphaël’s and the studio’s reputation.

  • Improving how the studio (and Hexa) runs: sharpening shared AI agent and tooling (GTM ex: github repo), playbooks and best practice (ex: grokbot rollout), and reusable systems that make the studio & Hexa as a whole compound over time.

Who we’re looking for.

jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Postdoctoral Researcher Position Deep Learning for Functional-Oxide Growth Video-to-Spectrum Prediction by RHEED / XRD Fusion
jobs.description:
PROJECT OVERVIEW

We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE).

The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon.

A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools.

Scientific context. Epitaxial perovskite-oxide thin films exhibit rich, tunable functional properties (thermoelectricity, ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity) governed by their structure and composition, themselves correlated with the growth conditions. MBE offers independent control of each element but, applied to oxides, is notoriously unstable and poorly reproducible because of the oxidising atmosphere. RHEED tracks the surface dynamics in real time (lattice parameter, surface reconstructions, roughness) but does not give access to the final bulk microstructure, which is only reachable ex situ via XRD / XRR. There is therefore a strong physical link – so far unexploited quantitatively – between RHEED dynamics and final XRD microstructure, which OXYD-IA proposes to learn directly.

Figure 1 – OXYD-IA pipeline. At inference, the RHEED video acquired during growth (INL) feeds a deep video encoder (LIRIS) and a probabilistic regression module that predicts the final XRD spectrum together with its uncertainty. During training, the predicted spectrum is compared with the ex situ XRD / XRR spectrum measured at INL (ground truth); this discrepancy is the supervised learning signal that adjusts the model parameters.

KEY RESEARCH AREAS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

You will drive the core computational research along a risk-managed, phased 12-month roadmap. The primary target is a versioned RHEED / XRD dataset, growth-regime classification and probabilistic regression of the key structural parameters with calibrated uncertainty; full-spectrum prediction, a real-time demonstrator and cross-oxide generalisation are stretch and follow-on objectives. The work is organised around three technical pillars:

1. Corpus structuring and spatio-temporal RHEED representation • Build a versioned dataset by cleaning, temporally aligning and pairing the RHEED video sequences, the associated MBE parameters (temperature, oxygen pressure, source fluxes) and the ex situ XRD / XRR spectra (SrTiO3 reference system). • Pre-train, in a self-supervised manner, a spatio-temporal video encoder (3D CNN, e.g. R(2+1)D, or temporal Vision Transformer) fine-tuned on the laboratory corpus. • Perform fuzzy / Bayesian classification of the growth regimes (2D vs. 3D modes, transitions, RHEED oscillations), building on LIRIS expertise in the statistical analysis of sequences.

2. Probabilistic RHEED →XRD regression with uncertainty quantification • Design a latent representation that couples the video encoding with the physical MBE parameters. • Learn stepwise – first scalar structural parameters (lattice parameter, density, mosaicity), more robust at small N, then the full 1D XRD spectrum. • Provide calibrated uncertainty estimates (Bayesian approaches or deep ensembles), indispensable for guiding real-time decisions during growth.

3. Real-time demonstrator and dissemination (stretch / follow-on) • Validate the model on new SrTiO3 growths and prototype an in-growth inference tool at the end of the NANOFUTUR MBE line. • Mitigate the small-data and generalisation challenges through temporal data augmentation, transfer learning from pre-trained video encoders and domain adaptation towards other functional oxides. • Contribute toward a high-impact joint publication at the AI / materials interface (the project milestone is the submission of a joint paper).


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• A Ph.D. in the field of Artificial Intelligence – Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or Signal Processing, and we are looking for a senior postdoc with 2–5 years of post-PhD experience.

• Deep learning on sequential / video data: demonstrable, hands-on experience with 3D CNNs, temporal transformers and / or probabilistic models. Proficiency in Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) is mandatory.

• A genuine appetite for physics: a strong curiosity for, or prior exposure to, experimental physics and materials science. The ideal candidate carried out an AI-focused Ph.D. and is eager to apply it to a real materials-physics problem.

• Research mindset: a track record of innovation and the ability to work autonomously on a complex, multidisciplinary project. • Software skills: experience with Git version control and reproducible research.

• Excellent communication and scientific-writing skills in English.

ADDITIONAL SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Self-supervised video pre-training, uncertainty quantification (Bayesian / ensembles), fuzzy classification, or domain adaptation.

• Experience with small-sample / transfer-learning settings and handling large-scale experimental datasets.

HOW TO APPLY

Please prepare a single PDF file containing:

1. A detailed Curriculum Vitae, including a list of publications.

2. A 1-page motivation letter explaining your specific interest in this project and how your background addresses the key responsibilities and qualifications listed above.

3. The names and contact information of at least two academic references.

EN ROLLE MED ANSVAR OG OVERBLIK

Som bogholder får du ansvar for en bred vifte af opgaver inden for økonomi og regnskab. Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

▪️ Daglig bogføring og finans ▪️ Kreditor- og debitorstyring ▪️ Bankafstemninger og betalinger ▪️ Momsafstemning og momsindberetning ▪️ Måneds- og årsafslutning ▪️ Løn og personaleadministration ▪️ Økonomiske rapporter og nøgletal ▪️ Afstemning af bilanlæg, lager og øvrige balanceposter ▪️ Kontakt til revisor ▪️ Løbende optimering og effektivisering af økonomiprocesserne

Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor du både arbejder selvstændigt med dine egne ansvarsområder og har tæt kontakt til resten af organisationen.

ET LILLE HUS MED STORE AMBITIONER

Škoda Nørresundby er en mindre, men ambitiøs bilforretning, hvor vi kender hinanden og hjælper hinanden på tværs af afdelingerne.

Hos os er der kort fra idé til handling, og vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes sammen.

Det gælder også økonomien. Vi har brug for en kollega, som ikke bare ser tal og posteringer, men som har lyst til at forstå forretningen og være med til at skabe struktur, overblik og gode processer.

Vi har en uformel omgangstone, et stærkt kollegaskab og en hverdag, hvor der også er plads til humor.

HVEM ER DU?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

▪️ Har erfaring fra en lignende stilling som bogholder ▪️ Har en relevant økonomisk uddannelse ▪️ Arbejder struktureret og detaljeorienteret ▪️ Er fortrolig med Excel og økonomisystemer ▪️ Har forståelse for regnskab fra A-Z ▪️ Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar ▪️ Er god til at samarbejde på tværs af organisationen ▪️ Har naturligt fokus på at skabe overblik og sikre, at tingene stemmer

HVAD FÅR DU HOS OS?

jobs.title: Fleksibelt lagerjob i Aalborg – vi søger dig, der kan tage fat
jobs.description:
Er du fysisk stærk, mødestabil og klar på et aktivt arbejde, hvor du får brugt kroppen? Så har vi måske jobbet til dig.

Vi søger løbende friske og fleksible vikarer til lagerarbejde i Aalborg, hvor du primært kommer til at arbejde med tømning af containere.

Der er tale om et fleksibelt vikarjob, hvor behovet kan variere fra uge til uge. Nogle uger er der 3-4 vagter, mens der andre uger ikke er behov er lige så travlt, hvor der også vil være færre vagter. Du bliver derfor en del af et stærkt og fleksibelt vikarhold, som kan træde til, når der kommer ekstra travlt.

Du kommer typisk til at arbejde sammen med et mindre team på 3-4 personer, hvor der altid vil være erfarne kolleger til at hjælpe dig godt i gang. 

Du bliver taget godt imod fra første dag og kommer til at arbejde sammen med både yngre og mere erfarne kolleger.

Der er en god og uformel stemning på arbejdspladsen, og du vil typisk arbejde sammen med de samme kolleger, når du tager vagter.

Din primære opgave bliver:

  • Tømning af containere

  • Håndtering og flytning af varer

  • Sortering og placering af varer

  • Generelt forefaldende lagerarbejde efter behov

Arbejdet er fysisk og indebærer løft af varer, så du skal være indstillet på en arbejdsdag, hvor du får brugt kroppen.

Detta söker vi:

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Er fysisk robust og ikke bange for at tage fat

  • Er mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også trives i et team

  • Er fleksibel og kan træde til med relativt kort varsel

  • Kan kende forskel på tal og læse simple informationer på varerne

  • Har en positiv indstilling og bidrager til den gode stemning

Det er ikke afgørende, om du har mange års lagererfaring. Der er plads til både dig, der har erfaring fra lager, og dig, der eksempelvis holder sabbatår og gerne vil tjene penge samtidig med, at du får en aktiv arbejdsdag.

Praktisk information:

Vagterne ligger typisk mandag til fredag kl. 08.00-16.00.

Behovet varierer meget afhængigt af, hvor mange containere der kommer ind. Derfor kan der være uger med flere vagter og perioder med færre eller ingen vagter.

Løn:

159,65 kr/timen + 10% fritvalgskonto og terminaltillæg på 15,5 kr/timen.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Hvis du er klar på fysisk arbejde, fleksible vagter og et godt team, så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Søg stillingen allerede i dag – så tager vi en snak om mulighederne og får dig med i vikarpuljen.

jobs.title: Senior klinikassistent til Herlev Dyrehospital/seeking an experienced and responsible Senior Veterinary Clinic Assistant
jobs.description:
Arbejdstid: fuldtid

Vi søger en erfaren og ansvarsbevidst senior klinikassistent til vores veterinærklinik. Du

bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift og vil have en central rolle i forbindelse med

klargøring af operationsafsnittet, vedligeholdelse af klinikkens udstyr og lager samt støtte

til veterinærer, sygeplejersker og øvrige klinikassistenter.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

• Klargøring af operationsstuen og det kirurgiske område til modtagelse af patienter.

• Klargøring og organisering af de nødvendige instrumenter, materialer og apparatur til

operationer og behandlinger.

• Sikre god hygiejne og rengøring af klinikkens områder, herunder reception,

operationsafsnit og opvågnings-/postoperative område.

• Daglig rengøring, vedligeholdelse og kontrol af laboratorieudstyr til blandt andet

blodprøver.

• Sikre, at klinikkens lager er opdateret, velorganiseret og korrekt opfyldt.

• Bestilling og indkøb af medicinske forbrugsvarer, materialer og øvrige nødvendige

produkter til klinikkens daglige drift.

• Assistere veterinærer og veterinærsygeplejersker med praktiske og kliniske opgaver

efter behov.

• Bidrage til, at den daglige arbejdsgang i klinikken fungerer effektivt og struktureret.

• Oplæring og introduktion af nye klinikassistenter og studerende.

• Bidrage til at sikre, at nye medarbejdere bliver fortrolige med klinikkens arbejdsgange,

hygiejneprocedurer, udstyr og rutiner.

Vi forventer, at du

• Har relevant erfaring fra en veterinærklinik, gerne med erfaring fra et kirurgisk afsnit.

• Har erfaring med klargøring af operationsstuer og kirurgisk udstyr.

• Arbejder struktureret, selvstændigt og med sans for detaljer.

• Har forståelse for vigtigheden af hygiejne, rengøring og korrekt håndtering af udstyr.

• Kan tage ansvar for lagerstyring og bestilling af klinikkens forbrugsvarer.

• Er fleksibel og hjælpsom og trives med at samarbejde tæt med både veterinærer,

sygeplejersker, klinikassistenter og studerende.

• Har lyst til at tage ansvar for oplæring og vejledning af nye medarbejdere.

• Bevarer overblikket i en travl hverdag og kan prioritere opgaver efter klinikkens behov.

Vi tilbyder

En alsidig stilling med ansvar og mulighed for at spille en vigtig rolle i den daglige drift af

klinikken. Du bliver en del af et fagligt miljø, hvor samarbejde, kvalitet og god

patientbehandling er i fokus.

____________________________________________________________________________________

We are seeking an experienced and responsible Senior Veterinary Clinic Assistant for a full-time position.

The role is central to the daily operation of the clinic and includes preparing the surgical area, organizing instruments and equipment, maintaining high standards of hygiene, overseeing laboratory equipment, managing stock and ordering supplies, and assisting veterinarians and veterinary nurses with practical and clinical tasks.

The Senior Clinic Assistant will also help ensure efficient daily workflows and play an important role in training and introducing new clinic assistants and students to the clinic’s routines, hygiene procedures, equipment, and working methods.

We are looking for someone with relevant experience from a veterinary clinic, preferably including surgical experience. The ideal candidate is structured, independent, detail-oriented, flexible, and comfortable taking responsibility. Strong teamwork skills and the ability to remain organized and prioritize tasks in a busy clinical environment are essential.

We offer a varied and responsible position in a professional veterinary environment with a strong focus on teamwork, quality, and excellent patient care.

jobs.title: Cost Estimator HVAC
jobs.description:
At VARD, we create innovative and sustainable solutions for the global maritime industry. Combining engineering excellence, cutting-edge technology, and strong teamwork, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced vessels.

At the same time, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We foster an inclusive and supportive environment where talents can grow, ideas are valued, and individuals are empowered to make an impact.

Vard Interiors is a leading supplier of turnkey interior, insulation, piping, and HVAC-R solutions for the maritime industry. As part of the VARD value chain, we work closely with shipowners, designers, and shipyards to create functional, sustainable, and high-quality onboard environments. With a strong focus on innovation, craftsmanship, and customer value, we help bring some of the industry’s most advanced vessels to life.

We are currently looking for a Cost Estimator HVAC to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities
  • Prepare and maintain cost estimates for products, services, and ship interior projects.
  • Analyze drawings, specifications, RFQs and other project documentation.
  • Identify and quantify materials, labour requirements and other project cost drivers.
  • Develop and maintain project calculations and technical proposals.
  • Collaborate with engineers, suppliers, customers and subcontractors to clarify project requirements.
  • Monitor actual costs against estimates and support cost control throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Maintain and continuously improve cost databases and estimation tools.
  • Participate in site visits and gather relevant information to support cost assessments.
Qualifications
  • Relevant higher education, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Knowledge of shipbuilding processes, materials and project costing.
  • Experience from the interior and/or HVAC industry is an advantage.
  • Technical understanding and commercial awareness.
  • Excellent Excel and general software skills.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above.

jobs.title: Car Driver, Lapland Safaris Saariselkä
jobs.description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Car Drivers for the Christmas season 2026 to Lapland Safaris offices in Levi and Saariselkä.**

Please note that we are currently accepting applications **only from candidates who already have the right to work in Finland.** Unfortunately, due to the processing times for work permits and the schedule of our recruitment, we are unable to consider applications from candidates who would require a new work permit to work in Finland. **This includes applicants from the UK, Australia, and other non-EU countries who do not already hold a valid right to work in Finland.**

The duties of a Lapland Safaris driver mainly consist of transporting, loading, and collecting equipment bags containing our guests winter clothing from local hotels and Lapland Safaris locations. In addition, your tasks will include supporting safari operations, such as sorting, maintaining, and drying equipment. Due to long distances, you may also occasionally transport staff between different locations, or between the workplace and staff accommodation.

The vehicles you drive will vary from passenger cars to vans, 9seat minibuses, and even vans equipped with a tail lift that can be driven with a category B driving license. Our working language is English, so good English skills is considered an advantage.

In addition to a valid driving license, we expect flexibility regarding tasks and working hours, as your workdays may sometimes be long. You are the person we are looking for if you are hardworking, proactive, well organized, and reliable.

The work is physically demanding and partly carried out in challenging weather conditions, including Laplands winds and snowstorms. You will work as part of a larger equipment maintenance team, and your contribution is highly important to the operation of Lapland Safaris.

**We offer you:**

- A great team to work with

- The beautiful landscapes of Lapland

- An easy way to start working in the field of tourism in Lapland

- Numerous leisure opportunities

- Comprehensive staff benefits from Lapland Hotels & Safaris, including discounts on equipment rental, restaurants, and lift tickets at Lapland Ski Resorts.


Lapland Safaris provides new employees with paid, role-specific training at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. The work starts in mid-to-late November and is expected to last until the last week of December.

. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A, hourly wage starting from 11,30 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish public holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews and selections will be conducted already during the application period, so please apply soon! Positions will be filled as suitable candidates are found.

**More information:** info@laplandstaff.fi

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager, Paid Search
jobs.description:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi at a glance:

  • Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

  • Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

  • Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

About the role:

As the Paid Search Marketing Manager for the UK market, you will play a key role in driving growth and profitability through expertly managed paid search campaigns. You will have the opportunity to work on high-impact initiatives, shaping how we connect with both sides of our marketplace - homeowners and tradespeople. We are looking for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment and is committed to consistently improving performance while exploring new opportunities to innovate and expand. This role reports to a Paid Search Director.

What you’ll do:

  • Steward the day-to-day management and optimization of Google Ads and Microsoft Ads campaigns, ensuring they deliver maximum profitability.

  • Conduct in-depth keyword research, running ad copy tests, and analyzing performance to continually improve profitability and ROAS.

  • Partner with our Product and Analytics teams to implement advanced reporting and actionable insights.

  • Stay ahead of the curve by monitoring industry trends, testing new strategies, and exploring untapped opportunities for paid search growth.

  • Leverage AI tools and agents (e.g. Claude-based workflows, Google Ads Scripts automation) for campaign monitoring, reporting, and anomaly detection to work more efficiently and surface insights faster.

This role gives you the chance to make a real impact while working in an environment that encourages innovation and data-driven experimentation. Your contributions will directly shape the success of our paid marketing efforts in a key European market.

Who you are:

  • 2-4 years of experience in Paid Search Marketing, specifically with Google Ads and Microsoft Ads.

  • Experience with budget management, bid optimization, and performance tracking.

  • Analytical mindset with a focus on data-driven decision-making.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with display or video advertising as a supplementary skill.

  • Experience with marketplace management

  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) techniques.

  • Comfort working with AI tools and agents (e.g. Claude, automation scripts) to accelerate reporting and analysis — a definite plus, though not required.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • The salary band for this position ranges from €50,000 - 65,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

  • Hybrid work environment and home office set-up allowance

  • Temporary work from abroad policy

  • Regular team and social events

jobs.title: Factory Training & Development Specialist
jobs.description:
**The opportunity**

Join Hitachi Energy in shaping the future of learning and growth! We're looking for a dynamic Factory Training & Development Specialist to lead impactful programs at our Transformers Factory in Vaasa.

The Transformers Business Unit is a core part of Hitachi Energy, enabling reliable power transmission and distribution worldwide. Over the years, the Vaasa factory has become one of Finland's largest and most important transformer manufacturing plant, contributing significantly to national energy security. Today, the factory develops and manufactures transformers that ensure electricity flows to millions of homes worldwide. The site operates in a complex manufacturing environment with high safety standards and a strong focus on sustainability, quality, and continuous improvement, serving customers globally both within and outside Hitachi Energy.

In this role, you will design and deliver innovative training experiences that empower teams, foster leadership, and drive operational excellence. If you're passionate about helping people unlock their potential and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, this is your chance to make a real difference.

**How you'll make an impact**

· Drive factory training activities according to the agreed training roadmap, production needs and HUB guidance.

· Lead the practical implementation of Structured-On-The-Job training for direct workforce, including schedules, participants, trainers and documentation.

· Maintain course assignments, training records, certifications and completion data in the appointed Learning Management System (LMS).

· Prepare regular training status reports, dashboards or data extracts to support follow-up and decision-making.

· Coordinate with trainers and SMEs to prepare, update and validate training materials and work instruction related content.

· Follow up overdue, mandatory or certification-related trainings and escalate gaps when needed.

· Collect feedback from participants, trainers and stakeholders and drive agreed improvement actions.

· Communicate training schedules, requirements and practical instructions to relevant employees and managers.

· Provide accurate training records and evidence for audits, compliance checks and training documentation requests.

· Contribute to and drive continuous improvement of training processes, tools and ways of working within the factory.

**Your background**

· A B.Sc., M.Sc. or equivalent degree in Engineering, Industrial Management, HR, Education, Business Administration or another relevant field

· Relevant experience in training coordination, production training, technical instruction, LMS administration or manufacturing support roles.

· Good understanding of manufacturing environment, shopfloor operations and competence development needs for direct workforce.

· Experience with Learning Management Systems, training data maintenance and reporting tools such as Excel and PowerBI is an advantage.

· Ability to coordinate multiple training activities, follow up details and maintain accurate documentation.

· Strong collaboration, communication and stakeholder service mindset.

· Structured, proactive and quality-oriented way of working with a continuous improvement mindset.

· Familiarity with transformer manufacturing is an advantage.

· Fluency in both Finnish and English, written and spoken.

jobs.title: Solution Architect - LangGraph & Agentic AI
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect with hands-on experience designing and deploying LangGraph-based AI solutions to lead the architecture of enterprise agentic AI platforms and applications.

You will work with business and technology stakeholders to identify high-value AI opportunities and translate them into secure, scalable, and production-ready architectures.

The role combines AI architecture, enterprise integration, cloud engineering, agentic AI, security, governance, and stakeholder leadership.

You will be expected to understand LangGraph at a practical level and be able to challenge architectural decisions, guide engineering teams, and ensure that AI solutions can operate reliably at enterprise scale.

Requirements

AI Solution Architecture

  • Lead the architecture and design of enterprise AI agent and agentic workflow solutions.
  • Design LangGraph-based architectures for single-agent and multi-agent applications.
  • Translate business requirements, processes, SLAs, security requirements, and technical constraints into solution architectures.
  • Evaluate architectural alternatives and document key technical decisions and trade-offs.
  • Define reusable architecture patterns for agentic AI solutions.

Enterprise Agent Architecture

  • Design architectures incorporating:
    • LLMs
    • LangGraph
    • RAG
    • Enterprise data
    • APIs and business systems
    • Workflow engines
    • Human approval processes
    • Observability
    • Security and governance
  • Define appropriate boundaries between AI reasoning and deterministic business logic.
  • Design state management, persistence, recovery, and long-running agent workflows.
  • Determine when to use single-agent, multi-agent, or conventional application architectures.

Cloud and Platform Architecture

  • Design scalable AI application architectures on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Define compute, networking, storage, API, security, and platform requirements.
  • Design architectures suitable for enterprise-scale production workloads.
  • Evaluate cloud services and AI platform capabilities based on performance, security, scalability, and cost.
  • Work with platform engineering and DevOps teams to establish deployment standards.

Integration Architecture

  • Design integration between AI agents and enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and SaaS platforms.
  • Define secure mechanisms for agent tool access and business-system interactions.
  • Design authentication, authorisation, secrets management, and access-control approaches.
  • Ensure AI-driven actions are traceable, auditable, and appropriately governed.

AI Security and Governance

  • Establish security and governance principles for enterprise AI agents.
  • Address risks including:
    • Prompt injection
    • Data leakage
    • Unauthorised tool usage
    • Excessive agent permissions
    • Inaccurate or unsafe actions
    • Sensitive-data exposure
  • Define appropriate human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Ensure solutions comply with organisational security, privacy, regulatory, and responsible-AI requirements.

AI Evaluation and Observability

  • Define architecture for AI application monitoring and observability.
  • Establish approaches for evaluating agent accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and task completion.
  • Define appropriate logging, tracing, metrics, and alerting.
  • Establish operational processes for monitoring and continuously improving production agents.

Stakeholder and Technical Leadership

  • Work directly with senior business and technology stakeholders to define AI strategies and roadmaps.
  • Lead architecture workshops and technical design sessions.
  • Communicate complex AI concepts and architectural trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Provide technical direction to AI engineers, developers, data teams, and platform engineers.
  • Review solution designs and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards.
  • Mentor engineering teams and promote reusable AI architecture patterns.

Required Experience

  • Significant experience in solution architecture, software architecture, AI architecture, or a related role.
  • Hands-on experience designing and deploying LangGraph-based AI applications or agentic workflows.
  • Strong understanding of LLM application architectures.
  • Experience with enterprise AI/ML solutions in production.
  • Strong understanding of RAG, tool calling, agent orchestration, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
  • Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns and APIs.
  • Experience with security, governance, observability, and operational requirements for production systems.
  • Strong technical understanding of Python and modern software engineering practices.

Desirable Experience

  • LangChain / LangSmith
  • Multi-agent architectures
  • Enterprise RAG platforms
  • Vector databases
  • Kubernetes
  • Event-driven architectures
  • Microservices
  • Infrastructure as Code
  • CI/CD
  • MLOps / LLMOps
  • AI security
  • Responsible AI
  • Large-scale enterprise transformation
  • Experience working directly with senior client stakeholders
