jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, India
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer focused on migrations to join our growing team in India. You will help deliver complex, production-grade data migrations, integrations, and automations for customers across APAC.

This is initially an internally focused, hands-on engineering role. You will partner closely with regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who own customer discovery, solution architecture, stakeholder communication, risk management, and final customer validation. You will own the behind-the-scenes technical execution layer from feasibility assessment and implementation through testing, production rollout, QA, reconciliation, reporting, and operational handoff.

You will work across multiple customer environments and source systems, often with incomplete requirements, imperfect data, and real-world constraints. Success requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound judgment, careful validation, and the ability to turn one-off delivery work into reusable tools and repeatable playbooks.

As a founding engineer in India, you will help build a new regional engineering capability from the ground up. You will create migration infrastructure, standards, and reusable tooling used by FDEs across APAC, while establishing practices that can scale globally. The role offers an opportunity to become a technical authority for production migration delivery, shaping how Notion approaches reliability, validation, and operational quality across complex customer environments. As the team grows, the role may also expand toward customer-facing FDE work, technical leadership, or a deeper engineering path, depending on business needs and demonstrated capability.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the technical execution layer after customer requirements, scope, and solution architecture have been established with the regional FDE. Contribute to feasibility assessment, estimation, implementation planning, and risk identification while the regional FDE remains accountable for customer discovery, scope, architecture, stakeholder communication, and final acceptance.

 - Apply a repeatable migration lifecycle covering source inventory and sampling, scope and pruning decisions, compatibility and degradation assessment, transformation design, pilot or dry run, user acceptance testing, production cutover, reconciliation, remediation, hypercare, and documented handoff.

 - Translate approved customer and regional FDE requirements into clear technical designs, implementation plans, test strategies, runbooks, and delivery estimates.

 - Build production-quality migration utilities, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, and automations using Python, SQL, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.

 - Investigate source-system behavior, data quality issues, permissions, rate limits, authentication constraints, and edge cases, then recommend practical solutions.

 - Design and validate permissions, ownership, and inheritance mappings against the approved migration plan. Make unsupported or ambiguous access requirements explicit, obtain the required decision or approval, and preserve evidence of validation.

 - Design migrations for reliability, scale, security, observability, idempotency, failure recovery, and safe reruns.

 - Execute migrations only through approved environments, devices, accounts, and tooling. Follow least-privilege access, customer-specific security and data-residency requirements, and approved handling procedures. Do not store customer data in unmanaged local or external systems, and escalate privacy, security, or sovereignty concerns before execution.

 - Build validation and reconciliation frameworks that provide clear evidence of migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions.

 - Debug failures across application code, infrastructure, customer data, third-party systems, and the Notion platform, then drive issues through resolution.

 - Manage multiple implementation workstreams, dependencies, and priorities while communicating scope, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly.

 - Surface scope changes, unsupported requirements, timeline risks, and material effort increases early. Document assumptions and trade-offs, and escalate with options and a recommended path rather than silently absorbing additional work.

 - Maintain an auditable record of scope, decisions, risks, approvals, validation evidence, and customer acceptance criteria in the agreed shared workspace or channel.

 - Convert repeated delivery patterns into reusable components, automation, documentation, and playbooks that improve speed, quality, and cost over time.

 - Bring field learnings back to Notion's Product and Engineering teams as actionable platform feedback and technical requirements.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in backend engineering, data engineering, integration engineering, implementation engineering, technical consulting, solutions engineering, or a similar technical role.

 - Strong hands-on Python development experience.

 - Working experience with Node.js, JavaScript, or TypeScript.

 - Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, and data transformation.

 - Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, webhooks, and system integrations.

 - Experience owning a production migration, integration, or technical implementation through mapping, transformation, testing, rollout, validation, and handoff.

 - Experience taking a technical problem from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production operation.

 - Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, release practices, and production deployment.

 - Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills across code, data, infrastructure, and external systems.

 - Evidence of working on production systems, not only prototypes or proof-of-concept projects.

 - Clear written and verbal English communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions, constraints, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - High agency and ownership. You are comfortable making progress with incomplete information, challenging assumptions, and escalating with options and a recommendation.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, job orchestration, or infrastructure automation.

 - Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.

 - Familiarity with message queues, event-driven systems, distributed-system patterns, retries, concurrency, and rate limits.

 - Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, or other observability tools.

 - Experience with enterprise SaaS applications, professional services, or large-scale customer implementations.

 - Experience migrating large volumes of content or structured data between enterprise platforms.

 - Experience with AI or LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, or agentic workflows.

 - Familiarity with MCP, tool calling, Notion Workers, Custom Agents, or similar extensibility platforms.

 - Experience working with distributed global or APAC teams.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

In your first 90 days, you will:

 - Learn Notion's migration and implementation ecosystem, engineering standards, and APAC delivery model.

 - Establish a productive working rhythm with regional FDE partners.

 - Contribute to at least one migration or integration workstream through production delivery.

 - Leave behind clear technical documentation, validation evidence, and an operational runbook.

Within your first six months, you will:

 - Independently own production migration or integration workstreams from technical design through rollout and handoff.

 - Deliver measurable improvements in migration turnaround time, validation quality, delivery cost, or regional FDE execution hours through reusable engineering.

 - Help establish repeatable quality controls, code review practices, runbooks, and observability patterns for the India team.

 - Demonstrate effective prioritization and communication across multiple concurrent APAC engagements.

 - Turn at least one repeated delivery pattern into a reusable tool, component, or playbook that is adopted by a subsequent engagement.




LOCATION:

This role is based in Hyderabad, India. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our Anchor Days, because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We're looking for someone who's excited to work alongside the team during those days.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Country HR Manager
jobs.description:
_Walki transforms materials for a circular future and towards a sustainable society by extending products' life cycle and embracing resource efficiency. We are an industry leading advanced materials conversion specialist delivering transformative, sustainable solutions to solve the most demanding challenges in packaging and the built environment. Walki is a growing international group organized in three business areas: Consumer Packaging, Packaging Materials and Engineered Materials, with operations in eleven different countries, both in Europe and Asia. In 2025, the Group's annual turnover was approx. 599 million euros employing around 1600 people._

**We are looking for an experienced Country HR Manager for Walki!**

**Your role**

In this comprehensive role, you will be responsible for the entire HR function in Finland, harmonizing processes and implementing global guidelines locally. You will lead a team of HR specialists and oversee HR operations across Walki's Finnish sites, ensuring high-quality support for managers and employees while continuously developing HR practices. Beyond strategic vision, the role also calls for a pragmatic and hands-on approach supporting the business and driving HR initiatives into practice. The position can be based in Valkeakoski, Säkylä, or Pietarsaari. Walki's sites are located along the Pietarsaari-Espoo axis.

You bring strong expertise in managing the full employee lifecycle and HR processes in an industrial or manufacturing environment. You will serve as a trusted partner to site and business leaders and help supervisors succeed in their roles. Working closely with Finance and other Group functions, you will contribute to workforce planning, payroll budgeting, and people-related decision-making. In addition, you will ensure that local compensation, benefits, payroll, and HR administration practices support both compliance requirements and business objectives.

The ideal candidate is down-to-earth, collaborative, and flexible. You lead by example and act as a role model in teamwork, interaction, and communication. Safety is a core part of Walki's culture and production environment. While Walki has a separate safety organization, HR plays an important role in supporting and driving the safety culture through example. You are able to see the bigger picture while breaking it down into practical steps, building functional processes and ways of working, and putting them into practice.

**What we offer**

At Walki, you will join a highly skilled HR team. At Walki, you will work in an international organisation with a collaborative, low-hierarchy culture where people are approachable, business-focused, and committed to continuous improvement. This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in developing HR practices and supporting leaders in a growing international organisation. Walki offers a hybrid work model with up to 50 % remote work, as well as a culture benefit.

**We hope our future Country HR Manager has the following qualities and skills:**

- At least five years of experience in HR Manager-level roles in an industrial environment

- Borad experience in managing HR processes across the employee lifecycle and driving continuous improvement initiatives.

- Strong knowledge of collective agreements (experience with the paper or chemical industry collective agreements is considered a particular advantage)

- Experience implementing and harmonizing HR practices in a multi-site or international organisation. Experience and understanding of how, for example, M&A and integration processes affect HR's scope of work is considered an asset.

- Solid knowledge of employment legislation, statutory documentation, and local negotiations, along with a track record in co-operation procedures

- Ability to navigate a complex stakeholder environment involving multiple sites, collective agreements, and cross-functional collaboration within a group structure. You understand the demands of a matrix organization and corporate group structure.

- Excellent leadership and people management skills

- Fluent Finnish and English. Swedish language skills are an advantage.

- Compensation & benefits expertise is considered an advantage


While we are looking for an experienced HR professional, we also value curiosity, continuous learning, and a willingness to challenge established ways of working when opportunities for improvement exist. What matters is recognizing what you don't yet know and knowing how to find the right answers.

**Recruitment process**

We'd love to hear from you next! Please submit your application and CV through our recruitment system. The application period closes on 30 September 2026, but applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The recruitment process is managed by Jasmiina Inkinen at Valiant HR Oy (tel. 050 557 4696), who is happy to answer any questions. You can also reach Jasmiina by email at jasmiina@valianthr.fi.

First-round interviews are tentatively scheduled for weeks 40–41, with follow-up interviews in weeks 41–42. The first interview round will take place on Teams.

This recruitment is carried out in partnership with Valiant HR Oy. The successful candidate will be employed directly by Walki.

_About Valiant HR Oy:_

_Valiant HR Oy is a recruitment partner that understands both business and people. We specialize in recruitment and executive search for office, manager, and executive-level roles. Delivering a positive experience for both clients and candidates is at the heart of what we do. Learn more about us and how we work: www.valianthr.fi_

_Facebook: @valianthroy_

_LinkedIn: Valiant HR Oy_

Työpäiväsi koostuu mm.:

- Asiakaspalvelusta kasvotusten ja puhelimitse

jobs.description:

Operations Performancella on neljä keskeistä tehtävää: se kehittää yhtiömme tuottavuutta, tuotteiden kilpailukykyä ja toimintamme hintakilpailukykyä sekä vastaa muutosjohtamisesta merkittävissä projekteissa. Haemme nyt asiakaspalveluhenkistä TALOTEKNIIKAN ASIANTUNTIJAA, ISS Remote Engineering Centre-etähallintakeskukseemme Kuopioon. Kyseessä on kokopäiväinen, toistaiseksi voimassa oleva tehtävä, jossa työtä tehdään katkeamattomana vuorotyönä arkisin ja viikonloppuisin 12h vuoroissa. Etähallintakeskus toimii asiakkaidemme tukena 24/7 eli ympärivuorokautisesti, vuoden jokaisena päivänä.
Talotekniikan asiantuntijana vastaat kiinteistöjen taloteknisiin järjestelmiin, rakennusautomaatioon ja muihin etähallittaviin järjestelmiin liittyvistä monipuolisista työtehtävistä sekä raportoinnista. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä kriittisissä ympäristöissä toimivien asiakkaidemme kanssa sekä sähköpostitse ja puhelimitse. Toimit asiakkaiden asiantuntevana kumppanina löytäen heidän liiketoimintaansa tukevia ratkaisuja eri kiinteistöpalveluistamme. Vastaat asiakkaiden prosessien toiminnasta sekä kiinteistöjen energia- ja olosuhdehallinnasta.
Odotamme sinulta aiempaa kokemusta kiinteistöautomaation- sekä talotekniikan parista. Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto tekniikan alalta, kuten talo-, sähkö-, energia- tai automaatiotekniikan tutkinto. Voit olla opintojesi loppuvaiheessa oleva tulevaisuuden kyky tai jo kokemusta omaava ammattilainen. Tehtävässä menestymisen edellytyksenä on motivaatio ja aito halu toimia rohkeasti asiakasrajapinnassa. Arvostamme automaatiojärjestelmien syvällistä tuntemusta sekä ymmärrystä kiinteistöjen olosuhteista ja energiankulutuksesta. Työssäsi tarvitset oma-aloitteisuutta, vahvaa palveluasennetta sekä paineensietokykyä. Viestit sujuvasti ja selkeästi, niin suullisesti kuin kirjallisesti, suomen kielellä. Lisäksi sinulla on hyvä englannin kielen taito ja IT-taitosi ovat ajan tasalla. Teetämme valitulle henkilölle turvallisuusselvityksen, joka on hyväksyttynä edellytys työsopimukselle.
Tarjoamme sinulle perehdytyksen itsenäiseen, mielenkiintoiseen ja haastavaan työhön asiantuntijayksikössämme. Tule mukaan osaavaan ja kannustavaan tiimiimme! Tarjoamme myös mahdollisuuksia kehittyä ja kasvaa. Tule kanssamme luomaan tiloja, joissa on hyvä olla!
Mikäli olet etsimämme henkilö, jätä meille hakemuksesi oheisen linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 27.9.2026. Liitäthän hakemukseesi mukaan myös CV:si. Olemme sinuun pian yhteydessä!


ISS työllistää Suomessa lähes 1000 teknistä ammattilaista asentajista erilaisiin kiinteistötekniikan asiantuntijoihin ja päälliköihin. ISS:llä tekniset osaajat pitävät huolta siitä, että kriittiset tilat toimivat – datakeskuksista tehtaisiin ja sairaaloihin. Tärkeissä paikoissa tarvitaan taitavimmat tekijät, jotka haluavat ratkoa haasteita aidosti monipuolisessa ympäristössä. Tarjoamme tilaa itsenäisyydelle, vastuuta, monipuolisia urapolkuja ja ammattitaitoisen tiimin tuen. Tutustu teknisiin ammattilaisiimme täällä: ISS työpaikat - Työ teknisissä palveluissa

jobs.title: Theatre Nurse
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Position: Theatre Nurse – Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery Employer: Avoca Clinic Limited Location: Unit C, Glencormack Business Park, Kilmacanogue, Co. Wicklow, A98 WK27 Contract: Permanent, Full-Time Department: Theatre & Perioperative Services Avoca Clinic Limited is seeking an experienced Theatre Nurse to join our Theatre and Perioperative Services team, supporting the delivery of high-quality care to patients undergoing plastic and reconstructive surgical procedures. The successful candidate will work as part of the multidisciplinary theatre team and will be responsible for providing safe, professional and patient-centred nursing care throughout the perioperative pathway. Key Responsibilities Provide safe and effective nursing care to patients before, during and after surgical procedures. Prepare patients for surgery and ensure all required documentation and safety checks are completed. Prepare the operating theatre, surgical instruments, equipment and consumables for scheduled procedures. Undertake scrub and circulating duties according to experience and competence. Assist surgeons and anaesthetists during surgical procedures. Maintain strict aseptic technique and infection prevention and control standards. Complete surgical counts and safety checks in accordance with clinic procedures. Ensure appropriate handling, identification and documentation of specimens. Monitor patients and promptly escalate any clinical concerns. Support the safe transfer of patients between theatre and recovery. Maintain accurate and complete nursing documentation. Ensure medicines, equipment and clinical supplies are handled and stored safely. Assist with theatre stock control and report shortages or equipment issues. Participate in theatre preparation, cleaning and turnaround between procedures. Follow all Avoca Clinic policies, procedures and patient-safety requirements. Report incidents, near misses or clinical concerns through the appropriate channels. Maintain patient dignity, privacy and confidentiality at all times. Communicate effectively with patients, surgeons, anaesthetists, nurses and other members of the multidisciplinary team. Participate in mandatory training, clinical updates, audits and quality-improvement activities. Work flexibly according to the theatre schedule and operational requirements of the clinic. Requirements Applicants must be registered with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI) and eligible to practise nursing in Ireland. Previous experience working in an operating theatre or surgical environment is required. Experience in plastic, reconstructive or cosmetic surgery would be an advantage. Applicants should demonstrate: Strong theatre and perioperative nursing skills. Good knowledge of infection prevention and control and aseptic technique. Excellent patient-care and communication skills. Good organisational and time-management skills. Accurate clinical documentation and attention to detail.

jobs.title: Personal Assistant to Grenoble France
jobs.description:
Core mission
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.
You will join the ILL's Reactor Division, where you will perform secretarial duties for the Head of Division and provide general administrative support to the entire division. This role is at the heart of the ILL's relations with France's nuclear safety and security authorities. It calls for a meticulous approach to the handling of sensitive documents and involves working in close collaboration with the personal assistants of the other members of the ILL's Management Board. Special security clearance ('habilitation') is required for this post, given the sensitive nature of some of the documents and activities associated with the role.

Your tasks
. Handle administrative relations with the French authorities (French nuclear safety authority (ASNR), Senior Defence and Security Advisor (HFDS) within the Ministry of Ecological Transition and its technical support services, Préfecture, police): processing, distributing and archiving incoming and outgoing correspondence, maintaining the correspondence register.
. Manage the logistics involved with inspections (ASNR, HFDS, EURATOM) and emergency response exercises.
. Handle documents classified as "Secret" and "Restricted" and monitor compliance with the associated security clearance and screening procedures.
. Handle administrative matters linked to crisis management: badges for access to CEA Grenoble, maintaining the list of ILL staff who may be involved and the associated documentation.
. Remain up to date with safety reference frameworks (safety report, general operating rules, on-site emergency plan and safety instruction sheets) and regulatory documents relating to nuclear materials, as well as documents governing reactor operations (procedures, RHF reactor reports, instructions).
. Organise regular meetings of the Reactor Division and draft the associated minutes.
. Organise important visits to the Reactor Division (safety authorities, public authorities) and other events, in collaboration with the other personal assistants.
. Perform secretarial duties for the Head of the Reactor Division: managing his agenda, phone calls, emails, correspondence, travel arrangements and travel expenses.
. Coordinate the annual performance reviews and manage data forwarded to the Joint Careers Commission.
. Collaborate with the personal assistants of the other members of the Management Board to ensure that actions are effectively coordinated in line with the objectives set.

our profile
. Level 4/5 qualification in business and administration or a related field, or administrative secretary and personal assistant diploma
. Proven experience as a personal assistant
. Excellent command of written and spoken English and French
. Meticulous nature and professionalism, particularly in the handling of sensitive and/or classified documents
. Strong organisational skills, ability to manage a variety of tasks simultaneously and liaise with multiple stakeholders
. Ability to perform day-to-day tasks independently
. Good interpersonal and teamwork skills, particularly when coordinating with the other personal assistants.

What we offer
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal by 04/10/2026, quoting reference number 26/39. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Stærkt netværk af expats og internationale virksomheder – Mange internationale virksomheder har kontorer i Portugal, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig i et globalt arbejdsmiljø.

Arbejdet i Portugal giver både professionel og personlig udvikling samt mulighed for at opleve en spændende livsstil med stor kulturel og økonomisk værdi.

Myyjä, S-market Mynämäki, Turun Osuuskauppa
jobs.description:
Primary location:
MYNÄMÄKI

S-market Mynämäki etsii tiimiinsä MYYJÄÄ!
Tehtävä on vakituinen ja osa-aikainen 10 tuntia viikossa. Työn aloitus on lokakuun aikana.

Myyjän työ ässässä on monipuolista ja nopeatempoista. Myyjän keskeisimpiin työtehtäviin kuuluu laadukkaan ja kokonaisvaltaisen asiakaskokemuksen luominen sekä työskentely kassalla ja päivittäistavaraosastolla. Osastolla työskentelyyn sisältyy asiakaspalvelun lisäksi muun muassa hyllytys, robotilausten keräily sekä esillepanojen ja myymälän siisteyden ylläpito. Kaupassa työskentely on fyysistä, sillä liikumme päivän aikana paljon, nostamme ja siirrämme tavaraa ja olemme koko päivän jaloillamme. Teemme työtä porukalla pilke silmäkulmassa, mutta tässä työssä tarvitaan myös tilannetajua ja kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn. Tehtävä edellyttää mahdollisuutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa vuoroissa kaupan aukioloaikojen mukaisesti arkisin ja viikonloppuisin 5.30-23.10 välillä. Varmistathan, että sinulla on mahdollisuus kulkea toimipaikkaan kaikkina kaupan aukioloaikoina.

Millaista tyyppiä etsimme?

Sovit tiimiimme hyvin, jos tartut työhön innostuneella ja energisellä asenteella. Haluat olla luomassa onnistunutta asiakaskokemusta ja nautit työskentelystä myymäläympäristössä. Olet valmis tarttumaan oma-aloitteisesti erilaisiin työtehtäviin ja pidät tiimityöskentelystä. Lisäksi sinulle sopii fyysinen vuorotyö, jossa työskentelet vaihtelevissa vuoroissa, ja kohtaat satoja ihmisiä päivässä. Eduksi katsomme aiemman työkokemuksen vastaavista työtehtävistä, mutta tärkeintä on halu oppia, toimia tehokkaasti ja tavoitteellisesti sekä työskennellä asiakaslähtöisesti.

Myyjän palkka perustuu Kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen. Tuntipalkka on koulutuksesta ja kokemusvuosista riippuen 10,89-14,57 €/h. Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kannustepalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1,20 € per tehty työtunti.

Liity meidän tiimiin, niin tarjoamme sinulle:

💚 Ihan tavallisia töitä epätavallisen hyvillä henkilöstöeduilla! Työskennellessäsi meillä, saat rahanarvoisia ostoetuja S-etukortillasi, kuten S-ryhmän ravintoloista –25 %,Sokos ja Emotion myymälöistä -15 % tai autopesusta –50 %.

💚 Työpäiviä poikkeuksellisen rennossa porukassa yhdessä Suomen innostavimmassa työpaikassa.

💚 Mahdollisuuden kerryttää osaamista sekä lisätienestiä tekemällä lisävuoroja muissakin S-marketeissa sekä kaikissa TOK:n toimipaikoissa koko Varsinais-Suomen alueella.

💚 Kattavan perehdytyksen työtehtävääsi ja mahdollisuuden ammatilliseen kasvuun, jota tukevat S-ryhmän monipuoliset oppimis- ja valmennusmahdollisuudet.

Jos ihan tavalliset työt houkuttaa, laita hakemusta tulemaan 27.9. mennessä! Me ollaan sinuun yhteydessä sähköpostitse tai puhelimitse 010 764 –alkuisesta numerosta. Kannattaa seurata myös roskapostia, sillä meidän viestit voivat eksyä myös sinne.

Haluaisitko kuulla lisää tehtävästä ja Turun Osuuskaupasta? 📞Lisätietoja antaa marketpäällikkö Mikko Eklund. Mikon tavoitat parhaiten arkisin klo 9-15 numerosta 0107644279.

Turun Osuuskauppa on osa S-ryhmää ja yksi alueensa suurimmista työllistäjistä. Meillä työskentelet vakaassa organisaatiossa, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi ja rakentamaan entistä parempia asiakaskokemuksia yhdessä ammattilaisten kanssa. Me Turun Osuuskaupassa työskentelemme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei tarkoita, että meillä olisi tylsää tai osaamatonta porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin! Meillä on harvinaisen hyvä työilmapiiri, epätavallisen hyvät henkilöstöedut ja poikkeuksellisen paljon monipuolisia työmahdollisuuksia. 82 % työntekijöistämme suositteleekin meitä työpaikkana. Meitä tokkilaisia on reilu 2600, ja työskentelemme neljällä eri toimialalla. Työskentelemme pilke silmäkulmassa ja tavoitteenamme on olla asiakkaiden ykkösvalinta! Lue lisää Turun Osuuskaupasta: Tietoa meistä – TOK.

jobs.title: Property Finder - Svensk Fastighetsförmedling Estepona
jobs.description:
Property Finder – Estepona, Casares & Manilva

Do you have a natural talent for connecting with people, spotting business opportunities and turning new contacts into long-term relationships? Are you driven by sales and enjoy being out in the local community rather than sitting behind a desk all day?

Svensk Fastighetsförmedling Estepona is looking for a Property Finder with a strong focus on Casares and Manilva. We are looking for someone who knows how to create opportunities, build trust and find the properties our clients are looking for.

Your role

As a Property Finder, your main responsibility is to identify and connect with potential property sellers and bring new properties into our portfolio.

This is a proactive and relationship-driven role. You will spend much of your time building your local network, contacting potential sellers and identifying new opportunities in the market.

Your day might include reaching out to homeowners, following up on property advertisements, contacting private sellers through platforms such as Idealista and Fotocasa, meeting people in the local area or visiting a potential new property.

You will work closely with the rest of the Estepona team, but you will also have plenty of freedom to plan your own activities and develop your area.

What you will be doing

    

Identifying and approaching potential property sellers

    

Actively sourcing new properties in Casares, Manilva and the surrounding area

    

Developing and maintaining a strong local network

    

Following up on private property listings and other potential leads

    

Building relationships with homeowners and prospective clients

    

Evaluating properties and identifying new business opportunities

    

Preparing property listings and ensuring that the necessary documentation is in place

    

Working closely with your colleagues to create a great experience for our clients

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who is commercially minded, proactive and genuinely enjoys meeting people.

You know that successful sales often start long before the actual transaction. Building trust, staying in touch and creating a strong network come naturally to you.

You are comfortable taking the first step, approaching new people and creating your own opportunities. At the same time, you are structured and understand the importance of following up, keeping commitments and delivering a professional experience throughout the process.

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

    

Fluency in English and Spanish, both spoken and written

    

Additional language skills are highly valued

    

Previous experience in sales, real estate, property sourcing or another relevant commercial role

    

A strong ability to build relationships and develop a local network

    

A proactive and results-driven approach

    

A valid driver's licence and confidence behind the wheel

    

Preferably, residence in or good knowledge of Casares, Manilva or the surrounding area

What we offer

At Svensk Fastighetsförmedling, you will become part of an established brand while working in a local and entrepreneurial environment.

We want you to have the right conditions to succeed. You will receive support, coaching and training as well as the tools you need in your daily work, including a mobile phone, computer and access to a company vehicle.

Most importantly, you will join a team where we work together, share knowledge and celebrate success.

Ready for your next move?

If you recognise yourself in this description, we would love to hear from you.

Send us your application as soon as possible. Applications are handled confidentially, and we will contact selected candidates with more information about the role and the next steps in the process.

If you have any questions, please contact Angelica Thunell at angelica.thunell@svenskfast.se.

About Svensk Fastighetsförmedling

Svensk Fastighetsförmedling is Sweden's largest nationwide independent real estate agency. With around 1,250 colleagues, we are united by a strong culture of collaboration, development and customer focus.

We continuously invest in our people through training, coaching and modern tools, creating opportunities to develop and grow within the organisation.

Could this be your next opportunity? We look forward to hearing from you!

Learn more about us here:

https://www.svenskfast.se/en/spain/

We are recruiting experienced BMS Project Manager for datacenter projects in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading the successful delivery of building automation projects across multiple datacenter construction sites. You will work closely with project teams, subcontractors, consultants, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on schedule, and within budget.

This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in high-profile critical infrastructure projects within a growing and technically demanding industry.

The assignment starts ASAP and is expected to continue for approximately 12 months.

The successful candidate can be employed under a fixed-term employment contract or engaged through a contractor agreement, depending on their situation and preferences.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of building automation projects across multiple datacenter construction sites
* Manage project teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery
* Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, forecasts, and risk management plans
* Oversee project financials, including cost control, forecasting, reporting, and margin management
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations, quality standards, and project requirements
* Coordinate activities with consultants, contractors, and project stakeholders
* Oversee procurement, logistics, and resource allocation across multiple sites
* Monitor project performance and provide regular project reporting
* Support commissioning, handover, and project close-out activities

* 5+ years of project management experience within construction, building services, automation, or related industries
* Demonstrated success managing complex, multidisciplinary projects
* Strong understanding of construction contracts, project controls, and safety legislation
* Experience managing project budgets, forecasting, and P&L responsibility
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills

* Valid driving licence and willingness to travel between project sites within the Helsinki Metropolitan Area

Previous experience in datacenter construction projects will be considered a strong advantage. We also value building automation (BMS) knowledge and experience with platforms such as Metasys, EasyIO, Tridium Niagara, Trend, Siemens, Schneider Electric, or similar systems. Experience managing large-scale projects, working in regulated environments, and proficiency with project management tools such as MS Project or Primavera will further support success in this role.

PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certifications, as well as a degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Automation, or a related field, are considered advantageous.

Details:

The position is based in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area across multiple datacenter construction sites. The assignment starts ASAP and will last approximately 12 months.

Working hours are between Monday to Friday from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm and Saturday from 8:00 am to 2:00 pm.

jobs.title: Koirasafariopas Leville
jobs.description:
KOKENEITA KOIRASAFARIOPPAITA LEVILLE!

Etsimme kahta kokenutta koirasafariopasta osaksi vauhdikasta ja hyvähenkistä talvisesonkia Levillä!

Jos tunnet olosi kotoisaksi sekä koirien että ihmisten seurassa, viihdyt Lapin luonnossa ja sinulla on kokemusta safarien vetämisestä, saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö.


MITÄ TYÖ PITÄÄ SISÄLLÄÄN?

Koirasafarioppaana vastaat asiakkaiden turvallisesta ja onnistuneesta safari-elämyksestä sekä koirien hyvinvoinnista. Työhön kuuluu muun muassa:

* koirasafareiden itsenäinen vetäminen

* koirien päivittäinen huolto ja hyvinvoinnista huolehtiminen

* päivärutiinien ja aikataulujen hallinta

* asiakkaiden ohjaaminen ja opastaminen

* turvallisuusohjeiden tarkka noudattaminen

* luonnossa ja talvisissa olosuhteissa liikkuminen

* yhteistyö muun työyhteisön kanssa


MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

Etsimme kokenutta ja luotettavaa opasta, jolla on:

* aikaisempaa kokemusta koirasafareiden vetämisestä

* hyvä ymmärrys päivittäisistä rutiineista ja aikatauluista safarioppaana

* suomen tai englannin kielen taito

* muiden kielten osaaminen katsotaan eduksi

* rauhallinen ja vastuullinen ote safarien ohjaamiseen

* tarkkuutta turvallisuusohjeiden noudattamisessa

* joustavuutta ja positiivista asennetta

* hyvä fyysinen toimintakyky ja luonteva tapa liikkua luonnossa

Ennen kaikkea toivomme, että tulet hyvin toimeen koirien ja ihmisten kanssa. Arvostamme opasta, joka osaa pitää tilanteet rauhallisina, huomioi asiakkaat ja koirat, sekä nauttit Lapin luonnosta.


MITÄ TARJOAMME?

* Työt voidaan aloittaa heti

* Työsuhde kestää sesongin loppuun

* Tarjolla on täydet työtunnit, mutta myös pienemmät tuntitakuut ovat mahdollisia

* Majoitus voidaan järjestää läheltä työpaikkaa

* Palkkaus ohjelmapalvelualan TES** mukaan tai osaamisen ja kokemuksen perusteella**

* Mahdollisuus tehdä työtä, jossa Lapin luonto, koirat ja ihmiset kohtaavat joka päivä


KIINNOSTUITKO?

Jos olet kokenut koirasafariopas ja haluat viettää loppusesongin Lapissa koirien, asiakkaiden ja upeiden maisemien parissa, laita meille viestiä ja kerro lyhyesti itsestäsi sekä aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi.

Paikkoja avoinna: 2

Levi, Kittilä
Koirasafariopas
Aloitus: heti
Kesto: sesongin loppuun

Toivottavasti kiinnostuit tehtävästä! Jätä hakemus järjestelmämme kautta helposti parissa minuutissa. Huomioithan, että ainoastaan sähköisen hakujärjestelmämme kautta saapuneet hakemukset käsitellään. Emme käsittele sähköpostitse tai muun kanavan kautta toimitettuja työhakemuksia. jobs.title: Vi søger betonchauffør til Unicon i Århus
jobs.description:
Vil du køre nogle af Danmarks mest ikoniske lastbiler og være med til at levere fundamentet for fremtidens byggeri?

Hos Unicon søger vi en betonchauffør til vores fabrik i Skejby. Som betonchauffør hos os er du meget mere end chauffør. Du er en vigtig del af støbningen og den, der sikrer, at betonen kommer sikkert frem, i den rette kvalitet og på det rigtige tidspunkt.

Du trives naturligvis bag rattet i en stor bil, men mindst lige så vigtigt er det, at du kan samarbejde med kollegerne på fabrikken og med kunderne på byggepladserne. Alle dage afsluttes på fabrikken, så du slipper for overnatninger i bilen.


Du bliver en vigtig del af byggepladsen

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du betonen fra fabrikken til byggepladsen, hvor du samarbejder med både kunden, pumpechaufføren og kollegerne om at få støbningen til at forløbe som planlagt.

Du leverer ikke bare et produkt – du er med til at sikre, at byggeriet kan fortsætte.

Nogle leverancer losses direkte fra bilens bånd, mens andre overføres til en betonpumpe. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan samarbejde med de mennesker, der modtager betonen, og bidrage til, at arbejdet udføres sikkert og effektivt.

Du kommer til at navigere på byggepladser, hvor pladsen ofte er trang, og hvor præcision og overblik er afgørende. Det kræver gode køreevner, sikkerhedsfokus og evnen til at holde hovedet koldt, når forholdene er udfordrende.


Mere byggeplads end landevej

Hvis du drømmer om lange ture gennem Europa, er dette nok ikke det rette job.

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du typisk mange korte ture mellem fabrikken og lokale byggepladser. Til gengæld bliver du en del af byggeprojekterne og får en hverdag med tæt kontakt til kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Det er et job for dig, der kan lide variation, ansvar og en arbejdsdag, hvor du gør en synlig forskel.


Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har stort kørekort inkl. hænger/trailer (CE)

  • Har EU-bevis

  • Har fokus på din egen og andres sikkerhed

  • Trives med at køre og manøvrere store køretøjer under krævende forhold

  • Er serviceminded og professionel i mødet med kunderne

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine leverancer

  • Har fysik til rengøring og vedligeholdelse af bilen

  • Holder orden omkring dig og dit materiel

Det er en fordel, hvis du har krancertifikat eller erfaring fra bygge-, entreprenør- eller transportbranchen, men det er ikke et krav.


Derfor skal du vælge Unicon

Hos Unicon bliver du en del af Danmarks førende betonproducent og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til jobbet

  • Moderne materiel og gode arbejdsforhold

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning inklusive vask

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både fagligt og personligt

  • En unik holdånd og stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • Overenskomst gennem Dansk Industri og 3F

  • En hverdag med selvstændighed og ansvar

En arbejdsdag, hvor kunderne er med til at sætte dagsordenen

Som betonchauffør er din arbejdsdag styret af byggepladsernes behov og dagens leverancer.

Du får typisk besked om mødetid den følgende dag om eftermiddagen, når næste dags produktion og leverancer er planlagt. Arbejdsdagen slutter, når den sidste tur er kørt og bilen er vasket. Du kommer derfor hjem hver dag og slipper for overnatninger i bilen. Det er ikke et traditionelt 7-15-job, og nogle dage kan blive kortere end forventet, mens andre dage bliver længere. Overarbejde forekommer jævnligt, men bliver naturligvis honoreret, og vi har gode muligheder for både udbetaling og opsparing af afspadsering, som mange af vores chauffører bruger til hele fridage.

Hvis du trives med variation, ansvar og en hverdag, hvor opgaven bliver gjort færdig, vil du passe godt ind hos os.


Sådan bliver du en del af holdet

Med udgangspunkt fra vores fabrik i Skejby bliver du en del af et stærkt team af chauffører og kolleger, som hver dag arbejder sammen om at levere beton til nogle af områdets vigtigste byggeprojekter.

Du refererer til fabrikkens daglige leder.

Kan du se dig selv i rollen, hører vi gerne fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Plant Supervisor, Casper Sakskjær Nielsen, på telefon +45 2688 4995.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

Om Unicon 

Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. I vores virksomhed er ansættelse baseret på den enkeltes fortjenester og kvalifikationer, som er direkte relateret til kompetencekrav i jobbet. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. Vi overholder disse principper i alle aspekter af ansættelse, herunder rekruttering, ansættelse, uddannelse, kompensation, forfremmelse og fordele.

jobs.title: IT Architect, Helsinki/Lahti/Tampere
jobs.description:
About the role

As a Hybrid Cloud Architect, you will bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution. You will work in a team of eight to ensure a reliable and scalable infrastructure while staying close to technical implementation.

 

Work tasks

This is not a role where you'll spend your days only studying theoretical architecture frameworks. We're looking for someone who is eager to learn solution design, solve technical challenges, and work closely with senior architects, business stakeholders, and IT partners to get things done. As our client is building our future IT landscape, you'll have the opportunity to grow your expertise and influence technological decisions while staying close to implementation and delivery. You will work across cloud services, infrastructure, integrations, security, and enterprise applications, helping ensure our technological environment supports both office and manufacturing operations.

What you'll be doing In this role, guided by experienced team members, you will:
- Participate in designing and developing solutions across Azure and on-premises environments
- Support cloud migration and modernization projects
- Work with internal teams and external partners to deliver infrastructure and platform solutions
- Support the improvement of integrations between business applications, manufacturing systems, and data platforms
- Help define and apply technical standards and best practices
- Learn and drive automation and Infrastructure as Code approaches
- Assist in ensuring solutions are secure, reliable, and scalable
- Participate in technology projects from planning through implementation
- Evaluate new technologies and suggest practical improvements

We are looking for

- Relevant IT education (Bachelor's or Master's degree) or equivalent foundational experience in IT infrastructure/cloud services
- Basic hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Azure or hybrid cloud environments
- Strong interest in cloud architecture, infrastructure, and enterprise platforms
- Basic understanding of IT concepts such as networking, identity management, and cybersecurity
- Interest in automation, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud operations (FinOps)
- Ability to communicate technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
- A practical, hands-on, and curious approach to technology
- Fluent English skills

It is meritorious if you have
- Good knowledge of the Finnish language
- Experience with SAP, data platforms, or AI solutions
- Background in manufacturing environments
- Microsoft Azure Certification

Other information:
- Start: As soon as possible
- Employment period: Permanent contract
- Location: Helsinki, Lahti, Tampere. Occasional visits to Lahti. At least three days at the office per week

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: R&D Project Manager, Vaisala
jobs.description:
_Vaisala is a global leader in measurement instruments and intelligence helping industries, nations, people, and the planet to thrive. From predicting hurricanes to optimising renewable energy production, our technology is used where it matters the most – from data centres, windfarms and laboratories to airports, the Arctic and even the surface of Mars. Vaisala was recognised by Time Magazine in 2025 as one of the worlds best companies for Sustainable Growth. Our team of over 2,300 experts and 59 nationalities around the world is committed to taking every measure for the planet. Driven by our shared purpose, curiosity, and pioneering spirit, we stay ahead and make a difference. At Vaisala, you don't have to fit in to belong._

**What would you do as an R&D Project Manager?**

As an R&D Project Manager, you will join Vaisala's growing Industrial Measurements business and lead product development projects that bring first-class measurement solutions to demanding industrial applications, such as data center HVAC environments.

You will be responsible for driving product development projects from concept and planning through industrialization and production readiness, following Vaisala's established development process. Your role is to ensure projects progress according to agreed objectives, schedules, and quality requirements while keeping stakeholders aligned and engaged throughout the project lifecycle.

You will be working with physical measurement instruments produced at scale, which calls for close collaboration between R&D and manufacturing – both located on the same site in Vantaa, giving you direct access to experts throughout the development process. You will lead a cross-functional project team and collaborate closely with product management, manufacturing, sourcing, regulatory specialists, marketing, and other stakeholders.

The position is based at Vaisalas headquarters in Vantaa. The role follows a hybrid working model, but due to the highly collaborative nature of the work, we expect you to spend approximately 80% of your time on-site. This is a full-time, permanent position with Biisoni, and you will work on assignment at Vaisala. Our preferred start date is as soon as possible.

**What would help you succeed in this role?**

We are looking for an R&D Project Manager with 1-2 years of project management experience and a background in product development, manufacturing, industrial projects, or another technical environment involving physical products. A degree in engineering, technology, or business will support your success in the role. You communicate fluently in English, while Finnish language skills are considered a plus.

Success in this role requires strong communication and stakeholder management skills, a structured way of working, and the ability to keep projects moving forward in a changing business environment. You are comfortable balancing different priorities, building alignment across teams, and ensuring progress toward business objectives.

jobs.title: Service Technician and Installation Supervisor - Denmark
jobs.description:
About the position:
Ferrum is looking for an experienced and hands-on Service Technician and Installation Supervisor who can take responsibility for the installation, start-up and servicing of individual machines and complete filling lines at our customers' sites. We supply solutions for the production and filling of beer and soft drinks, including process equipment, filling machines, conveyors and associated utility systems.

You will have a key role at customer sites, combining hands-on work with the coordination of installation, connection, testing and commissioning activities. The position requires solid industry experience and extensive travel. Assignments will mainly be in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe, and you must be prepared for overnight stays, changing working hours and work carried out during production shutdowns.

Your main responsibilities:
- Plan and carry out the installation, mechanical assembly and run-in of new machines and complete filling lines.
- Act as Installation Supervisor and coordinate Ferrum technicians, customer personnel, subcontractors and other equipment suppliers on site.
- Ensure correct positioning, levelling and mechanical integration of machines, conveyors, piping, platforms and associated equipment.
- Carry out and verify pneumatic connections and assist with the connection of process media and utilities such as compressed air, water, CO2, nitrogen, steam, cooling and CIP.
- Participate in testing, FAT/SAT, commissioning, production start-up and performance runs in close cooperation with project management, automation specialists and the customer.
- Systematically troubleshoot mechanical and pneumatic faults and carry out basic fault-finding on electrical signals, sensors, drives and PLC-related issues.
- Perform service, inspections, preventive maintenance, repairs, modifications and format changeovers on existing systems.
- Identify the root causes of downtime and quality issues and recommend spare parts, maintenance activities and technical improvements.
- Train customer operators and maintenance personnel in safe operation, cleaning, changeovers and routine maintenance.
- Document progress, working hours, deviations, outstanding items and completed work in daily site and service reports.
- Ensure that all work is performed safely and in accordance with applicable safety requirements, customer site rules and relevant hygiene and food-production requirements.
- Provide practical feedback to the project, engineering and service teams to support the continuous improvement of future solutions and installations.

Your professional background:
- You have a relevant technical qualification, for example as an industrial mechanic, marine engineer, metal fabricator, automation technician or similar.
- Extensive relevant industry experience may compensate for a different educational background.
- You have several years of hands-on experience with the installation, servicing and commissioning of machinery or complete lines for the beverage, brewery, food or packaging industry.
- You have in-depth knowledge of filling lines and preferably experience with fillers, cappers, can seamers, conveyors, mixers/carbonators, pasteurisation, CIP and utility equipment.
- Experience from a manufacturer or service organisation such as Krones, KHS, Sidel, GEA or another supplier of process and filling lines would be a clear advantage.
- You are able to read and work from mechanical drawings, layouts, P&IDs, pneumatic diagrams, manuals and technical documentation.
- You have strong mechanical expertise and can perform precise alignment, installation, adjustment and systematic troubleshooting.
- Knowledge of electrical systems, instrumentation, variable frequency drives, sensors and Siemens PLC/HMI systems is an advantage, but this is not a dedicated PLC programming role.
- You can communicate professionally in written and spoken English. Danish or another European language would be an advantage.
- You hold a valid driving licence and a valid EU/EEA passport, and are able to travel and work throughout Denmark and Europe without significant restrictions.

Personal qualities:
- You take ownership of your assignments and maintain an overview, even when schedules are tight or several disciplines are working simultaneously.
- You are hands-on, solution-oriented and comfortable working independently away from the office.
- You communicate clearly and respectfully with customers, colleagues and subcontractors and can lead site meetings in a professional manner.
- You work in a structured manner and follow up on agreements, open items, safety, quality and documentation.
- You are flexible regarding travel, working hours and changing priorities and understand that start-ups and production-critical service assignments may require additional effort.

We offer:
- A permanent position with significant influence on the successful delivery of international customer projects.
- A varied working day involving new installations, commissioning, service and technical problem-solving.
- The opportunity to work with complete solutions - from process systems and utilities to the finished filling line.
- Close cooperation with project managers, engineers, automation specialists, suppliers and customers' technical organisations.
- An informal company with short decision-making paths, a high level of responsibility and a strong focus on quality and professional integrity.
- Salary and employment terms based on qualifications, together with relevant travel conditions and work equipment.

Practical information:
- Work location: Ferrum's base in Fredericia, combined with assignments at customer sites in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe.
- Travel: Extensive and varying according to the project portfolio. Overnight travel and assignments lasting several weeks may occur.
- Employment: Permanent position.

Application:
Please send your application and CV, including a brief description of your experience with filling lines, installation, service and commissioning. Please also state which machine types and suppliers you have previously worked with and the level of travel you are accustomed to.

For more information about the position and application process, please visit: https://workindenmark.jobnet.dk/find-job/3d290357-17fd-4f50-9711-71a9b19dd200

jobs.title: Senior People & Culture Partner
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Impact Fund Denmark has changed a lot in a short time. We have grown quickly, welcomed many new colleagues and are becoming a larger, more international investment organisation. The same goes for People & Culture and we need and experienced People & Culture professional to strengthen our deliveries in the next phase.

The next phase is about making that growth work well: helping teams come together, strengthening leadership and building and implementing people practices that are robust enough for a more complex organisation without becoming unnecessarily heavy.

We are looking for a senior People & Culture professional with a proven track record across the full HR agenda, including culture and organisational development. You will bring experience and judgement that strengthen the whole function, with the ambition and potential to be considered for the Head of People & Culture role within three to four years. We also welcome experienced former Heads of People & Culture who want to contribute at this level as an individual contributor.

You will serve the whole organisation, where you will partner closely with senior leaders on organisational, leadership, performance and people questions. You will also take responsibility for selected People & Culture priorities and projects across Impact Fund Denmark.

You will be a senior sparring partner to the Head of People & Culture and Executive Management, bringing the confidence and experience to challenge established thinking, shape our people strategy and lead its implementation. We expect you to contribute expertise that colleagues across People & Culture, including its leadership, can learn from.

You will report to our Head of People & Culture.

What you’ll be working on

A part of your role will be spent working directly with leaders across our investment organisation. The questions will vary: how a team should be structured, what capabilities we need next, how to address and build performance, how we strengthen succession, or what senior management needs to know before making a people decision.

You will:

  • lead culture and organisational development initiatives, translating our values and strategic priorities into everyday leadership behaviours, stronger collaboration and clear accountability for performance

  • advise senior leaders and Executive Management on organisational, capability, performance and complex people matters across headquarters and regional offices

  • prepare analysis, recommendations and decision material for Executive Management and, when relevant, the Board

  • support organisational and job design as teams, mandates and responsibilities evolve

  • advise on employee relations matters within local employment law and our agreements across headquarters and regional offices

  • use people data to identify patterns, challenge assumptions and support better decisions

  • take ownership of selected People & Culture projects that cut across the organisation

  • work with People Operations, Finance and Legal to ensure that people processes have clear approvals, appropriate controls and traceable documentation, supporting compliance and auditability under the Danish standards on public-sector auditing (SOR)

  • work closely with colleagues in Recruitment, People Operations and People Development, and coach and mentor People & Culture colleagues to strengthen their business partnering skills and prepare them for broader responsibilities

We are currently a relatively lean People & Culture function. That means there is not a specialist team to hand work over to. If a recommendation requires analysis, a presentation, a new process or careful implementation, you should be comfortable taking ownership and doing that work yourself.

What a good first year looks like

After your first year, we would expect that:

  • Change has moved beyond discussion and design. You have taken ownership of important organisational or capability priorities and helped turn them into practical improvements.

  • Core processes work well. Performance, talent and compensation processes in your area are consistent, useful and delivered on time. Leaders can explain and document their decisions, and demonstrate that people resources are used responsibly and effectively in a state-owned organisation.

  • Leaders trust your advice and judgement. Senior investment leaders involve you early as a trusted advisor and challenger when important organisational or people questions arise.

  • Decisions are better supported. Executive Management receives clear, well-argued recommendations and useful People material from you.

What we’re looking for

There is no single background that will make someone successful in this role, but you will need substantial experience dealing with the full People & Culture agenda, strategy and policy work, senior stakeholders and an organisation that has really great people and leaders with massive potential.

We would expect you to bring:

  • substantial experience in a broad senior HR Business Partner, People Partner or People leadership role in international organisations

  • experience advising senior executives directly on organisational and people decisions

  • demonstrated experience across the full HR agenda, including people strategy, culture and organisational development, recruitment, leadership development, performance, talent and succession, reward, employee relations and HR governance

  • practical experience with organisational design and complex employee matters

  • strong analytical skills and an ability to turn complicated information into a clear point of view and useful recommendations

  • evidence that you can take work from diagnosis through to implementation rather than relying on large specialist teams

  • solid knowledge of Danish employment law and HR practice; knowledge of local employment law across our regional offices is considered an advantage

  • professional fluency in Danish and English

It would be useful, but is not essential, if you also have experience with one or more of the following:

  • financial services, investment or another complex, knowledge-intensive organisation.

  • working with Executive teams and Boards or preparing material for Executives and Board discussions

  • international HR

  • a lean or smaller organisation where senior People professionals remain in delivery

  • compensation, People Analytics, talent or succession

Where the role sits

This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports.

You will be the main People & Culture partner for our investment organisation, working directly with senior investment leaders. At the same time, you will own selected priorities that matter across Impact Fund Denmark and work closely with the Head of People & Culture.

The role will suit someone who likes that combination: being in the room for senior discussions, then staying close enough to the work to make sure something actually happens afterwards.

You should be comfortable moving between an Executive Management discussion, detailed analysis and the practical conversations needed to implement a decision.

Why join Impact Fund Denmark?

You will have close access to the Head of People & Culture and senior leaders across our organisation. You will have considerable scope to influence how we organise, lead and develop our people as Impact Fund Denmark grows and consolidates.

You will also be joining at a point where the organisation is evolving. We are building the people foundation for a larger and more professional international investor, which means some things are already well established while others still need to be shaped.

And the organisation's purpose is tangible. Our investments support green energy and infrastructure, financial services, sustainable food systems and healthcare in developing countries.

jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Impact Fund Denmark has grown over the past few years, and many of our colleagues are still relatively new to the organisation. In 2027, our focus is on making that growth work well: strengthening the systems, processes and ways of working a larger organisation needs, while continuing to hire for our ambitions toward our 2027-2030 strategy.

Recruitment is an important part of that next phase.

We are creating a dedicated Senior Talent Acquisition Partner role to take ownership of how recruitment works across Impact Fund Denmark from attraction and sourcing to assessment, candidate experience and offer.

Hiring managers make the final hiring decision. Your role is to make sure they reach it through a strong, well-run and well-informed process.

You will report to our Head of People & Culture.

What you’ll be working on

You will own end-to-end recruitment across the organisation, covering both investment roles and corporate and support functions.

For each hire, you will take the process from the first conversation with the hiring manager through to offer. You will be responsible for keeping the process moving, maintaining a high standard and making sure both candidates and hiring managers know what to expect.

At the same time, you are responsible for anchoring the recruitment process in the organisation, training hiring manager or appointed recruitment panel, and meticulous documentation of the hiring process and decisions to ensure compliance.

That includes:

  • advising hiring managers on role definition, the candidate market and the right recruitment approach

  • delivering a professional and engaging candidate journey from start to finish, including a welcoming, seamless and positive on-site experience for arriving candidates

  • coordinating, overseeing and driving end-to-end recruitment processes in close collaboration with hiring managers

  • sourcing directly, mapping relevant markets and reaching out to candidates who may not be actively looking

  • Identifying, sourcing and vetting talents on different channels to find top-tier active and passive candidates, and conduct initial screening interviews to assess technical and interpersonal-skills as well as cultural alignment

  • screening and interviewing candidates and helping managers design structured, relevant assessments

  • managing timelines, expectations and communication from intake through to offer

  • briefing and managing external search or recruitment partners when we use them

  • setting and ensuring a consistent standard for job ads, interviews, candidate communication and hiring documentation

  • building talent pipelines and market knowledge for recurring or difficult-to-fill profiles

  • using recruitment data to improve hiring quality, timeliness and cost-effectiveness, and demonstrate responsible use of recruitment resources in a state-owned organisation

  • improving our recruitment tools, templates and ways of working over time

  • ensuring that selection criteria, candidate assessments, approvals and hiring decisions are clearly documented and traceable, supporting public-sector governance, compliance with applicable rules and internal policies, and auditability under the Danish standards on public-sector auditing (SOR)

  • contributing to selected People & Culture projects alongside recruitment where it makes sense

  • training and guiding hiring managers on recruitment processes and guidelines to drive fair, consistent hiring decisions

We use Talentech as our applicant tracking system and CatalystOne as our HR system.

What a good first year looks like

After your first year, we would expect that:

  • Recruitment has a clear owner. Hiring managers know where to go for advice and support, and there is a consistent professional standard across the organisation.

  • Processes are stronger and more consistent. Roles are well defined, assessments are structured, and recruitment decisions are properly documented.

  • Hiring processes keeps moving. Managers receive relevant, well-screened candidate fields, and processes keep momentum on the factors within your control.

  • We rely less on who happens to apply. Direct sourcing is used actively where needed, and external search partners are brought in selectively and managed closely.

What we’re looking for

This role needs someone who is comfortable owning recruitment rather than simply coordinating it.

You will need to bring:

  • Solid experience independently managing end-to-end recruitment

  • strong direct-sourcing experience, including outreach to passive candidates

  • experience recruiting into a professional, knowledge-intensive environment

  • confidence advising senior and demanding hiring managers

  • the ability to keep recruitment processes moving and hold people to agreed timelines

  • experience screening and interviewing candidates, with good judgement about assessment quality

  • strong structure, follow-through and attention to the documentation behind hiring decisions

  • professional fluency in Danish and English

It would be useful, but is not essential, if you also have experience with one or more of the following:

  • recruiting investment or financial-services professionals

  • executive search or other senior professional recruitment

  • briefing and managing external search or recruitment partners

  • market mapping, talent intelligence or proactive pipeline building

  • using recruitment data and metrics to improve processes

  • international recruitment

Where the role sits

This is a Lead role with no direct reports. You will have full ownership of the recruitment lifecycle, meaning you should be comfortable balancing high-level strategy and manager coaching with hands-on execution, including the day-to-day administrative and coordination tasks, candidate care and operational execution.

You will be the main point of contact for recruitment across Impact Fund Denmark and the person responsible for how recruitment is run and for its quality.

Hiring managers remain accountable for who they hire. You bring the candidate market knowledge, recruitment expertise and process that help them make those decisions well.

That means being willing to challenge a brief when necessary, being realistic about the market, keeping a process moving when other priorities compete for attention, and making sure candidate experience does not become an afterthought.

For specialist searches, or during periods of particularly high hiring activity, you will also work with HRBP colleagues and external search partners. For periods of low activity you will build adjacent HR capabilities and part take in leadership development,....

Why join Impact Fund Denmark?

You will have the opportunity to shape how recruitment is done across the organisation rather than inherit a narrowly defined part of the process.

You will work closely with the Head of People & Culture and with senior leaders across the organisation, including our investment teams.

The role is unusually broad for an internal recruitment position. One search may be for an investment professional with a highly specialised background; the next may be for a corporate or functional expert.

And the work connects directly to Impact Fund Denmark's purpose. Every person you help bring into the organisation contributes, in some way, to investments in green energy and infrastructure, financial services, sustainable food systems and healthcare in developing countries.
