jobs.title: 2 Mekanikere/montører søges til spændende automotive virksomhed i Dragør – konverteringer
jobs.description:
Konverteringsforberedelse fra brændstof til el · Praktisk udvikling – Fuldtid, fysisk tilstedeværelse, Dragør, Danmark

RENTEQ Automotive søger efter to praktiske og dygtige mekanikere/montører, der kan tage hånd om de mekaniske aspekter af vores konverteringer til el, og som har det rette mindset til at arbejde i et udviklingsmiljø, hvor processerne løbende optimeres.

Om RENTEQ Automotive

RENTEQ Automotive er en ung dansk virksomhed med en ambition om at reducere CO₂-udledningen ved at elektrificere varebiler og entreprenørmaskiner. Vi holder til i Dragør og tager hele rejsen på os – fra ingeniørarbejde og udvikling helt frem til produktion.

Jobbet

Som mekaniker/montør hos os arbejder du med den praktiske del af konverteringerne – at forberede og demontere maskiner og køretøjer, så de er klar til elektrificering.

Konverteringerne foregår ikke på samlebånd – hvert projekt er anderledes. Du arbejder tæt sammen med ingeniør- og produktionsteamet, kan finde ud af bidrage til problemløsninger tidligt, og hjælper os med at bygge klogere fra gang til gang. Du er med til at sikre, at hver eneste komponent behandles korrekt og dokumenteres præcist, idet dit arbejde er fundamentet for hele konverteringsprojektet.

Dine typiske opgaver vil være:

●      Afmontering af motor og brændstofdel – med fokus på korrekt håndtering og dokumentation

●      Forberedelse af chassis og karosseri til montering af nye elektriske komponenter

●      Tilpasning af komponenter efter konvertering i tæt samarbejde med elektronik- og software-teamet

●      Kvalitetskontrol og dokumentation af alle monteringssteps og fund under demontering

●      Løbende forbedring af proces og arbejdsgange – du kan bidrage til de guider og checklister, vi udvikler

●      Arbejde med varierede maskiner og køretøjer – fra små varebiler til store entreprenørmaskiner

●      Sammen holder vi altid værkstedet organiseret, udstyr vedligeholdt og processer dokumenteret for at sikre den højest mulige kvalitet.

Er det dig?

Vi leder efter en person med solid praktisk erfaring og en tilgang, der kombinerer præcision med fleksibilitet. Vigtigst er, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også er dygtig til at samarbejde i et team, der hele tiden lærer og udvikler sig. Det vil være en fordel, hvis du kan nikke ja til nedenstående:

●      Erfaring med montering og demontering af motor, hydrauliksystem og brændstofkomponenter på landbrugsmaskiner, entreprenørmaskiner eller varebiler

●      Solidt kendskab til mekaniske systemer, væskesystemer og elektriske grundelementer

●      Ideelt set erfaring med eller stærk interesse for konverteringer og ombygninger

●      AC-kursus eller tilsvarende (ikke obligatorisk, men en stor fordel)

●      Evnen til at arbejde struktureret og dokumentere dit arbejde

●      Selvstændighed og ansvar, men også åbenhed over for feedback og samarbejde

●      Tålmodighed og en positiv tilgang til arbejde i et udviklingsmiljø, hvor vi hele tiden forfiner processen

●      Dansk på højt niveau; fungerende engelsk er en fordel, da vi er et internationalt team.

Vi tilbyder

●      En central rolle i vores udviklingsteam, hvor din praktiske viden sætter direkte aftryk på, hvordan vi konverterer

●      Mulighed for at påvirke og udforme arbejdsprocesserne – dine idéer og erfaringer bliver hørt

●      Varieret hverdag med arbejde på en bred vifte af køretøjer og maskiner

●      Tæt samarbejde med dygtige ingeniører og et uformelt, kollegialt team

●      Ordentlige faciliteter, godt værktøj og en støttende arbejdskultur

●      Løn: 190-240 kr./t afhængig af kompetencer og erfaring

●      Reelle muligheder for at vokse fagligt og personligt i takt med, at virksomheden udvikler sig.

Sådan søger du

Send dit CV og et par linjer om dig selv til Simon Steen Kristensen på email simon@ren-teq.com. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og inviterer relevante kandidater til en uformel første samtale – så vent ikke for længe med at tage kontakt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, inden du søger, er du meget velkommen til at skrive til os på samme e-mailadresse, som angivet ovenfor.

jobs.title: International Construction Manager Wanted at DK TØMRER
jobs.description:
International Construction Manager Wanted at DK TØMRER

Do you have an international degree in construction management, architectural technology, civil engineering, building engineering, or a related field – and are you looking to develop your career in the Danish construction industry?

DK TØMRER is looking for a motivated and well-organised International Construction Manager to help manage and coordinate our construction projects across Zealand.

We are a growing construction company working on both large-scale contracts and ongoing construction and renovation projects. We are therefore looking for someone who can help ensure structure, quality, coordination, and progress across our construction sites.

Your Responsibilities

As a Construction Manager, your responsibilities will include:

  • Daily coordination and follow-up on construction sites

  • Planning and coordination of employees and subcontractors

  • Quality assurance and photographic documentation

  • Monitoring schedules, deadlines, and project progress

  • Ordering materials and coordinating deliveries

  • Communicating with project managers, main contractors, and other project partners

  • Reviewing drawings, specifications, and other project documentation

  • Registering and managing additional works and variations

  • Participating in construction and project meetings

  • Monitoring health and safety, quality standards, and site safety

About You

We are looking for someone with a degree in Construction Management, Architectural Technology and Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Building Engineering, or a similar field, preferably obtained outside Denmark.

For us, the most important thing is not where you obtained your education, but that you have a solid understanding of construction, are willing to take responsibility, and are motivated to learn and develop within the Danish construction industry.

You work in a structured manner, are able to maintain an overview in a busy construction-site environment, and communicate effectively with both tradespeople and project management.

The ability to communicate in English is important. Danish language skills are an advantage, but Danish does not need to be your native language.

What We Offer

At DK TØMRER, you will become part of a growing company with short decision-making processes and the opportunity to take on significant responsibility.

We offer:

  • An exciting position involving a variety of construction projects

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development

  • An international workplace that welcomes different nationalities and backgrounds

  • The opportunity to gain valuable experience in Danish construction management

  • Close cooperation with company management and our construction organisation

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience

Work location: Copenhagen and Zealand
Company: DK TØMRER
Starting date: As soon as possible

If you are interested in the position, please send your CV and a short application to pm@dk-tomrer.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Facilities Manager
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Facilities Manager to oversee the delivery of hard and soft facilities services on site for a major account. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for managing day-to-day operations, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, and maintaining high standards of service delivery across multiple stakeholders. You will lead on-site teams, manage contractors, oversee maintenance programmes, and act as the key operational contact for the client. The successful candidate will be a customer-focused facilities professional with strong leadership skills, commercial awareness, and a proven ability to manage operational performance in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities: Operational Management: Manage the day-to-day delivery of hard and soft facilities services across the contract. Lead, motivate, and develop the on-site service delivery team. Oversee planned preventative maintenance (PPM) schedules and lifecycle replacement programmes. Manage reactive maintenance requests and ensure contractual service levels are achieved. Scope, manage, and verify minor works projects. Coordinate contractors and ensure works are completed safely, efficiently, and to specification. Manage permit-to-work and safe systems of work processes. Client & Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary operational point of contact for the client and key stakeholders. Build and maintain strong working relationships through effective communication and service delivery. Attend client meetings and provide operational updates and performance reporting. Resolve issues promptly and professionally while maintaining a customer-focused approach. Health, Safety & Compliance: Ensure compliance with all relevant health and safety legislation and company policies. Lead safety initiatives including toolbox talks, safety walks, and near-miss reporting. Monitor contractor compliance and site safety performance. Promote a strong culture of safety and continuous improvement across all service lines. Financial & Contract Management: Monitor lifecycle expenditure and ensure spending remains within agreed budgets. Manage materials ordering and cost control processes. Support small works estimation and project delivery. Understand and interpret contractual requirements to ensure compliance and value delivery. Administration & Reporting: Maintain accurate contract documentation, records, and compliance files. Produce operational, maintenance, and performance reports as required. Coordinate site inductions and onboarding activities. Manage payroll and timekeeping processes for site-based teams. Maintain lifecycle plans, budgets, and performance data. About You: Essential Experience & Skills: Previous Facilities Management experience in a management or supervisory capacity. Experience managing both hard and soft FM services. Strong people management and leadership skills. Experience working in a client-facing environment.

jobs.title: Courtier Ventes Résidentielles (H/F)
jobs.description:
Vos missions :

En tant que courtier-ère spécialisé-e dans l'immobilier résidentiel, vous jouez un rôle clé dans le développement et la réussite des transactions immobilières sur le marché genevois.

À ce titre, vous serez amené-e à :
- Développer un portefeuille de biens résidentiels (appartements, villas et autres biens) grâce à une prospection active.
- Réaliser des estimations de biens et accompagner les propriétaires en leur apportant des conseils personnalisés adaptés à leur projet.
- Mettre en œuvre la commercialisation des biens : rédaction et diffusion des annonces, organisation des visites et valorisation des propriétés.
- Accompagner vendeurs et acquéreurs tout au long du processus de vente, de la première prise de contact jusqu'à la signature, en assurant un suivi rigoureux.
- Conduire les négociations avec professionnalisme afin de garantir la satisfaction des différentes parties.
- Assurer une veille permanente du marché immobilier genevois afin d'identifier les opportunités et les évolutions du secteur.

Profil recherché :
Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience confirmée d'au moins 10 ans dans le courtage immobilier, idéalement dans le secteur résidentiel. Vous possédez une excellente connaissance du marché immobilier genevois ainsi qu'un réseau professionnel développé.

Autonome, dynamique et orienté-e résultats, vous êtes reconnu-e pour votre sens commercial, votre capacité à instaurer une relation de confiance et votre qualité de service. Vous maîtrisez les techniques de négociation et savez accompagner vos clients avec professionnalisme tout au long de leur projet.

Compétences et prérequis :
- Expérience de 10 ans minimum en courtage immobilier résidentiel
- Excellente connaissance du marché immobilier genevois
- Réseau professionnel solide dans la région
- Français langue maternelle
- Anglais courant
- Maîtrise des outils informatiques usuels
- Permis de conduire indispensable.

Déplacements :
Des déplacements réguliers sont à prévoir dans le cadre de cette fonction.

jobs.title: Gestionnaire de parc ETAM  H/F
jobs.description:

Rejoignez notre client, spécialisé dans la gestion de parc, en tant que Gestionnaire de parc ETAM à METZ - 57070 et contribuez à son développement.

jobs.title: Produktionsmedarbejder / Snedker til Træfolk
jobs.description:
Hos Træfolk søger vi en omhyggelig og kvalitetsbevidst medarbejder til vores produktion i Hedensted.

Du bliver en del af vores produktionsteam, hvor du kommer til at arbejde med fremstilling af eksklusive møbler i træ. Vi arbejder primært med massivtræ og lægger stor vægt på godt håndværk, præcision og kvalitet i alle led af produktionen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du vil blandt andet komme til at arbejde med:

  • Opskæring af træ og pladematerialer

  • Afretning og høvling af træ

  • Limning og samling af emner

  • Arbejde ved limpres

  • Formatsavning

  • Pudsning og klargøring af emner

  • Forberedelse af komponenter til videre produktion og samling

  • Diverse opgaver i forbindelse med fremstilling af vores møbler

Du vil få en vigtig rolle i den indledende del af produktionen, hvor præcision og kvalitet er afgørende for det færdige resultat.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har hænderne godt skruet på og interesse for træ og godt håndværk

  • Har erfaring med eller kendskab til snedkerarbejde

  • Er fortrolig med brug af almindelige snedkermaskiner som afretter, høvl, formatsav og limpres

  • Arbejder struktureret og omhyggeligt

  • Har øje for detaljer og er kvalitetsbevidst

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Er mødestabil og engageret

  • Har lyst til at være en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok

Erfaring fra en lignende stilling eller uddannelse som snedker/tømrer er en stor fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har den rette håndværksmæssige forståelse, interesse og sans for kvalitet.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

  • En varieret hverdag i vores moderne produktion i Hedensted

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med eksklusive møbler og gode materialer

  • En arbejdsplads med stærkt sammenhold og en god omgangstone

  • Et engageret team med stor faglighed og passion for godt håndværk

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og kompetencer

Om Træfolk

Træfolk er et eksklusivt dansk møbelbrand med fokus på godt håndværk, gennemtænkt design og materialer af høj kvalitet.

Vi producerer vores møbler på vores moderne produktion i Hedensted, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe møbler, vi kan være stolte af.

Vi er omkring 20 kolleger med forskellige fagligheder, men fælles for os er passionen for det, vi laver. Vi lægger vægt på høj kvalitet, godt samarbejde og en arbejdsplads, hvor der både er plads til faglighed og godt humør.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så hører vi gerne fra dig. Send en kort ansøgning og gerne et CV, hvor du fortæller lidt om dig selv, din erfaring og hvorfor du kunne tænke dig at blive en del af Træfolk.

jobs.title: Reservedelsekspedient søges til stærkt team hos GLAD Kalundborg

Vores reservedelsafdeling er et centralt bindeled mellem værksted, salg og vores mange eksterne kunder – og du får en vigtig rolle i at sikre, at de rigtige reservedele er på rette sted, på rette tid.

 

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

  • Ekspedition af reservedele og tilbehør/ekstraudstyr til mekanikere og pladesmede på værkstedet

  • Salg af reservedele og tilbehør/ekstraudstyr til eksterne kunder i forretningen og på telefon

  • Fakturering og øvrig administrativ opfølgning

  • Ad hoc-opgaver som lageroptælling og vedligeholdelse af reservedelsområdet

Personprofil:

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra en lignende stilling – f.eks. som reservedelsekspedient, lagermedarbejder eller teknisk salgsassistent

  • Arbejder struktureret, har blik for detaljen og kan lide at holde orden

  • Er serviceminded, nysgerrig og sætter en ære i at hjælpe både kunder og kolleger

  • Trives med at være bindeled mellem kolleger, kunder og leverandører

  • Er imødekommende, lærenem og positiv i din tilgang

  • Har kørekort (B) – og det er et plus, hvis du har truckcertifikat

  • Har flair for IT og gerne kendskab til autobranchen

 

Vi tilbyder:

  • En spændende og alsidig hverdag i en moderne bilforretning med høj faglighed

  • Et stærkt og uformelt team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og har det godt sammen

  • En arbejdsplads med gode muligheder for udvikling

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer, pensionsordning efter overenskomst og sundhedsforsikring

  • En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer – med opstart snarest

  

Ansøgning:

Har du lyst til at blive en del af reservedelsteamet hos Glad Kalundborg?

Find jobannoncen og søg denne stilling på www.glad.dk/job. Her udfylder du en formular med dine oplysninger og vedhæfter din ansøgning og dit CV, samt evt. bilag.

Ansøg med det samme for vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og lukker stillingsopslaget, når vi har fundet den rette. Hvis du vil vide mere, er du velkommen til at kontakte reservedelschef Bo Sørensen på tlf. 50 60 57 23.

Læs mere om os og find jobannoncen for denne stilling på glad.dk/job

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 

Bilcentret Peer Glad A/S | Slagelsevej 88 | 4400 Kalundborg

Tlf. 59511064 | glad.dk | glad@glad.dk

---

Bilcentret Peer Glad A/S består af ca. 40 passionerede kolleger, der alle arbejder med en stærk vision og et stærkt værdisæt i et topmoderne bilhus. Vi er autoriseret forhandler af Peugeot, Citroën, Opel, Subaru og Ifor Williams erhvervs- og hestetrailere samt aut. serviceværksted for Jaguar / Land Rover.

jobs.title: Part-time Administrative Officer for the Centre for Industrial Mechanics
jobs.description:
The Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a part-time Administrative Officer position at the Centre for Industrial Mechanics (CIM), part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the SDU Sønderborg campus.

We are looking for a structured and proactive colleague who can support the Centre’s day-to-day administration, assist with project coordination, and contribute to the planning and organization of conferences, workshops, meetings and other academic and industrial events. The position offers the opportunity to work in an international university environment with close interaction with academic staff, students, external partners and administrative units.

Unique opportunity

The Centre for Industrial Mechanics combines research, education and collaboration with industry across areas including mechanical engineering, energy systems, renewable energy, artificial intelligence, mechatronics and related technologies. As the Centre continues to develop its activities and external collaborations, effective administrative and project support is important for ensuring smooth daily operations and successful delivery of events and projects.

The successful candidate will become part of an international and collaborative working environment and will have a varied portfolio of tasks. The role is well suited to a person who enjoys organizing, coordinating and communicating, and who is comfortable handling both routine administrative duties and changing priorities.

Workplace description

The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at SDU conducts research and education from fundamental engineering principles to applied solutions. The Centre for Industrial Mechanics is located in the Alsion building at SDU’s Sønderborg campus and benefits from strong connections with companies and organizations in Southern Denmark and Northern Germany. The working environment is international, and English is widely used in daily communication.

Duties of the position

  • Conference and Event Organization: Support the planning and practical organization of conferences, workshops, seminars, project meetings and other events. Tasks may include registration, participant communication, invitations, agendas, room coordination, catering, travel arrangements, accommodation, event materials and on-site support.

  • Daily Administrative Support: Assist with general administrative tasks for the Centre and its research groups, including correspondence, document preparation, meeting coordination, scheduling, filing, maintaining administrative records and following up on agreed actions.

  • Project Administration and Coordination: Support externally and internally funded projects with practical project-management tasks such as meeting planning, collection of inputs from partners, follow-up on deadlines and deliverables, preparation of simple status overviews, and coordination of project documentation.

  • Meeting Support: Organize internal and external meetings, prepare agendas and supporting material when required, take meeting notes or minutes, and assist with follow-up of decisions and action points.

  • Communication and Stakeholder Coordination: Communicate professionally with colleagues, students, project partners, companies, conference participants and other external stakeholders, and help ensure that relevant information is shared in a timely and structured manner.

  • Travel and Visit Coordination: Assist with practical arrangements for staff travel, guest visits, invited speakers and visiting researchers in accordance with SDU procedures.

  • Documentation and Information Management: Maintain structured project and administrative files, contact lists, event information, templates, presentations and other shared material, and support the collection and organization of information needed for reports and internal follow-up.

  • Financial and Procurement Support: Provide practical administrative assistance related to purchases, invoices, reimbursements, budgets and project expenses in coordination with the relevant SDU administrative functions. The role does not require responsibility for formal financial approval.

  • Other Administrative Tasks: Contribute flexibly to other administrative and organizational tasks that arise in the daily operation of the Centre and its projects.

We are seeking a reliable and motivated candidate with strong organizational and communication skills. The position does not require a specific advanced academic specialization; a relevant Bachelor’s or Master’s degree is sufficient.

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business administration, management, communication, social sciences, humanities, engineering management, public administration, project management, or another relevant field.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several tasks, deadlines and stakeholders in parallel.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • A structured, responsible and service-oriented approach to administrative work.

  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with academic and administrative colleagues.

  • Good general digital skills, including confidence using common office applications such as Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams.

  • Attention to detail and the ability to handle information and documentation systematically.

It will be considered an advantage if you have

  • Previous experience with administration, event or conference organization, project coordination, or similar support functions.

  • Experience from a university, research organization, public institution or an international working environment.

  • Experience supporting externally funded projects or collaboration with companies and other external partners.

Personal qualifications

We value a colleague who is approachable, dependable and solution-oriented. You should enjoy creating structure, helping others and following tasks through to completion. Since the role involves interaction with many different people, we also expect you to communicate clearly and professionally and to handle changing priorities with flexibility.

The position is part-time with anticipated 12 hours per week. It is time limited to 1 year with the possibility for extension.

The exact weekly working hours and distribution of working time will be agreed in connection with the appointment. 

The workplace is Campus Soenderborg. 

Preferred starting date: As soon as possible. 

Further information

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Lars Duggen, Centre for Industrial Mechanics, University of Southern Denmark, e-mail: duggen@sdu.dk.

Information about the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering and the Centre for Industrial Mechanics is available on SDU’s website.

Application procedure

Applications must be submitted electronically through SDU’s recruitment system. The application should include the following:

  • A motivated application describing your interest in the position and relevant experience.

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Documentation of relevant Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree.

  • Any additional documentation that you consider relevant to the position.

Application deadline is September 24, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. 

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: Directeur (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description:

Qualités recherchées :

- Autonomie et savoir-faire en droit, économie et gestion

- Expérience : Plus de 5 ans


Certificats requis

- Aucun certificat requis

jobs.title: Kvalitetsprofil / QA QC Konsulent (Region Nordjylland)
jobs.description:
Region Nordjylland

Er du stærk inden for kvalitetssikring, dokumentation og opfølgning på bygge eller anlægsprojekter? Vi søger en engageret Kvalitetsprofil / QA QC Konsulent til vores kunde i Region Nordjylland, hvor du vil spille en central rolle i at sikre kvalitet, struktur og dokumentation gennem projektets udførelse.

Om stillingen

Som Kvalitetsprofil / QA QC Konsulent bliver du en vigtig del af en større projektorganisation, hvor du skal sikre, at kvaliteten bliver dokumenteret, fulgt op og lukket korrekt gennem hele projektforløbet.

Rollen kræver en praktisk og struktureret profil, der forstår byggepladsens tempo og samtidig kan holde styr på kontrolplaner, dokumentation, afvigelser og aflevering.

Du vil blandt andet arbejde med:

Kvalitetssikring
Du sikrer, at arbejdet udføres i henhold til gældende krav, kontrolplaner og projektets kvalitetsstandarder.

  • Dokumentation og kontrolplaner
    Du arbejder med dokumentation, kontrolplaner og opfølgning på kvalitet gennem projektets faser.

  • Tilsyn og sitekontrol
    Du gennemfører kvalitetstjek på pladsen og følger op på udførelse, fejl, mangler og afvigelser.

  • Afvigelseshåndtering
    Du registrerer, følger op på og bidrager til lukning af afvigelser i samarbejde med projektledelse og produktion.

  • Samarbejde med projektorganisationen
    Du understøtter projektleder, produktion og underentreprenører med kvalitetssikring og dokumentationsflow.

Du får en rolle, hvor din evne til at skabe struktur, følge op og fastholde kvaliteten i en travl projektfase bliver afgørende.

Din profil

Vi ser gerne, at du har følgende kvalifikationer:

  • Relevant teknisk eller kvalitetsfaglig baggrund
    Du har erfaring fra byggeri, anlæg, kvalitetssikring eller teknisk dokumentation på større projekter.

  • Erfaring med QA QC
    Du har arbejdet med kvalitetssikring, kontrolplaner, dokumentation, tilsyn eller afvigelseshåndtering.

  • Byggepladsforståelse
    Du forstår, hvordan kvalitet skal fungere i praksis tæt på udførelsen.

  • Struktureret dokumentationsarbejde
    Du kan holde overblik over dokumentation, status, mangler og afleveringspakker.

  • Tydelig kommunikation
    Du kan samarbejde med projektledelse, produktion, underentreprenører og øvrige interessenter.

  • Kan tale og forstå dansk
    Du kan forstå instruktioner, sikkerhed, møder og daglig kommunikation på dansk i projektet.

Som person er du grundig, struktureret og vedholdende. Du følger op, indtil tingene er lukket, og du forstår, at kvalitet ikke kun handler om kontrol, men om at sikre, at projektet ikke taber dokumentation og overblik undervejs.

Arbejdssted og praktiske forhold

Arbejdsstedet er i Region Nordjylland.

Rollen vil primært være tilknyttet projektkontor og byggeplads, hvor du arbejder tæt sammen med projektorganisationen.

Forventet opstart er fra oktober 2026 eller efter aftale.

Varigheden forventes at være op til halvandet år fra udførelsesfasen.

Hvad vi tilbyder

  • En spændende rolle med ansvar for kvalitet
    Du får mulighed for at bidrage til kvalitetssikringen på et større bygge eller anlægsprojekt.

  • En praktisk rolle tæt på projektet
    Du kommer tæt på udførelsen og får en vigtig funktion i projektets daglige kvalitetsarbejde.

  • Et dynamisk projektmiljø
    Du bliver en del af en projektorganisation med mange snitflader og behov for stærk struktur.

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling
    Du får mulighed for at bringe din erfaring med kvalitet, dokumentation og opfølgning i spil.

  • Attraktiv løn efter kvalifikationer

  • Opstart - Oktober 2026 eller efter aftale

Vi ønsker stillingen besat med den rette kandidat og afholder samtaler løbende.

Om stillingen

Som Arbejdsmiljøprofil / HSE Konsulent bliver du ansvarlig for at understøtte arbejdsmiljø og sikkerhed i den daglige udførelse.

Rollen kræver, at du er synlig på pladsen, tør tage dialogen med både mandskab og ledelse og kan følge op på sikkerhed, observationer, hændelser og dokumentation.

Du vil blandt andet arbejde med:

  • Arbejdsmiljø og sikkerhed på site
    Du følger op på arbejdsmiljøforhold og bidrager til, at sikkerheden bliver håndteret aktivt i hverdagen.

  • Sikkerhedsrunderinger
    Du gennemfører runderinger, registrerer observationer og følger op på forhold, der kræver handling.

  • Instruktion og toolbox talks
    Du deltager i instruktioner og sikkerhedsdialoger med mandskab, underentreprenører og projektorganisation.

  • Hændelsesopfølgning
    Du følger op på hændelser, nærved hændelser og sikkerhedsbrud samt sikrer relevant dokumentation.

  • Samarbejde med projektledelse og produktion
    Du understøtter projektledelsen i arbejdsmiljøplanlægning og bidrager til, at sikkerhed bliver en naturlig del af udførelsen.

Du får en rolle, hvor synlighed, tydelig kommunikation og praktisk gennemslagskraft er vigtigere end skrivebordsarbejde alene.

Din profil

Vi ser gerne, at du har følgende kvalifikationer:

  • Erfaring med arbejdsmiljø på bygge eller anlægsprojekter
    Du har arbejdet med HSE, arbejdsmiljøkoordinering eller sikkerhedsopfølgning i projektmiljøer.

  • Kendskab til arbejdsmiljølovgivning og praksis
    Du forstår kravene og kan omsætte dem til konkrete handlinger på byggepladsen.

  • Erfaring med runderinger og opfølgning
    Du kan gennemføre sikkerhedsrunderinger og sikre, at observationer bliver fulgt til dørs.

  • Stærk kommunikation
    Du kan tale med både mandskab, ledelse og underentreprenører på en tydelig og konstruktiv måde.

  • Dokumentationsforståelse
    Du kan registrere observationer, hændelser og opfølgning systematisk.

  • Kan tale og forstå dansk
    Du kan forstå instruktioner, sikkerhed, møder og daglig kommunikation på dansk i projektet.

Som person er du tydelig, robust og nærværende. Du skal kunne være synlig på pladsen og tage de nødvendige samtaler, også når det er ubelejligt.

    Du arbejder tæt på mandskab, produktion og projektledelse.

    Du bliver en del af en organisation, hvor arbejdsmiljø, struktur og ansvar vægtes højt.

    Du identificerer afhængigheder, grænseflader og kritiske aktiviteter på tværs af projektet.

jobs.title: Construction workers for renovation projects – Holbæk / Zealand, Denmark
jobs.description:
BN Group ApS is recruiting 1–10 experienced construction workers for building and renovation projects around Holbæk and across Zealand (Sjælland), Denmark. Individuals and small teams are welcome. There is potential for a long-term working relationship.

THE WORK

Depending on your experience, tasks may include bricklaying, plastering and filling, tiling, concrete work, basement renovation, excavation, demolition, ceilings, doors, skirting boards and small carpentry jobs.

You do not need to do everything. Tell us which tasks you can carry out independently and which require support. We are looking for practical experience, reliable attendance and careful work. English, a driving licence and your own vehicle are advantages.

WORKING IN DENMARK

Applicants of all nationalities are welcome. You must have the legal right to carry out the proposed work in Denmark before starting. Any restrictions must be clarified before an agreement.

The company is registered at Gl. Præstebrovej 24, 4532 Gislinge, in Holbæk municipality. The work takes place on construction and renovation sites around Holbæk and across Zealand.

Accommodation may be available through the company. Availability, rent and utilities are agreed separately. Pay, working hours, start date, transport and other employment terms will be agreed individually.

HOW TO APPLY

Email bn@bygge-gruppen.dk with the subject “Construction worker Holbæk – [your name]”. Please include:

• Your practical experience and the tasks you can carry out independently.

• A few photographs of your own work and any relevant references.

• Your current location, earliest availability and, if applying as a team, the number of people.

• Languages spoken and whether you have a driving licence or vehicle.

• Your expected GROSS hourly wage before tax, stating the currency.

• Whether you need accommodation and your current work authorisation status for Denmark. Do not send identity documents with the initial application.

-

jobs.title: Restaurant Manager
jobs.description:
Location: Gråbrødretorv 9, st.tv., 1154 København K
Position: Full-time
Start date: As soon as we find the right candidate

About Steam

Steam is a unique Chinese restaurant in the heart of Copenhagen. We share the flavours we love through handmade food, regional Chinese dishes, and fermentation—from comforting brunch favourites to warming copper-pot rice noodles and dishes made for sharing.

Our hospitality is personal, welcoming, and relaxed. We care about good food and the small details that make guests feel at home.

We are looking for a hands-on Restaurant Manager to lead our front-of-house team, take ownership of daily operations, and help Steam grow.

The Role

You will lead from the floor, work closely with the kitchen team, and keep service running smoothly. From supporting colleagues during busy shifts to organising schedules and special events, you will combine warm hospitality with confident, practical leadership.

We are looking for someone who notices what needs doing, takes initiative, and follows through.

Key Responsibilities

  • Service and guest experience: Lead daily service, manage reservations and table flow, and handle guest enquiries, special requests, and feedback with care.

  • Team leadership and scheduling: Train and motivate the FOH team, give constructive feedback, prepare schedules within agreed staffing budgets, and oversee shift coverage and recorded hours.

  • Menu knowledge and kitchen coordination: Ensure the team can confidently explain our food, drinks, and allergens, and maintain clear communication with the kitchen throughout service.

  • Operations and business awareness: Maintain opening, closing, and cleanliness standards; oversee stock, ordering, and cash reconciliation; and identify ways to reduce waste and improve sales and efficiency.

  • Events and collaborations: Help plan and deliver pop-ups, festivals, private bookings, and special events.

  • Social media: Capture everyday moments, food, and events for Steam’s social channels.

About You

You enjoy taking responsibility, making decisions independently, and helping the team do its best work. You bring:

  • At least 3 years of hospitality experience, ideally with supervisory or team leadership experience.

  • Strong organisational skills, a calm approach during busy service, and confidence in solving problems and giving and receiving feedback.

  • A warm, attentive approach to guests and a supportive attitude towards colleagues.

  • An interest in Chinese food and a willingness to learn about our ingredients, techniques, and stories.

  • Clear communication skills in English; Danish, Chinese, or Japanese are a plus.

  • Availability to work evenings, weekends, and peak service hours.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary based on experience and responsibilities.

  • Real responsibility and room to shape daily operations.

  • A supportive international team with a passion for food and hospitality.

  • Opportunities to take part in food events, pop-ups, and creative collaborations.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a short introduction about yourself and why you would like to join Steam to steam@steamfusion.dk, with “Steam Restaurant Manager” in the subject line.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidate.

jobs.title: Klinikassistent til hårtransplantation / Clinical Assistant – Hair Restoration
jobs.description:
Copenhagen Private Clinic på Frederiksberg søger en engageret og ansvarsbevidst klinikassistent til vores team.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer ugentligt og omfatter primært praktisk og klinisk assistance i forbindelse med klinikkens behandlinger inden for hårtransplantation og hair restoration.

Arbejdsopgaverne omfatter blandt andet klargøring af behandlingsrum, instrumenter og udstyr, assistance før, under og efter hårtransplantationsbehandlinger, praktisk hjælp ved håndtering og klargøring af grafts efter oplæring og instruktion, modtagelse og forberedelse af patienter, patientvejledning før og efter behandling samt lettere dokumentation og administrative opgaver.

Vi forventer, at du er ansvarsbevidst, omhyggelig og struktureret, har gode samarbejdsevner og interesse for klinisk arbejde og patientkontakt. Du skal være indstillet på at lære nye procedurer og arbejdsmetoder og kunne arbejde både selvstændigt og som en del af et team.

Erfaring fra klinik, sundhedssektoren, kosmetiske behandlinger eller hårtransplantation er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Relevant oplæring vil blive tilbudt.

Ansættelse: Fuldtid, 37 timer ugentligt
Arbejdssted: Copenhagen Private Clinic, Frederiksberg
Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår: Efter kvalifikationer og nærmere aftale.

Ansøgning og CV sendes til Copenhagen Private Clinic.

Copenhagen Private Clinic in Frederiksberg is looking for a motivated and responsible Clinical Assistant to join our team.

The position is full-time, 37 hours per week, and primarily involves practical and clinical assistance in connection with the clinic’s hair transplantation and hair restoration treatments.

The main responsibilities include preparation of treatment rooms, instruments and equipment, assistance before, during and after hair transplantation procedures, practical assistance with handling and preparation of grafts following training and instruction, preparation and reception of patients, practical patient guidance before and after treatment, as well as basic documentation and administrative tasks.

We are looking for someone who is responsible, detail-oriented and well organised, with good teamwork skills and an interest in clinical work and patient care. You should be motivated to learn new procedures and working methods and be able to work both independently and as part of a team.

Previous experience from a clinic, healthcare, cosmetic treatments or hair transplantation is an advantage, but not a requirement. Relevant training will be provided.

Employment: Full-time, 37 hours per week
Workplace: Copenhagen Private Clinic, Frederiksberg, Denmark
Starting date: By agreement
Salary and employment conditions: According to qualifications and agreement.

Please send your application and CV to Copenhagen Private Clinic.

jobs.title: Junior Payroll Assistant
jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate across 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Mission of the role

To ensure the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of payroll for multiple UK clients. The UK Payroll Executive will be responsible for managing payroll data, processing payroll transactions, supporting workplace pension auto-enrolment, responding to client queries, and ensuring all payroll activities are completed in line with UK labour laws, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and agreed client timelines.

The role requires strong attention to detail, client service, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple payrolls and deadlines efficiently while continuously looking for ways to improve workflows through technology, AI, and automation.

Key outcomes In the first 6â12 monthsOutcome 1: UK Payroll Knowledge & Process Proficiency

Develop a strong foundational understanding of UK payroll regulations and processes and confidently apply the appropriate rules when preparing and processing client payrolls.

Become fully familiar with Sleek's internal payroll platforms and processes, including HMRC submissions such as RTI, FPS and EPS, workplace pension submissions, and year-end reporting requirements including P60s and P11Ds by the third month.

Outcome 2: Accurate & Compliant Payroll Processing

Process assigned client payrolls accurately and within agreed timelines, ensuring all payroll data is complete and correctly validated before submission.

Ensure 100% compliance with agreed payroll and statutory deadlines, including payroll runs, pension auto-enrolment submissions, and applicable HMRC requirements.

Identify discrepancies or potential issues early, take ownership of resolving them, and maintain high standards of confidentiality and data accuracy.

Outcome 3: Client Service & Responsiveness

Maintain a high level of client satisfaction by providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses to payroll-related queries.

Consistently achieve a CSAT target of at least 97% month-on-month while ensuring that client queries and emails are responded to within the agreed communication SLA, with no non-reply tickets or emails left unresolved at the end of the working day.

Build trusted relationships with clients by providing clear updates, proactively following up on outstanding information, and handling difficult conversations positively when required.

Outcome 4: Team Collaboration & Process Improvement

Work effectively with the UK Payroll team and other internal departments to ensure smooth payroll operations and timely resolution of client or processing issues.

Contribute to improving payroll processes and operational efficiency by identifying opportunities to use AI, automation, payroll technology, and improved workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase turnaround times.

Must-have experience

  • Minimum 1â2 years of hands-on UK payroll processing experience.
  • Experience working in a bureau, outsourced payroll environment, or shared services centre is preferred.
  • Experience managing multiple client payroll accounts is an advantage.
  • Working knowledge of UK payroll processes, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and workplace pension processes.
  • Experience with payroll software such as BrightPay, Xero Payroll, or similar is an advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail and experience working with sensitive and confidential financial information.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.

Description:

Business Intelligence Engineer, SCOT - Automated Inventory Management
Job ID: 10529667 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

The Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization owns Amazon's global inventory management systems: we decide what, when, where, and how much we should buy to meet Amazon's business goals and to make our customers happy. We do this for millions of items, for hundreds of product lines worth billions of dollars of inventory world-wide. We foster new game-changing ideas, creating ever more intelligent and self-learning systems to maximize the efficiency of Amazon's inventory investment and placement decisions.
The Automated Inventory Management team within SCOT seeks an experienced and motivated Business Intelligence Engineer to develop analytical models and tools to automate the auditing of the SCOT systems. Such tools may include algorithms, metric bridges, dashboards, processes and workflow systems.

The successful candidate will have strong quantitative data mining and modeling skills and be comfortable working on new and sometimes ambiguous problems from concept through to execution. They will have strong communication and leadership skills, will be able to collaborate with other teams (e.g. software development, business owners, product managers) and to present findings to senior audiences to drive business improvements. As well we expect this candidate to raise the bar on any of the following categories: Data Warehousing, Data Architecture, Performant Self Service Toolsets and Data analytics. Candidate might be willing to work with the others BIEs in order to solve organizational problems at scale and setting the grounds of a healthy data products offer while delivering what is required by business.

Key job responsibilities

• Performing complex analysis to understand the behavior of automated inventory management systems, identify the root cause of system / process issues and provide insight on potential solutions.
• Building audits (analytical products) to identify trend breaks or defects at scale for millions of products and multiple Marketplaces globally
• Assessing the end-to-end suite of audits and identifying opportunities for enhancements and simplification, working with other audit owners
• Creating new solutions to automate the business process of identifying and resolving defects (e.g. through metric dashboards and automated alarms, self service dashboard, Single source of truth tables... )
• Supporting the improvement of the automated audit workflow system: integrating new audits and providing input on the future developments/roadmap
• Developing dashboards and insight products
• Fostering culture of continuous engineering improvement through blueprints, mentoring, feedback, and metrics

jobs.description:
Description:

Senior Financial Analyst, EU Operations FP&A
Job ID: 10528196 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

The right financial and business decisions have made Amazon what it is today. As a Senior Financial Analyst, you'll help us optimize our finances so that we can enhance our customer experience even more and navigate the fast-changing business environment. This role is an opportunity to act as the key finance leader and get really involved with shaping our business. You'll influence others and use insights to show senior stakeholders ways that we can move forward with our business ambitions.

Key job responsibilities

• Build financial models to drive business decisions and make judgement calls on challenges using your understanding of Amazon's cost structure
• Lead projects by overseeing timelines, priorities, auditing quality and resolving issues
• Generate insights from financial data, identify opportunities for greater efficiency, and communicate findings with the leadership team to drive business actions
• Own the financial reporting, create scalable processes and monitor teams for accuracy
• Onboard, develop and mentor team members in areas of financial reporting for accuracy, create best practice materials and promote knowledge sharing

A day in the life

Your typical day involves consolidating weekly or monthly financials for Cost-to-Serve initiatives, connecting with initiative owners to gather updates and validate data accuracy. You'll prepare insightful analyses for Management Business Reviews (MBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), focusing on trends and performance metrics. A significant portion of your time is dedicated to leading Quadrant reporting for Cost-to-Serve, requiring close partnership with Operations teams to ensure alignment and accurate representation of financial impacts.

About the team

Our team uniquely bridges Operations Finance and Stores organizations, owning Cost-to-Serve strategies and cost allocations that span multiple business units. We are the only team within Operations Finance that creates this valuable connection between these two critical organizations.
Our mission centers on providing financial clarity, driving cost efficiency, and enabling data-driven decision making across the business. We take pride in our ability to influence strategic decisions through robust financial analysis and cross-functional partnerships. By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact while gaining exposure to multiple aspects of the business.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or above
• Experience in a finance role leading a project or program and partnering with multiple stakeholders within a business
• Experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau
• Experience in financial modeling

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Mathematics, or Economics
• Experience troubleshooting problems and offering solutions to streamline complex challenges
• Experience working in a large team or fast-paced corporate environment

Title:  Fund Legal Senior Officer – CDI

Dept:  FUND LEGAL DEPARTMENT

Description:

The Fund Legal Department is in charge of company secretarial tasks, internal control and corporate governance for the Cayman Islands domiciled subsidiaries of NBL as well as monitoring of the legislation and regulations applicable to our business activities. The Fund Legal Department is also responsible for the legal work in relation to the set-up, restructuring and liquidation of the Cayman investment funds administered by NBL.

In order to support the department, we are looking for a legal officer on a permanent contract.

Your main tasks will be:

• Organize the board meetings for our two Cayman subsidiaries (GFTC/MTC),  Ensure the related documentation is collected, drafted, shared, signed and registered appropriately
• Coordinate and liaise with the team and lawyers for the execution and delivery of legal documents
• Draft and review GFTC/MTC's corporate governance policies and procedures. Control NBL polices applicable to GFTC/MTC.  
• Draft various regulatory reporting to Cayman authorities.
• Conduct the risk assessment of the third-party service providers (e.g. external law firms)
• Assess various invoices from the third parties.
• Assist the team to perform certain fund projects (setting up, restructuring and termination of funds).
• Safekeeping of original documents and database maintenance

Job requirements:

• Successful candidates must possess either: (a) an academic background in Studies in Law, with a preference for Luxembourg, European, and/or UK common law jurisdictions. Experience in a legal environment would be a plus; or (b) a minimum of three years of professional experience within a law firm or a legal department of financial institutions or equivalent entities
• Familiar with laws and regulations applicable for global financial institutions
• General knowledge of company secretary functions for companies and internal control
• A collaborative mindset and willingness to share administrative tasks and operational responsibilities with team members to ensure smooth departmental operations.
• A keen interest in offshore jurisdictions, with a specific focus on Cayman Islands fund structures.
• Very good level of English. In particular, advanced English writing skill is essential
• Good legal drafting and analytical skills; attention to details,
• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with a track record of meeting strict deadlines
• Sound judgment in compliance with laws and regulations as well as common sense and commercial reasonability
• Proactive with stress resilience and hands-on approach
• Good communication skills in English (French is a plus), open-mindedness, and flexibility to adapt to an international and multicultural office environment

Please be aware that in accordance with the law of July 23, 2016, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3)

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Køkkensouschef søges til vores burgerafdeling hos Smash Burger i Sydhavnen
jobs.description:
KØKKEN SOUSCHEF SØGES TIL SMASH BURGER APS – SYDHAVN

Smash Burger ApS søger en erfaren og engageret køkken souschef til vores restaurant i Sydhavnen.

Om restauranten

Smash Burger er en moderne burgerrestaurant med fokus på friske råvarer, god kvalitet og velsmagende mad. Vi tilbereder blandt andet smashburgere, chicken burgers, fries og andre klassiske fast-food retter. Restauranten har både almindelig restaurantdrift og takeaway, og der er derfor ofte et højt tempo, hvor effektivitet, kvalitet og godt samarbejde er vigtigt.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som køkken souschef vil du blandt andet:

  • Assistere køkkenchefen med den daglige drift og planlægning

  • Koordinere og fordele arbejdsopgaver blandt køkkenpersonalet

  • Tage ansvar for køkkenet, når køkkenchefen ikke er til stede

  • Deltage aktivt i madlavning, forberedelse og service

  • Sikre kvalitet og ensartethed i produktionen

  • Planlægge og følge op på mise en place og prep

  • Oplære og vejlede nye medarbejdere

  • Sikre et effektivt arbejdsflow under travle perioder

  • Kontrollere råvarer, lager og varemodtagelse

  • Sikre overholdelse af hygiejne- og fødevaresikkerhedsregler

  • Bidrage til at reducere madspild og optimere råvareforbruget

Vi søger dig, der

  • Har erfaring fra et professionelt køkken

  • Har erfaring som souschef, køkkenansvarlig eller i en tilsvarende funktion

  • Har erfaring med koordinering eller ledelse af køkkenpersonale

  • Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt

  • Kan bevare overblikket i et travlt køkken

  • Har fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet og god hygiejne

  • Er stabil, ansvarsbevidst og fleksibel

  • Kan kommunikere på engelsk. Dansk er en fordel.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

  • En central rolle i den daglige køkkendrift

  • Ansvar og mulighed for indflydelse

  • Et dynamisk arbejdsmiljø med højt tempo

  • Tæt samarbejde med køkkenchef og øvrigt personale

  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Løn efter erfaring og kvalifikationer

  • Ansættelse på almindelige danske vilkår

Arbejdstiden kan omfatte dag-, aften- og weekendarbejde.

Kontakt os og send ansøgning/CV på tlf: 42314315 eller på mail: Info@smashburger.dk,

ENGLISH

KITCHEN SOUS CHEF WANTED FOR SMASH BURGER APS – SYDHAVN

Smash Burger ApS is looking for an experienced and motivated Kitchen Sous Chef for our restaurant in Sydhavnen.

About the restaurant

Smash Burger is a modern burger restaurant focusing on fresh ingredients, quality and great-tasting food. We prepare smash burgers, chicken burgers, fries and other classic fast-food dishes. The restaurant provides both regular restaurant service and takeaway, which means that the kitchen can be busy and requires efficiency, consistency and good teamwork.

Main responsibilities

As Kitchen Sous Chef, your responsibilities will include:

  • Assisting the Head Chef with daily kitchen operations and planning

  • Coordinating and distributing tasks among kitchen staff

  • Taking responsibility for the kitchen when the Head Chef is absent

  • Taking an active part in food preparation and service

  • Ensuring quality and consistency in food production

  • Planning and following up on mise en place and preparation

  • Training and guiding new employees

  • Maintaining an efficient workflow during busy periods

  • Monitoring ingredients, stock and deliveries

  • Ensuring compliance with food hygiene and food safety requirements

  • Helping reduce food waste and optimise the use of ingredients

About you

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has experience from a professional kitchen

  • Has experience as a Sous Chef, Kitchen Supervisor or in a similar position

  • Has experience coordinating or supervising kitchen staff

  • Works independently and in a structured manner

  • Can remain calm and organised in a busy kitchen

  • Has a strong focus on quality, efficiency and hygiene

  • Is reliable, responsible and flexible

  • Can communicate in English. Danish is an advantage.

We offer

  • Permanent full-time employment of 37 hours per week

  • A central role in the daily kitchen operation

  • Responsibility and the opportunity to influence the kitchen operation

  • A dynamic and fast-paced working environment

  • Close cooperation with the Head Chef and kitchen team

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development

  • Salary based on experience and qualifications

  • Employment on ordinary Danish terms

Working hours may include daytime, evening and weekend shifts.

Notre client recherche un/une Expert Flux / Business Analyst Support Applicatif (H/F) dans le cadre d'une mission freelance.

La mission s'inscrit au sein d'une équipe support en charge des flux (data marchés financiers) entre fournisseurs externes et applications internes.

- Assurer les échanges avec les équipes techniques, les providers et les équipes support ;

- Préparer et suivre les demandes d'ouverture de flux et la documentation associée ;

- Contribuer à la validation des schémas d'architecture et des dispositifs de sécurité ;

- Réaliser ponctuellement des activités de support applicatif ;

- Intervenir lors des mises à niveau des applications lorsque nécessaire ;

- Documentation administrative et technique liée aux ouvertures de flux ;

- Scripts nécessaires au traitement des fichiers et à l'automatisation des traitements.

- Expérience en support applicatif et traitement d'incidents liés aux flux ;

- Maîtrise opérationnelle des protocoles et technologies de flux SFTP, SSH, MQ, Webservices et NFS ;

- Bonne maîtrise des problématiques d'architecture et de sécurité des flux, notamment DMZ, Proxy et procédures d'ouverture de flux.

Le bénéficiaire souhaite une prestation d'accompagnement visant à renforcer les travaux de gouvernance cyber du Groupe, avec un focus principal sur les thématiques IT Continuity, Resilience, Backup & Restore et Cloud Security, ainsi que sur la formalisation d'exigences et de procédures cyber applicables aux entités du Groupe.

   Animation et facilitation de workshops en anglais avec les entités et fonctions du Groupe, afin de cadrer les attendus, partager les livrables et recueillir les retours opérationnels

   Contribution à l'alignement des exigences avec les cadres de référence, les bonnes pratiques de continuité/résilience IT, de Cloud Security et les attentes de conformité applicables

CONDITIONS DE TRAVAIL

*

   Mission longue

*

5.  Capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs cyber, IT, risques, production et entités métiers dans un environnement Groupe international
6.  Bonne compréhension des cadres de référence et bonnes pratiques cyber, sans nécessité d'être expert technique dans chaque domaine
7.  Expérience préalable dans la construction ou l'évolution de cadres de référence, procédures ou exigences cyber Groupe fortement souhaitée
8.  Expérience sur des procédures ou exigences Cloud Security, notamment autour de l'application des exigences cyber aux environnements IaaS, PaaS/CaaS et SaaS, particulièrement appréciée
9.  Rigueur, autonomie, bonne capacité de synthèse et aisance dans la coordination transverse
10. Anglais courant obligatoire, à l'oral comme à l'écrit

Acompanhamento social individualizado dos residentes, apoio no processo de admissão e integração, e articulação direta com as famílias;
